item.properties|f.fierce_flamberge: A scorching saber whose main thrust is to rotisserie your foes.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
item.properties|f.brandish: A reliable blade whose lack of ornamentation belies its strength.
projectx.properties|m.save_offer: In order to save the knight that you have created, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Lord Vanaduke \nLittle is known about the eternal Duke of the Almirian Empire. Our sensors show the mask is a source of power as well as a potential weakness.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: No problem, from the top then...
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3a: Gremlins are a race of creatures who are incredibly adept at creating and dismantling all manners of machinery. They are at once a legion of brilliant artificers and a force of powerful destruction.
guild.properties|m.removing_features: Removing this expansion will lower upkeep but will also remove any installed rooms or doors in the expansion. Any furnishings in the expansion will be returned to the Guild Treasury.\n\nAdditionally you will lose the following features\: {0}
item.properties|f.volcanic_pepperbox: When encamped in dangerous territory, the Volcanic Pepperbox is perfect for roasting both marshmallows and enemies.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r4: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: Spiral HQ wants us to haul these minerals back up to Haven.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_2a: I was imprisoned here over a thousand years ago for speaking out against my liege lord, sentenced to be here for a lifetime as my punishment.  When the fires overtook the citadel even in my passing I did not find freedom.  My soul is bound to these cursed stones.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_paid: Upkeep paid\! {0} crowns removed from the guild treasury.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.grand_tortoise: A shield empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. The very plates of this colossal carapace shake as the unstable energy within waits to be unleashed.
guildhelp.properties|l.record_console: The Guild Record can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
guild.properties|x.rename_desc2: The renaming item will be consumed.
item.properties|f.icebreaker_armor: Upgraded Frostbreaker Armor further hacked to resist freeze.
conversation.properties|m.npc_onwatch_b: I know they will come back.
item.properties|f.silversix: A mysterious antique with a brilliant silver finish, these handguns are said to have been wielded by "gunslinger priests" during a now forgotten time.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_2a: And speaking of gremlins, we're starting to get an alarming number of reports of gremlins mobilizing in the Clockworks below Haven.  We don't have too many details yet, but given the relations we've had with them so far, our guess is they're preparing for an attack.
item.properties|f.frozen_great_cleaver: A custom made Triglav designed by Biscotti, head chef of the Skylark. Though she swears it's used just for cooking, one can't help but think more than a few monsters have met it at the chopping block as well.
item.properties|f.eternal_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. This orb is prized by the most powerful knights and is used to craft items of extraordinary power.
item.properties|f.token_core: A fragment of strange material found within the core of the Clockworks. Each fragment seems to have an entirely unique composition, like snowflakes. These fragments are highly prized by Spiral HQ as they hope to learn the nature of the core through their study.
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_helm: A finely-made helmet for the more discerning explosives expert. It won't tell you what kind of wine goes best with Nitronome, but it'll certainly keep your head looking good. And in one piece.
mission.properties|r.guardians_of_cradle: I know, Vaelyn. I feel the same way.
item.properties|f.kat_suit: A clawed costume made by Moorcroft tailors. It's perfect for curious knights who are prone to pause for naps after a long night of adventuring.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_7a: No problem, I've got the time.  Let's start from the top.
item.properties|f.almirian_crusader_helm: A helm once worn by the elite royal guard of the kingdom of Almire. Its ivory color was a symbol of Almire's purity, both in the land and in the hearts of its people.
sprites.properties|d.cover: Increases the size and duration of the angelic aura.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r6: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_suit: A demo suit made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_8a: Yes, it seems that these sprites have mastered the ability to focus their powers on skills that protect their knight. Given that and their appearance I've dubbed them 'seraphynx.'
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Then it sounds like we narrowly avoided a horrible catastrophe. If we had opened the Core and unleashed The Swarm all of Cradle might have been destroyed. Perhaps even the universe\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet3_1a: You've restored the power and saved us all, {0}\!  I can't thank you enough, all these recruits owe you their lives. \n\nYou should now try to contact Spiral HQ via your comlink.
auction.properties|e.please_wait: The auction house is busy, please wait a moment and try again.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_g: Have you seen a danger room yet? I hear they are really tough.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2a:
Crimson Order Directives\: 

- It is the DUTY of every Gremlin to repel the metal intruders\! 

- Every Gremlin must work to destroy Haven. Cradle belongs us\! 

- Every Gremlin must remain LOYAL to King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. The Iron Law must be obeyed\!
exchange.properties|m.getenergy_info: Purchase energy with your credit card, PayPal, mobile phone, or various other methods.
conversation.properties|r.rc_bomb_1a: Sounds like a blast\! Maybe I'll buy some from the traveling merchant.
dungeon.properties|m.jigsaw_valley_desc: Appearing to be sky islands ripped apart and put back together again as if it were a puzzle this world can sometimes be confusing to navigate. Unfortunately it seems to also be home to a host of mindless slimes and constructs who do not seem to mind its erratic layout.
mission.properties|r.anniversary_start_3: Though my training never included confectionery combat, I'm in\!
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_5a: Then I now authorize you to take on Arcade Missions.  You can access the Arcade via your Mission interface or approach the gates directly here in the Arcade itself. There is a massive world beneath your feet waiting to be explored.\n\nGood luck to you\!
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl: A beaked mask shrouded in a simple hood. Take on the guise of your feathered friends and celebrate the new year.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Take cover if you get overwhelmed\!
item.properties|f.shard_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in depleted Crimsonite. Depleted or not, this sucker can sling some serious shrapnel.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: That's fine, just talk to me again when you are ready to choose.
dungeon.properties|m.firestorm_citadel_d: All that remains of the once great kingdom of Almire, the Firestorm Citadel houses the legions of lost souls burning in the flames of a forgotten war, endlessly rekindled by the twisted spirit of their former lord.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_3a: One was clearly not enough last time... so now there are two\! TWO\! Brilliant\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_gourmet: Contains various unique costumes and weapons used by battle chefs. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.exp_east_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_blade: A mythical blade that lashes out with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. Those who wield it claim to feel the fiery stare of the beast upon them whenever they close their eyes.
item.properties|f.battle_chef_coat: A coat worn by the knights who work in the Skylark's galley. Not to be trifled with, these chefs are blade masters on and off the battlefield.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_1a: Hello there, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you will be needing a quick lesson in the species of monsters within the Clockworks that inflict piercing damage, yes?
mission.properties|b.great_escape: Recon Knights have collected intel that has revealed the gremlin 'Crimson Order' has begun ordering gremlins to build makeshift prisons within the Clockworks where Spiral Knights are being taken and imprisoned.  It is believed that these orders are coming in direct response to your destruction of the Roarmulus Twins. \n\nFurther data suggests that these makeshift prisons are a temporary solution until a larger facility can be built.  Spiral HQ however, has no intention of these imprisoned knights staying long enough to find out.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_b: Not much equipment has been salvaged from the crash pods.  There's not even enough here for each able-bodied Knight.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: I just heard an explosion in the back of the lab\! \n\nWe'll handle these monsters, {0}.  You go and make sure the Artifact is secure\!  Hurry\!
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_defeated: We shall never fall\! We shall... never...
item.properties|f.furni_pet_chromalisk: A timid chromalisk that seems to have lost its tongue.
guild.properties|e.guild_in_default: Sorry, that guild is in-default. Try again later.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_9b: Thanks\! I'm off to train. [Complete mission]
item.properties|f.spiral_flak_jacket: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_3a: You can always count on me\! \n\nNow then, I'm sure you've got lots to do.  We're going crazy over here trying to make heads or tails over that recon module you discovered outside of the Core.  How the heck could the Alpha Squad have 'entered' the Core?
item.properties|f.kat_claw_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a cut-throat warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2d: Battle sprites gain perks at certain levels that you can equip within the battle sprite interface. Perks provide bonuses to your stats.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r7: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_3: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  This perfect recreation bears the terrible likeness of Seerus himself, serving as a dark memento of Operation Crimson Hammer.
pvp.properties|m.bribe_reward_subject: King Krogmo reward earned in the Coliseum.

chat.properties|m.usage_unmute: Usage\: /{0} player name\nStops blocking messages from the specified player.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_1: Hail\! You must be the brave knight Spiral HQ has sent to deal with these Grinchlins. Mount Krampus is not like other levels so allow me to explain to you how it works.
global.properties|m.disconnected: You have been disconnected from the server.
item.properties|f.grey_feather_mantle: A cloak for renowned Owlite scholars, this feathery frock is filled with the wisdom of the ages... and is super soft\!
item.properties|f.magmatic_fanatic_mask: A mask said to have been worn by fanatics that worshiped a magma god. Its fires will light the path to victory.
item.properties|f.tabard_rose: An aged, embroidered tabard that once belonged to a Knight of the Rose, a sacred order of brave and especially dashing heroes whose numerous adventures are the subject of many folk tales. The Knights of the Rose were said to be peerless fencers, believing that their blades were like the flowers of their name\: a delicate thing of beauty that hides a vicious sting.
guildhelp.properties|m.record_info: The Guild Record logs important recent activity within the guild, such as donations to the Guild Treasury, deposits to and withdrawals from the various Guild Storages, and promotions, additions or departures of guild members. They allow higher-ranked guild members to track who is donating or taking a lot from the guild, and act accordingly.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_2a: Very well {0}, let's get right to it.  It seems the closer monsters get to the Core, the more their unique properties begin to surface.  In most cases this takes the form of their being able to inflict special damage types that require special defenses in order to withstand properly. \n\nIn Tier 2, a monster inflicting a special damage type will always produce a split normal/special damage output.  Thus, normal defense is still a somewhat valid defense choice.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
mission.properties|m.another_trace_1a: Hello {0}, I'm happy to report that my equipment is back up and running\! Now I have some good news and bad news for you.  The good news is\: I've been able to track down the source of that energy signature. Here is the bad news\: the energy source has been pinpointed to a highly dangerous area of the Clockworks that Recon Knights have dubbed the 'Royal Jelly Palace.'
item.properties|f.frozen_pulsar: A highly advanced pulsar that can produce a blizzard-like blast of ice once its rounds mature. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We wouldn't have made it past that artillery without your help\!
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
helptips.properties|m.unlock_gold: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use the Gold Key.
item.properties|f.luck_potion: A syrupy secretion said by some to strengthen serendipity. (Spiral HQ is unable to determine any actual effect.)
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_sight: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Submit your offer to the market. If a seller is found while you are online, you will receive a chat notification.
item.properties|f.token_vanaduke: A seal from the lost kingdom of Almire, proof that the keeper braved the ever-burning abyss known as the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.frenzy_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe shaped the world in its passing\: its frenzy started the mighty winds, its scales became the shadows.

mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r6: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.wild_shell: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. It's tough enough to dull a jelly barb on impact.
pvp.properties|m.cancelled: All pending coliseum games were cancelled. Please sign up again.
conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Oh, haven't seen you around here before\!
uplink.properties|m.shard_bomb_reward:
Attention {0}\!  Some significant changes were recently made to the following bombs\: Crystal Bomb, Sun Shards, Rock Salt Bomb, Radiant Sun Shards and Ionized Salt Bomb.  

While we're confident that you'll enjoy the new way these bombs work, we also want you to know that we take changes like this seriously.  Enclosed is a thank you gift for having invested in one or more of these bombs before the change was made.  For more detailed information, please visit the official Spiral Knights Forums. 

Please accept these rewards and happy bombing\!
mission.properties|b.p_r4_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
craft.properties|m.empty: You have not yet learned any recipes.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: {0}, this is almost certainly a trap and I can't ask you to come with me, but I'm going in there. If there's even a chance that Rulen and the other Alpha Squad members are alive I need to try and find them.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_0: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium perfect for pondering over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore.
social.properties|m.earned_crowns: become the new Crown King, having earned {0} crowns in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_helm: A demo helm made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
item.properties|f.riftlocker: A deadly handgun said to be capable of sundering heavy armor with a single shot. These firearms proved instrumental during the siege of Isora in breaking through the war machines of the Morai.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
item.properties|f.helm_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
guild.properties|m.published: The Guild Hall has been updated\!

item.properties|f.grave_soil: Dreadful dirt dredged from a creepy crypt. It is always a little cold to the touch.
item.properties|f.foiled_frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. Even though it has a pretty foil wrapper, it's still made of cake, and eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r4: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
mission.properties|b.rise_or_fall: Infiltrating the Royal Jelly Palace and taking on the hordes of slimes that serve the great Royal Jelly is not going to be an easy task. Give them a good fight\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_b_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm Bechamel, and I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
item.properties|f.exp_east_5f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.vial_poison: A glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
item.properties|f.master_blast_bomb: An incredibly powerful explosive typically used in mining, now issued somewhat recklessly for use in combat.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_b_: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.

item.properties|f.jack_froster: Usher in a winter wonderland with this nose-nipping, nasty surprise that is perfect for giving your foes a bad case of frostbite.

Speak with him via comlink before taking on any further missions.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r7: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.gh_env_rain_torrent: A environment with almost too much rain.

conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3c: Something of immense power, little one. There is an enormous energy signal coming from the center of the Clockworks, but that is all we know. No one has ever made it to the core. Or at least if anyone has, they have never returned.\n\nThe ones to ask would be the gremlins, for they have likely gone deeper into the Clockworks than any creature. But that might prove difficult as they are quite a disagreeable lot.

item.properties|f.harlequin_suit: A costume for those who juggle, tumble, or have the gift of mischief.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: Your friend list is already full\! You were unable to friend these {0} friends at this time\:\n{1}\n{2}
item.properties|f.clockworks_box: A celebration of all things related to the Clockworks\! Contains costumes and accessories built from the same girders, plates, cogs, and gears that make up the Clockworks deep within the planet of Cradle. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok: You are eligible for this mission.
item.properties|f.plated_sentinel_armor: A suit of armor reinforced with gremlin plating to defend against a range of dangerous elements.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Click here to accept the listed trade, and buy crowns with energy.
item.properties|f.token_candy: A piece of candy made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival.  It can be exchanged in the Haven Town Square for various costume masks.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.nightmare_mane: A coat of coarse fur taken from a Snarbolax.  Each fiber seems to curl and fray as if life is still flowing through it.
item.properties|f.dark_ember: A mote of burning energy salvaged from Lord Vanaduke's throne room. It slowly smolders with a sinister intensity, creating an almost hypnotic trance when gazed upon for any length of time.
item.properties|f.philoso_feather: A large, grey feather plucked from the greatest of the Owlite magicians.
prologue.properties|m.ozlo_arrive: At last. Begin preparations for descent. We must harness this power...
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
You see that shimmery aurora? 

We have no idea what that is\! 

And while it's pretty from here, we're reading intense energy spikes in some regions down below\!
uplink.properties|m.items_expired: You have items that have expired. Items can be repurchased from the Supply Depot.
mission.properties|b.rescues_and_recycli: A 'Deconstruction Zone' is a gremlin work site where gremlins seem to tear apart existing levels and use the components to build new levels. Their ability to rapidly engineer levels and machines is incredible, surpassed only by their hostility to anyone who crosses their path. \n\nRecon Knights have discovered that a squad may have observed their engineering marvels a little too closely as they are now being held captive in one of the deconstruction sites near depth 10.  It is unclear what the gremlins have in store for these knights or if they simply plan on letting them perish along with the rest of the level they are dismantling.
item.properties|f.everfrost: A small patch of ice crystals that never seem to melt, even when exposed to direct heat.
helptips.properties|m.devilish_drudgery: The office minions of the Underworld are a disgruntled lot, attacking any unauthorized personnel on sight.  While not terrible threats on their own, they can become far worse if one of their Pit Bosses gets a hold of them.  Watch out\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_vile: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Vile style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
support.properties|m.sent_mail: Sent mail with subject "{0}" to knight {1}.
helptips.properties|m.test_lobby: Welcome testers\! Before you head off into the Clockworks, feel free to help yourself to some wonderful stuff from the merchant to the left. \nThe embers to the far right will level up weapons once your collect enough of them and proceed to the next floor. \nGood luck, brave knights\!
item.properties|f.spiral_sallet: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.obsidian_crusher: A peculiar bomb made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Despite it being a bomb, some are drawn to holding it and 'solving' it as if it were some kind of puzzle.
item.properties|f.prize_box_nemesis: Contains various unique items representing good and evil. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.antigua: A mysterious relic from a forgotten time. It uses explosive powder to fire its rounds.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: Well, we now know there were massive citadels housing Almire's armed forces and great estates for its noble houses. It must have been quite a sight to see. We assume the rest of the kingdom is still a smoldering ruin somewhere. It is possible that some of it might have survived...though given the anecdotal evidence we think it is unlikely at best.
auction.properties|m.start_recipe: Select a learned recipe to search for the ingredients.
trade.properties|e.cart_removed.n: NOTE\: a stack (of {0}) of {1} was removed from the cart.
projectx.properties|m.mission_gw: Recover the recon module in the Gloaming Wildwoods.
craft.properties|m.moved_treasury: Item moved to your Guild Treasury
projectx.properties|m.infobox_loadout: Loadouts are configurations of equipment that you design\! Here you can save your current configuration for later use or equip an existing loadout.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Herex slipped away\! I lost sight of him as things went black. It felt like a thousand hands were pulling us away. As if something didn't want us to follow.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_pickups: Pickups are items that are slotted into your belt seen at the top of the screen. They cannot leave the Clockworks and will turn to dust as soon as you return to town. Think of them as powerups and bonus items to use as you please.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_6b: Once you've applied all your skill points and achieved a very high level with your sprite, you will begin to select your 'ultimate skills.' Ultimate skills are improved versions of your sprite skills. Each sprite skill has two options for an ultimate skill.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_slice: A hot steamy slice of pie.
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_bra: The path of danger takes you further up this perilous mountain. For now you will pass on the cache of Grinchlin treasures stored here for a chance at an even greater haul further up the mountain. \n\nBe warned\! Should you be overcome by the challenges ahead before reaching the next shelter, you will forfeit all treasures\!
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_1a:
Listen up, Rangers\! Spiral HQ has received a very cryptic distress signal from some completely unknown facility deep within the Clockworks. 

The way I figure, we're about to dive head first into either a perilous rescue mission or a death trap. Either way, your means of resolving the situation resides in your arsenal right now. So get geared up, and get ready for combat. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_2b:
Additionally, HR has requested an updated org chart as soon as possible. It is our understanding that all Pit Boss duties, administrative and otherwise, have been turned over to a 'Maulos of the Eternal Frost,' is that correct? 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
item.properties|f.super_blaster: A supercharged Blaster well-suited to longer expeditions down into the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: That's just it {0}, nothing. We've been monitoring the base below for weeks then it went silent. Quite suddenly. We're not sure what you're going to find down there. Our sensors show no active life forms.
item.properties|f.frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. Since it's made of cake, it eventually falls apart.
logon.properties|m.non_public_server: The game is not currently open to the public.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_3: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 3 star item.
item.properties|f.waste_module: A small receptacle that once collected refuse from a device built to wreak havoc. Now, it just plain reeks.
item.properties|f.furni_floormonitors: These durable monitors will activate when being stood on. It's not really clear who thought this was a good idea.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_3b: Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_7: On very rare occasions I've found jellies that haven't attacked us on sight. I'm removing the barbs off this one now. They're kind of cute when they aren't trying to impale you\!
uplink.properties|m.ironclaw_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we have intercepted gremlin transmissions from this facility that indicate they are building some kind of weapon to destroy Haven\!  It is your mission to infiltrate the facility, destroy this weapon and save Haven from destruction\! 

Known only as 'Project Roarmulus,' it is said to be impenetrable from standard attacks.  You will have to find a way to break whatever armor it is using.  Intel suggests this weapon is located deep within the facility. 

But getting to it won't be easy.  You will find that gremlins have little care for a safe work environment as live rockets seem to be fired every which way at all times.  However you should be able to utilize the 'polarity walls' you will find in testing environments to block the oncoming rockets.  Look for a purple and gold switch to toggle them. 

We've also detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad somewhere in this factory.  Retrieve it if you can\! 

Good luck\!
item.properties|f.grim_repeater: Used only by the most elite of the Spiral Knight rangers, this devilish machine gun earned its name from the incredible speed in which it hands out shadowy tickets to the afterlife.
chat.properties|m.usage_move: Usage\: /{0} x y\nMove to the (x, y) coordinates.
item.properties|f.super_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with potent fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
projectx.properties|m.mission_rjp: Recover the recon module in the Royal Jelly Palace.
item.properties|f.brimstone: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
mission.properties|r.becoming_champion_4: I think you're on to something, Lieutenant.
item.properties|f.punch_gun: Used to blast open damaged drop pods, this emergency rescue tool doubles nicely as a powerful, single shot handgun.
mission.properties|r.cwt_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r7: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_3c: Remember, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r4: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.nameless_hat: A nameless hat worn by a nameless hero of legend.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_1: You... you are not one of the lost. You must be strong to make it to this court. Please, you must help me\!
item.properties|f.vial_freeze_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
guild.properties|i.console_publish: Publish design changes to the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_4a: Heh, don't look now, {0}, but there's a ghost over your shoulder\! Let's hope these sprites haven't invested all their power into good looks. \n\nUse that one to clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_0: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 0 star item.
item.properties|f.bucket_of_flawed_snowb: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of Flawed Snowballs. Unfortunately, they will start to melt when exposed, so you better use them fast\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Welcome to the High Wobbler Lounge\!
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer_mkii: A Toxic Vaporizer modified to disperse noxious agents over a wider range.
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mail: A plated mail said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. It comes augmented with ice plating to conceal your location during arctic expeditions.
logon.properties|m.steam_error: We experienced a problem authenticating with Steam. Please ensure that the Steam client is running and that you are not logged in elsewhere.
mission.properties|o.strength_unity: Defend the Geo Knights from a monstrous assault
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_2: Looks like you know how to handle yourself. That's good, because the final area is just ahead.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_steam_cont: Menu key toggles between mouse mode
item.properties|f.guild_storage: Permanently adds Member Storage, Veteran Storage and Officer Storage options to Guild Command Console. Storages allow guild members of sufficient rank to exchange unbound items with other guild members.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_6a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a CHARGE ATTACK, so make sure to evade monsters while charging\! \n\nFeel free to give it a try.  Just remember to equip it at that arsenal station up ahead.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_3a: We have pinpointed its location to be in the deepest level of a gremlin facility known as the 'Ironclaw Munitions Factory.'  The factory is used for the production of all manners of gremlin weaponry and is highly dangerous, even to the gremlins working there. \n\nYou must prepare yourself for heavy resistance from shock-powered constructs and gremlins.
conversation.properties|m.core_resting_3: I hope those supplies come soon.
item.properties|f.magister_robe: A ceremonial robe worn by learned masters of the arcane arts, who often leave their keys in one of the many inner pockets.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: A dash of Moonstone, a pinch of... H... How did you... Who are you\!? You're not supposed to be here\!
helptips.properties|m.branch_battle_warn: Two paths lie before you. Which one will you take?
item.properties|f.gremlonium: A highly advanced compound created by gremlin engineers to power their most devious machines.  It constantly emits an unsettling hissing sound.
item.properties|f.hunters_lodge_room: A monster hunting lodge curated by the great hunter, Armero. Contains a guild alchemy machine containing monster trophy recipes. Guild alchemy machines use resources from the Guild Treasury and deposit results into the Guild Treasury.
chat.properties|m.usage_complain: Usage\: /{0} player name\nFile a complaint against the specified player.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: We've had a few cases where knights have met non-hostile constructs that they swear behaved like true sentient creatures.  But that is very difficult to believe. Gremlins are brilliant, but brilliant at the kind of direct engineering that simply gets the job done and little else.  Brute force. \n\nArtificial life?  Well, that's something else entirely.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_4a: Lost souls trapped by the Apocrea are bound to the realities they have created. Find the lost souls and free them from the bonds of the Apocrea.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_3a: We thought things were getting pretty predictable, even at the depths you've been exploring.  The Core was in sight.  But now some kind of massive negative energy anomaly has surfaced above the Core, blocking access to it.  Recon Knights have said that all they see near it is fire, endless fire. \n\nWe don't know what it is just yet, but squads near that depth have already gone missing.  This is bad news.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We'll hold the line\!
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_5a: Roger that.  So you've got some missions lined up for me?
item.properties|f.tusk_helm: Modeled after noble beasts known for their strength and fearlessness, this helm strikes such terror and respect in its wearer's enemies that the deeds will be talked about for ages to come.
conversation.properties|m.npc_teaser_kni: This last mission sure was a strange one. We were clearing the way to an elevator when we saw some odd structures off in the distance. We couldn't see any way to reach them though.  I guess we'll just have to keep an eye out for them in the future.  The Clockworks is ever-shifting after all.
mission.properties|o.shadow_knows: Learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage
item.properties|f.confetti_bubbles: Use this item to blow a cloud of bubbles into the air. See how long they last before they pop\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_12a: No problem, I've got the time.  Let's head back to Punch and Vise.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_4: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
help.properties|m.clockworks_1: The Clockworks is your gateway to the planet's Core\! It's filled with a huge variety of worlds and populated with monsters and treasure beyond your imagination. Beware, however\: the deeper you go below the surface, the tougher and smarter your opponents will become\!
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendnoti: Due to continual under-performance, there will be no paid holidays or free coffee in the break room.
mission.properties|b.frostifur_fandango: Spiral HQ is receiving numerous reports of squads being wiped out by a pack of wolvers known as 'the Snowclaw Pack' near depth 10.  These ferocious frostifurs have an icy bite and are very territorial. Due to their relentless attacks, Spiral HQ is requesting an experienced squad infiltrate their den and destroy them to prevent any further casualties. \n\nIt is advised that you prepare yourself with piercing damage and freeze resistant gear before deploying.
item.properties|m.use_harness: Use this item to add the {0} as an available harness for your battle sprites? \n\nOnce installed, all sprites capable of using this harness can select it via your sprite manager. This action cannot be undone.
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige_lock: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Prestige Missions\!
projectx.properties|m.instance_will_shut: You cannot enter this place because it will be refreshed soon.
guild.properties|m.rename_gms_only: Sorry, only Guild Masters may rename a guild.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_1a: Be on your guard here, {0}, whatever the gremlins were up to here has made for a very treacherous environment. \n\nLet's hurry to the sprite cache before any more are lost\!
social.properties|m.unfriended: You are no longer friends with {0}.
conversation.properties|m.fc_greeter_2: May your end be mercifully swift.
chat.properties|m.usage_drain: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nDrains a player (yourself by default) of all mist energy.
item.properties|f.heavy_gear: A weighted gear that previously assisted in the operation of an enormous machine.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_3a: Amazing that after all this time we didn't know the truth. I mean, we've suspected for a while now that this planet was some kind of prison but who could have guessed that this 'Swarm' was just waiting for someone to stumble across the Core and free it?
item.properties|f.personal_color: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's personal color to the specified color.
item.properties|f.ice_axe: A technical climbing tool that can pick apart monsters with precision.
item.properties|f.confetti_equinox: When thrown, this spring confetti bursts with freshly sprouted grass and fragrant flowers. No rain required\!
mission.properties|o.another_trace: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
auction.properties|e.no_preview: Sorry, this item cannot be previewed with your current equipment.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_stri: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
item.properties|f.celestial_ore: An extremely rare metal of great power said to be from the heavens above.  It is often completely wasted on crowns and jewelry for slime royalty.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro3_1a: Glad to see you in one piece as well, Rhendon.  Where are the other survivors?
item.properties|f.wild_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_8a: Take it easy {0}, not all gremlins are cut from the same cloth.  Some disagree with the ways of King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order.  In fact, somewhere down in the Clockworks I'm told there's an entire town full of gremlins who left the Great Colony.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_3a:
Our scans have located an ancient generator below this camp.  It should be sending power to the surface, but something seems to be diverting it. 

We need you to go investigate the ancient generator and divert power back to the surface.  But you'll need to be ready- it's completely uncharted territory and teeming with monsters. 

Rhendon said he wanted to meet up with you before you take on this mission.  Why don't you see him first?
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r9: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_suit: An upgraded Skelly Suit infused with the elemental essence of fear. It comes standard with matching pants that cannot be scared off.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_4a: Hey, it looks like one of the sprites has taken a liking to you\! Well, let's not let that extra power go to waste, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. You use your new friend to help clear the rest of the area of hostiles.
monster.properties|m.fired_3: Ahh, I'm gonna have to fire you. OK?
item.properties|f.winter_grave: A tremendously powerful hand cannon whose moniker should come as no surprise to anyone who happens to be viewing it from the wrong end. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.prize_box_plunge: Contains various unique costumes and items to celebrate the warm days of summer.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.grinchlin_snowball: Handcrafted by the grouchy Grinchlins of Mount Krampus, these repugnant projectiles are sure to put a damper on any Winterfestivities.
item.properties|f.daring_rigadoon: A savage skewer that will slow even the most salubrious of foes to a crawl.
mission.properties|b.shocking_sentient_s:
Recon Knights have uncovered a secret weapons facility that according to the intel we have available, could belong to a high ranking gremlin of The Crimson Order.  It is heavily fortified by a small army of electrified constructs who have no doubt been programmed to defend the facility at all costs. 

While it is unclear if this weapons stash actually belongs to a gremlin of The Crimson Order, it is no less worth infiltrating and neutralizing the weapons stash. 

It is advised that you prepare yourself with elemental damage and shock resistant gear before deploying.
mission.properties|b.minerals_rock: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is responsible for researching the strange minerals that Knights have begun mining from within the Clockworks.  He believes that they may hold the answer to gaining entry into the Core and retrieving the energy needed to restore the Skylark. \n\nMeet with him in the Haven Arcade and gain an understanding of how you can help his research as well as harness the true power of the Haven Arcade\!
item.properties|f.justifier_jacket: A finely-made suit for danger-seeking gunslingers who would much rather be quick than dead.
uplink.properties|m.gift_received: Please accept this token of friendship.
item.properties|f.swimsuit_wrap: A spiral issue sarong draped over a one piece suit intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
item.properties|f.furni_library_bookstac: A loose pile of miscellaneous texts, ranging from cookbooks to eldritch codexes scribbled in unintelligible script.
item.properties|f.armor_front: An accessory that can be attached to the front of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.draped_armor: A stylish suit of armor that adds a touch of class to battle.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_5: It is time you entered the Hall of Heroes once more.  Having been fully Star Certified and successfully completed so many missions that have ensured the survival of the Spiral Knights on Cradle, Spiral HQ is preparing you for the high rank of Vanguard.
projectx.properties|m.reach_terminal_1: Delve into the Clockworks and find your way to the first Terminal.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_1: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation.\n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Apologies for not appearing in person. I'm hidden away in a safe place. I knew I'd never make it there in time when I noticed your signal. Luckily I was able to pull some strings and find you an exit.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It'll restrict your peripheral vision a bit, but it's virtually impregnable.
sprites.properties|d.ray_of_light: Fires a concentrated beam of light that damages anything passing through it.
mission.properties|b.p_boost_test_t1: Start the mission and help us test.
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige: Prestige Missions are bonus missions offered to you daily. Completing Prestige Missions earns you prestige.
item.properties|f.beast_scale: A relatively intact scale recovered from a Clockworks creature.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_2a: I'm just another soul hiding from the gaze of the Apocrea. But I refuse to give up. Until they find me I will do anything I can to save another soul from my fate.
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of extremely low temperature material at an increased rate.
mission.properties|b.darkest_depths: Having defeated the Roarmulus Twins and recovered the Alpha Squad recon module, it's time to check in with Intel Agent Kora to get a report on the analysis of the module and information about your new access to some of the deepest depths of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.deadly_shard_bomb: A large chunk of Crimsonite primed with a potent explosive. No more depleted Crimsonite here\: this bomb's made with the good stuff\! Or the bad stuff, if you happen to be the target.
social.properties|m.friend_party_booted: You have been banned from {0}'s party.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_pier: Hi there {0}, I'm Walkon, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high piercing damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the piercing attacks of slimes and beasts. \n\nOne of the best parts about choosing piercing defense is that the armor is often made of soft, squishy jelly materials.  You could just about fall asleep in it\!
item.properties|f.guild_members_250: Allows your guild to recruit up to 250 members\!
item.properties|m.use_recipe:
Use this item to add the {0} to your Known Recipes list? 

Items can be created at Alchemy Stations.
(You may view your learned recipes at any time by pressing <{1}>.)
item.properties|f.mega_tundrus: An upgraded tundrus that takes no prisoners, except when it does and then the prison is made of ice. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_4_acc: Free 6 Lost Sprites? I can do that\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_5bfbda: Complete a Tier 2 expedition without having to revive.
item.properties|m.prize_box_rose_regalia: Rose Regalia Returns Again Prize Box
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_1:
The Hall of Heroes is where knights go to receive their Star Certification allowing them to access deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Each certification ensures a knight meets the star level required to deal with challenges in the upcoming missions. 

The Hall of Heroes also allows knights the opportunity to speak to veteran knights and discover their loadouts, even offering the opportunity to purchase recipes for these loadouts. 

Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification in order to obtain access to missions within deeper levels of the Clockworks.
uplink.properties|m.retgift: The attached Spark of Life is a gift, sent from the Skylark straight to you\! Please use it with our compliments.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.raiders_sword: A runed sword that will reduce your foe to cold cuts.
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_prompt: Invite party members to follow you\:
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_9a: Yes I know. Anyway I also understand that some of the sprite transport crates were empty again. Something is not right... \n\nNow then, secure that last cache of sprites before whatever is stealing sprites finds it\!
mission.properties|o.whipping_mishandlin: Deliver the supplies to the research team within the fiendish city of Sol' Fork
mission.properties|b.p_r9_weap_4: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors. mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve. As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_1a:
Nothing like a death-defying romp through a haunted necropolis to really get the blood pumping, eh Rangers? 

The necropolis originates from Almire, fallen kingdom of some crazy lord something-something, population\: innumerable legions of Undead.  Apparently these less-than-living residents are guarding something that Spiral HQ would like to acquire. 

Our job is to recover a special book, a piece of a much larger collection of works that may give us more insight into the nature of this cursed kingdom.  So grab your helmets, and your best zombie-basher- I'm not expecting a warm reception. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!

mission.properties|b.weight_of_darkness:
It is speculated that all fiends within the Clockworks crossed over from a dimension known as the Underworld.  While how they crossed over and what their motives are on Cradle is unclear, data collected from fiendish cities seems to indicate that they are now stranded on Cradle, much like us. 

The undead on the other hand remain a mystery.  Why spirits return to the material realm is unknown, though it is clear that many of the spirits within the Clockworks have come from other worlds.  Given how hostile these creatures can be, the only way to obtain useful data is through direct interactions, like combat. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you collect combat data for the powerful fiend and undead monsters in Tier 3 of the Clockworks in order to better understand the nature of these creatures. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with shadow resistant gear with elemental and piercing damage weapons\!

shop.properties|m.cart_recipe_adjusted: You will only need one of these recipes\!
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Quite the scarab nest we've stirred up this time eh, {0}? Reminds me of the time we engaged the Morai siege fleets over Isora. That was quite an all or nothing gamble. Doesn't surprise me in the least that we're the only thing standing between us and utter annihilation again.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_3a: Exactly, and they're worse now.  And the same goes for the undead.  You'll find that howlitzers become particularly bothersome with their enhanced firing and homing capabilities. \n\nLastly, prepare for fiend and undead monsters to potentially deal pure shadow damage.  As always, choose the right gear for the job should you want to live long enough to hear from me again.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r6: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.

I've felt it since we first set foot on this world; invisible eyes watching our every move, shapes that form just out of view... something greater than gremlins calls this world home.

It is our understanding however that the king is never seen by common gremlins, but instead his orders are delivered and carried out by his Crimson Order, a fearful and zealous band of gremlins who alone share audience with the great king.
item.properties|f.nameless_poncho: A nameless poncho worn by a nameless hero of legend.

'They continue to advance and thwart our schemes\!  How could they have discovered Project R?  Why was there no advance warning of the attack?' 

'Herex and his minions were supposed to be spying on them but they have all vanished like cowards.'

support.properties|m.subheader_step209:
Sometimes we make a mistake when trading with players. This happens to all of us.

But Game Masters can't know what the agreement with the trade was. One player could claim this wasn't what was agreed on, while the other could claim it was. And we can't just blindly pick a side. So we have to rely on players double checking what they're trading before they click to confirm.

So if you just made a trade you didn't really mean to, then I'm afraid Game Masters won't be able to assist you. Instead you'll want to talk to the other player and see if the player is nice enough to reverse the trade.

Also remember never to trade anything away "as a loan" unless you are OK with this player not returning the item. Game Masters won't be able to recover it for you.

dungeon.properties|m.vip_tos:
This C.U.B.E. Club Membership Agreement constitutes a binding legal document between the undersigned (the "knight"), Golden Casino Holdings LLC (the "Casino"), and the entire slime community ("slimes").

 I. General Terms and Conditions
  1. Membership in the C.U.B.E. Club is for personal use only and can not be transferred to other knights, Devilites, or other Clockwork creatures.
  2. Selling access to your ability to spin is prohibited.
  3. Keep your arms and legs inside the Casino at all times.
  4. Please do not drop items into the core.
 II. Description of Benefits
  1. Benefits are varied and may be changed at any time.
  2. Lounge access is not guaranteed and limited by availability.
  3. Buffalo Wings are not included.
  4. All disputes will be arbitrated by the Casino floor manager and all decisions are final.
 III. Winnings, Payments, and Fees
  1. Winnings may be paid in Golden Slime Coins at the discretion of the Casino floor manager.
  2. No additional fees are collected at this time.
 IV. Promotional Awards
  1. Sale promotions\: Reduced prices for members, if any, will be displayed plainly in the shop interface.
  2. The Gift Shop reserves the right to modify, alter, discontinue or terminate these promotions at any time for any reason whatsoever without notice to the end users. No whiners.
 V. Restrictions and Conditions of Use
  1. As a condition of your use of the club services, you agree not to use club facilities or interfaces for any purpose that is unlawful or prohibited by the terms, conditions, and notices included in this Membership Agreement or any relevant Licence Agreement, or anything generally regarded as uncouth by the slimes.
  2. The Spiral Knights Terms of Service supersedes these terms where applicable.
  3. The knight agrees to all terms and conditions enumerated here, and those not enumerated here. The slimes may add new conditions at any time that require complete retroactive compliance.
 VI. Termination of Account
  1. The Casino has the right to terminate your membership for violating any terms or conditions, precise or vague, enumerated herein or generated at the time of infraction. You've been warned.
 VII. Disclaimer of Warranty; Limitation of Liability
  1. Your use of the Casino is at your sole risk. You click it, you bought it.
  2. The Casino nor the general slime community shall not be liable in contract, tort, negligence or otherwise for any loss or damage whatsoever arising from or in any way connected with your use of the Casino.
 VIII. General
  1. This Membership Agreement is governed by the laws of Haven and the laws of Cradle. You hereby irrevocably consent to submit to the jurisdictions of the Courts of Cradle and Haven.
  2. This agreement was written by a few slimes with little grasp of legal language beyond what they saw when watching A Few Good Men. Thus, any parts that don't make sense are usually blamed on the other guy. Any good parts left over are still good. They don't go bad just because we screwed up on the other badder parts. There's a word for that concept and the fact that we don't know it is one of the bad parts.

conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_2: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings.\n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_5: I've been talking with Spiral HQ about it now for some time and they're prepared to investigate it further.  Though I don't think I'll be changing their mind about trying to open the Core any time soon.  That's still priority number one for now. \n\nAll I can say is be careful out there, {0}.  I think this world has more surprises in store for us than we know.

It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.

While normally not the concern of a Chief Biotech, I specifically requested the opportunity to inform you about the dangers that lie ahead for you in Tier 3 of the Clockworks. The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the elemental attacks of constructs and gremlins. \n\nElemental resistant armor and shields are adapted from Owlite technology.  Though the Owlites themselves no longer exist, their amazing elemental mastery lives on in this gear.
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_2a: I understand my upcoming missions will have me facing mostly beast and slime monsters.

helptips.properties|m.tg_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those retrodes weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft1:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into the depths of a moldering sewer where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!

item.properties|f.blighted_bone: A peculiar patella that's seen better days, after having seen a few better knights.

conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_2a: Thanks\! I'm off to explore now.

guild.properties|i.officer_storage: Community item storage for officers and above.
