The fetishes were carried into battle by Kat warriors and are said to bring good luck despite the ill fate of the Kat Tribe itself.
social.properties|m.join_guild: Join your guildmate {0} at depth {1} in the {2} Gate\!
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A scaled-down model of the Royal Jelly. He'd probably be flattered by it if he hadn't already been flattened.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: Thank you, Morlin. I will do my best to raise this sprite well.
item.properties|f.swift_flourish: An upgraded Flourish for knights who make a point of dispatching opponents with a bit of flair.
item.properties|f.quicksilver_mail: A fine set of mail made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
item.properties|f.razor_ribbon: Remember\: when handling Grinchlin giftboxes, always wear your plate mail gauntlets.
item.properties|f.fiery_pepperbox: When you've been attacked by a swarm of Ice Cubes, all Knights agree\: happiness is a Fiery Pepperbox.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_3: In any case it would seem that this new 'recipe' caused the cakes to turn into horrible monsters that have overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks.  I'd like to have my kitchen back, so could you please assist me in destroying these horrible Creep Cakes?
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_4a:
Perhaps Geo-Science has no place in this conversation?  You are correct, {0}. 

Moving on, shadow damage is produced by fiend and undead family monsters.  Additionally, fiend monsters tend to be weak to piercing damage and the undead to elemental damage. Keep this in mind. 

Now then, is there anything else you require?
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_presti: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\!
dungeon.properties|m.treasure_vault_desc: Treasure Troves contain vast quantities of treasure blocks, yours for the taking should you have the proper means to get past the numerous locked doors. Some of them are heavily guarded, so always be on the look out for hidden traps and monsters.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dangerous: Contains various unique items used by Desna's elite Recon Rangers. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.tailed_helm: An expressive helm proving that two plumes are always better than one.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_3a: Sadly, even with our link to the Spirit Mother restored we can only do so much to save this place. Yet, even as one path closes another might open. It is the nature of this shifting world.  Good fortune, star-borne.
conversation.properties|m.rc_soil_1a: I'm collecting geological samples for Spiral HQ. So far my tests are identifying hundreds of unique soil samples within every inch of the ground below our feet. This can't be possible, I must have miscalculated...
chat.properties|m.usage_respond: Usage\: /{0} message\nResponds to the player who sent the last /tell.
support.properties|m.subheader_step201: Spamming is when someone repeats text or sends long lines of random characters with the sole purpose of annoying others because it fills up the chat screen so they can't chat normally.\n\nIt's important that you only file a spam complaint when the spamming was so bad that you couldn't chat with others. For example a couple of lines of a few characters, while not necessary perhaps, is not bad enough to file a complaint for. Also if the repeated lines are far between (like 10 seconds between) then it also won't prevent people from chatting, even if it may be annoying that they're just writing nonsense.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_helm: A hardened helm made to protect intrepid explorers while they explore the unknown.
conversation.properties|m.mon_pocket_1:
Greetings\! I'm Nonna with the Emberlight Adoption Agency\! 

We at the Emberlight Adoption Agency collect baby monsters that have managed to become lost in the darkest depths of the Clockworks.  No longer having a home or any means of caring for themselves, we try to find these needy monsters a good home\! 

By purchasing one of these adorable 'monster pockets' you can carry around a baby monster of your very own\! 

The Emberlight Adoption Agency will visit Haven from time to time, and you never know what we will have to offer\!
logon.properties|m.network_error: Either there is a temporary network outage or the server is not yet fully operational. Please wait a moment before reconnecting.
item.properties|f.round_helm: A svelte helm that's just waiting to be accessorized.
item.properties|f.slime_trinket: A curious circle coated with calcified slime.
mission.properties|o.true_champion: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.clockblocker: A mechanical shield with machined wheels, pinions, and gears that mesh with exacting tolerances, making it a precision timekeeping instrument.
mission.properties|r.reporting_duty_2a: If we could somehow harness that power...
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm_b: Having restored power to the Rescue Camp and established contact with Spiral HQ, it's time you attempted to cross the chasm north of the Rescue Camp and reach Haven where the rest of the Spiral Knights have taken refuge. \n\nIn order to cross the chasm you will need to take an elevator down into the Clockworks and find another to bring you up on the other side.  There's no telling what dangers lurk in the dark depths below so Rhendon will be accompanying you on your journey.
helptips.properties|m.atg_button: Standing on a BUTTON can open locked doors.
sprites.properties|d.bristle: Increases the number of quills fired and their sticking duration.
item.properties|f.static_capacitor: An explosive device of Gremlin origin designed to produce a deadly field of electricity.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_5: It will take a little time to get all of our equipment fully working again.
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_message: You were awarded Krogmo Coins for participation in {0}\!
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of luminite.
item.properties|f.firetail_mail: A scorching simian mail typically worn by commanders in combat. It will ward off many wounds made to the wearer.
item.properties|f.lump_coal: A Grinchlin gift for those who have been naughty or nice.  Grinchlins are equal opportunity party poopers.
logon.properties|m.temp_banned: This account has been temporarily suspended.
item.properties|f.pith_helm: A simple but effective helm favored by Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.venom_fiend_mask: A mask said to be crafted in the visage of a venomous fiend.  It is infused with a vile essence that is sure to frighten your foes.
helptips.properties|m.atg_healthcap: Use HEALTH CAPSULES from your quickslot bar to heal.
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: User is in a restricted country.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_devot: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...This world has seen few greater tragedies than the fall of the great Kingdom of Almire.  Once a vibrant, beautiful realm of lush forests and sweeping plains... 

...neighboring kingdoms declared war... 

...seeking the power needed to turn the tide, Lord Vanaduke of Almire fled into the mountains...
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
item.properties|f.vog_cub_cap: A thick hat that smells heavily of barbecue. Barbecued what? Don't ask.
mission.properties|o.elemental_my_dear: Learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_1: Hi there, I'm Biscotti, Head Chef of the Skylark\!  We've got a little situation on our hands that may or may not involve sentient, monstrous cakes that may or may not have completely overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks... \n\nAnyway, I've worked it out with the Strangers to provide rewards for turning in slices of cake that prove you've helped eradicate these horrible monsters that may or may not exist.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Victory is ours\!
chat.properties|m.usage_party: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all party members.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.cosmic_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
helptips.properties|m.confirm_energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to confirm spending energy.
item.properties|f.shadow_steel: An extraordinary metal imbued with the creeping darkness of the Underworld.
item.properties|f.freeze_raider_tunic: Raid fast, raid warm in this furry coat.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_fire: A fiery theme that's sure to keep your Guild Hall warm and toasty... or sweaty.
item.properties|d.recover_accessory: Recovers an accessory from an item, returning the accessory to your arsenal.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: Careful in there.  Looks like they had a big one with them...
helptips.properties|m.need_key_grim_gate: The Grim Gate requires a Fiendish ID Card to activate.
item.properties|f.ronin_gasa: A lost straw cap once belonging to a lordless swordmaster.
sprites.properties|d.dark_veil: Increases the defensive power of the shadow cloak.
chat.properties|m.usage_mute: Usage\: /{0} player name\nBlocks messages from the specified player.
item.properties|f.celestial_shield: Cradle's equinox inspired the dual nature of this specialist shield, which protects against the dazzling light of day and the chill of night in equal measure.
item.properties|f.cracked_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. Though cracked, it still glows ever so faintly.
helptips.properties|m.plan_o_attack: The monitor shows readouts coming from a prototype of a massive war machine labeled "Project R".
mission.properties|b.ancient_generator: The Rescue Camp has no power and with it, no means of defending itself from the onslaught of monsters that attack it in the night.  With the sun setting fast, it's up to you to enter the dark depths below the camp and locate an Ancient Generator. \n\nIf you can restore power to the camp, the Spiral Knights can power their turrets and create a defensive perimeter. Once secure, it may be possible to reconnect with Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_3a: At 4 and 5 star level, gear offers the best protection you can find and weapons pack the biggest punch.  If you want to stay alive where you're heading, you need to start building an arsenal of 4 and 5 star gear. \n\nAnd remember- as items reach 5 star they typically can branch even more than before.  Your combat options are about to really open up.  Plan your arsenal with care.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4a: Your sprite will evolve as you level it up. At certain key levels your sprite will require an Evo Catalyst be fed to it in order to level up further. Once fed, your sprite will physically change its appearance\! \n\nIt will be interesting to see how these strange, new forms of battle sprites evolve in time.
mission.properties|b.silent_legion:
Guardian Knight Arkus was one of the finest warriors serving the Spiral Knights until some time shortly after the crash.  As one of the first to search for the Alpha Squad, Arkus's own squad perished in a grisly battle with a horde of dust zombies.  Since then, Arkus has blamed himself for their loss, saying that he betrayed his Guardian's Oath to protect his squad. 

Arkus now journeys into the Clockworks alone, never risking the loss of another squad and we believe, somehow trying to find the squad he once lost.  As these expeditions began to appear self-destructive, Spiral HQ issued him a direct order to cease. 

Arkus ignored these orders and has gone deep into the Clockworks and not returned.  Not wanting to lose the last member of his squad, Spiral HQ is asking you to pursue him to his last known whereabouts, some kind of mysterious statuary at depth 26.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_1a: {0}, I'm glad you called, I have something big here for you.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: I don't know if I feel better or worse after finding out what happened to everyone in the Core. Poor Grantz...Parma...Euclid...Rulen...
pvp.properties|m.autotarget_off: Krogmo has turned off autotarget for this match only.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_coat: This well-made hide coat is self-heating, protecting the wearer from freeze attacks. The secret? A tiny pinch of blaze pepper.
item.properties|m.no_activate: You must wait for other upgrades to expire before activating.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: My rescue team was ambushed by some giant mechanical horror. We didn't stand a chance. I'm glad you got here when you did, otherwise I don't know if we would have made it.
item.properties|f.firotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of napalm at an increased rate.
help.properties|m.monster_fiend: Deal SHADOW - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against SHADOW
exchange.properties|m.billing_duplicate: Your credit card is starting to smoke from overuse. Please let it rest for just a few minutes and try again.
item.properties|f.bolted_blade: An upgraded Proto Sword reinforced with bronze bolts scavenged from the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.the_gauntlet: One final battle stands in your way before reaching the Firestorm Citadel. Thought to be devised by Lord Vanaduke himself, this unrelenting gauntlet is teeming with all manners of dark creatures and culminates in a nightmarish battle arena that must be conquered in order to gain access to the gates of the Firestorm Citadel. \n\nThis mission will take everything you've got and requires a full arsenal of powerful weapons and gear.  If Lord Vanaduke is testing you, give him the fight that he's asking for and show him what a true Champion can do\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_7a: Discoveries on the planet grow stranger by the day. Now our sprites are adapting the form of some kind of phantom.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_1: Head into the room ahead with the party pad. You're almost done.
item.properties|f.celestial_orbitgun: This planetoid projecting pistol conjures images of the birth of stellar systems. Opponents caught within its blazing maelstrom are sure to see the light.
item.properties|f.heavy_demo_suit: Reinforced armor intended for explosive experts.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_card: Please check that card number is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_4a: The Apocrea bend reality, twisting the environment they invade into a trap. In these traps they stalk any life, harvesting their souls for some unimaginable purpose.
exchange.properties|m.credit_card_toolti: Purchases the selected amount of Energy right now with your credit card.
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_helm: A helm for those who want to bring down some beasts.
item.properties|f.graviton_vortex: A Graviton Bomb fortified with potentially dangerous amounts of shadow steel. Its blast should draw your foes toward it... if it doesn't rip the entire universe in two, that is.
item.properties|f.cosmic_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
item.properties|f.blaster: A versatile handgun issued to Spiral Knights who have proven themselves in the field.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_3a: Wow, {0}, you seem to have a way with battle sprites\! Let's not waste any time. Clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t2: Help us test this new content.
helptips.properties|m.party_button: The party button will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
item.properties|f.wild_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
conversation.properties|r.vise_seerus: Sure, Vise.  I'll see what I can do.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_6a: Here we have an alchemy station that you'll no doubt become very familiar with as you upgrade your arsenal.  But no need to worry about that too much as Spiral HQ is likely to give you a mission later on that explains everything. \n\nWell, that about does it for your first tour.  Do you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
helptips.properties|m.tg3_welcome: Welcome back to the Training Grounds. This last level will teach you the last few important things you will need to know as an explorer of the Clockworks. Head up the ramp and let's begin\!
chat.properties|m.usage_invite: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nInvites a player into your current party.
item.properties|f.scale_helm: A helm crafted from the scales of a slithering beast.
item.properties|f.spark_plug: A small, mechanical component that really gets a construct's motor running.
item.properties|f.gilded_griffin: A beautiful pistol named after a great, noble beast. Its golden frame was believed to provide light within the impenetrable darkness of the Underworld.
chat.properties|m.no_last_teller: Nobody has sent you a /tell to respond to.
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_2a: I've prepared for facing the Firestorm Citadel, you can count on me.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: I have faith in you, {0}.  I just know that you will be among the select Knights skillful enough to reach the Core and with any luck, get us off this planet.
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_desc: A level where travelers can safely return to town, or journey further into the depths of the Clockworks.
guild.properties|i.buy_environments: Change the environment for the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.dim_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within flickers like a tiny candle.
conversation.properties|m.vise_seerus:
Hello there lad\!  
Taking on ol' Seerus aye?  Careful now, he's not right in the head. Proper imbalanced that one.  

He and I go way back, but not in any way worth remembering.  Should your mission prove successful, see if you can bring me back a little souvenir.  I'll make ya something nice for your troubles.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3a: Feeding your sprite materials is the fastest way to level it up. Talk to Biscotti here in the Lab for more information on sprite feeding.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_1a: How do sprites level up and evolve?
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: The Sparkcaster Deluxe is almost stable, I promise. I need a little more time, Warmaster.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.volcanic_demo_suit: Highly protective gear for the cutting-edge demolition man. The internal cooling system makes you feel a little like you've been cryogenically frozen.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3b: While the path is dangerous, you will not be traveling very deep, so the monsters you encounter should be easy enough to handle. However, scouts have been reporting increased gremlin activity in the area since we set up camp, so watch out.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_torin: A fading inscription reads\: Here lies Torin, knight of Almire.
exchange.properties|m.coinex_offer_paid: You have received {0} energy as the result of an energy trade.
helptips.properties|m.bramble: Some areas are overgrown with bramble that will hurt you if you run through it\!
item.properties|f.spell_book: An old dictionary that seems to have quite a few spells within it.
chat.properties|m.usage_team: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message privately to your team.
item.properties|f.spiral_plate_mail: Heavyweight armor made of iron plates that can withstand a great deal of standard attacks.
mission.properties|b.rotting_metropolis: It would seem as though those slime generators have been around much longer than we thought, seeping their vile toxins into any levels that should be near them. \n\nA modern city, much like those that the devilites inhabit seems to be overrun with these toxins, and was probably left behind by both the devilites and gremlins as a result.  Now a legion of slime and undead creatures haunt the place, festering in the poisons that linger in the air.  A squad that was attempting to pass through the city has gone missing.  Given that the very air is toxic, it is urgent that an experienced team enter this city and rescue the squad.  There is little hope left for them otherwise.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  I hear you've recently arrived in Haven from across the great chasm.  While you were out there, did you encounter any of our battle sprites?
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_shield: A kite shield haunted by a benevolent ghost. It should help you put up a spirited defense against shadow.
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: (Tell Feron about the Rescue Camp, Razwog and the Artifact)
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus: Glorp, glorp, glorp\!  Merry Winterfest\!\n\nGet into the holiday spirit with snowball fights in wintery Lockdown levels and turn in those Krogmo Coins for splendid Santy Hats\!
item.properties|f.no_door: Removes any door presently installed and leaves the room open for anyone to enter.
item.properties|f.torchstone: A small rock that smolders constantly. Gremlins patrolling the Cooling Chambers occasionally use them as a hand warmer.
item.properties|f.fuel_canister: A small receptacle once used to hold fuel for a complex machine.
projectx.properties|m.please_relaunch: Please quit and re-run the game to check your new options.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_2a: Perfect\!  I'll keep the artifact and burn you to the ground all the same\! \n\nHahaha\!
item.properties|f.static_diskgun: A shockingly powerful handgun that creates a storm of electrified disks. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_shad: Hello {0}, I am Sylvin, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high shadow damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the shadow attacks of fiends and the undead. \n\nShadow defense can be harnessed from the shadows themselves.  The armor and shields I specialize in are derived from the very fiendish and undead creatures that seek to use the power of the shadows against you.  Plus, it looks incredibly scary and cool.
dungeon.properties|m.training_grounds_de: This derelict portion of the Clockworks has been modified to train new recruits in the fine art of not dying when they have the rest of the world to explore.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Seekers, the skillful grenadiers of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.clockworks_armor: Forged from girders, gears, scrap, and pipes found in the Clockworks. Walk the catwalk... wearing the catwalk\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_7: Once you're ready to transmute the item, click 'Transmute' and hold your breath\!
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skescape: A piece of Spiral technology used to escape disabled starships. They're very cramped inside.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Do you have any more questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
item.properties|f.plated_shade_helm: A helm of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: Don't know how long before our forcefield gives out...
item.properties|f.seraphic_helm: A beautiful mail coif that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_shock: A high-energy theme that fills the air with electricty. Side effects include constant static shock from touching absolutely anything.
conversation.properties|m.atg_guard: Greetings\!  Beyond this door you will find the advanced training hall. As a Spiral Knight, you are free to use it to practice your skills and learn more about the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_3a: You'll figure it out as you go along, trust me.  Take this Brandish for example.  It has within it the potential to become three different types of elemental blades that deliver powerful status conditions, or even a shadowy sword of darkness\! \n\nYou just need to discover the recipes that require a brandish and get crafting to find out. Here, you can even keep this Brandish I've got.  Transmute it into something amazing.
uplink.properties|m.rank_mig: Spiral Knights has recently undergone a change that has added new mission rewards to missions you have already completed. They are attached.\n\nEnjoy\!
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: Account does not exist or is temporarily unavailable.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_4a: Good luck, {0}.  Be sure to thoroughly prepare before attempting this mission.
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r9: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
item.properties|f.divine_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
item.properties|f.silver_coil: An electromagnetic mechanism made of an extremely conductive metal.
item.properties|f.deadly_crystal_bomb: A large chunk of Moonstone and Valestone alloy primed with a potent explosive. Studies have shown that this bomb can be used to reduce a zombie's craving for brains by up to 100% by blowing them to pieces.
item.properties|f.spiral_soaker: A deadly squirt gun sure to soak even the driest of foes.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_4a: I'll make it.  Just you wait.
sprites.properties|d.virulent_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit there is a chance to trigger a poisonous explosion.
helptips.properties|m.event_locked_modul:
Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.

However, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\! 

This room offers a bonus chance at the treasures within.
chat.properties|m.usage_help: Available commands\: {0}\nEnter\: "/{1} <command>" to learn more about each command.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Hissers, the unstable bombers of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.garden_snipes_room: A peaceful garden home to a number of Snipes. Perfect for both relaxing and spinning wildly in place.
item.properties|f.dread_captain_cutlass: A custom curving cutter kept keen on careless castaways.
conversation.properties|r.mission_crimso: Thanks for the intel. I'll check it out.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_2a: Missions range from dangerous combat engagements to talking to certain people, such as myself.  By completing missions, you'll earn progress towards new ranks, which will in turn give you access to increasingly powerful gear.  Greta informed me that you'll be tackling our power supply problem in the Ancient Generator?
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_gre: A tall torch filled with ghastly green fire.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_crystal: Crystal blocks are like breakable blocks except that if destroyed, they also destroy the crystal blocks of the same color connected to them.
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: Thanks for "rescuing" me but I feel fine.
item.properties|f.neutralizer: You'd be surprised at the number of practical applications to be had from two substances that, when combined, leave quite literally nothing in their wake. Neutralizer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_3: The perfected version of the shadowy bomb that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.  It is thought to have been reserved for use against other members of the Crimson Order.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_button: If a door won't open, search under blocks for a hidden floor button to open it.
projectx.properties|m.cs_instructions: Please select the control layout you would like to use.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_5a: I haven't given up the search for Euclid, Parma, Grantz and Rulen.  They're out there somewhere and I will find them, even if it means entering the Core myself.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Prestige Missions are entirely optional and cannot be repeated in a single day.  And don't forget to keep an eye out for special missions that offer large prestige rewards\!
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_07: Uh-oh\! The truck have started to move\!
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak: A simple feathered cloak. Adorn yourself in down and get down for the new year.
item.properties|f.prize_box_disguise: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Disguise style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.

mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r6: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'

conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3b: There are different theories. Some say the gremlins that you see working on it now are responsible. But that seems too great even for their seemingly infinite work force. Even with the means to do so, how did they "start?" Where did they find the power?
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: One of our squads made it inside but got cut off, save them if you can\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_7a: It's unclear, {0}. Given Rhendon's report, I'd say they learned something from the old arcane tomes you discovered near these sprites. Fascinating that they appear to have adapted their combat abilities because of this.

monster.properties|m.vanaduke_1: What's this? More wolves hungry for the blood of Almire? Our great kingdom shall never fall to the likes of beasts\!
guildhelp.properties|m.treasury_info: The Guild Treasury contains all the items and crowns collectively owned by the guild. In order to be placed within a Guild Hall, furniture must first be added to the Treasury. The costs of new rooms, items from the Birdsong Emporium and weekly upkeep are also paid from the Treasury, so guild members will have to be certain to keep the Guild Treasury full of crowns\!\n WARNING\: Anything added to the Guild Treasury can never be removed by any member of the guild, including the guild master. Vaelyn has never given up her search and is now attempting to put together an on-site Core research team in order to better understand the very place where the Alpha Squad's trail is thought to end.

Lastly please instruct your division to cease using our mail system to inform other Undercorp divisions that 'The freezing corruption of lord Maulos is inescapable.'  Improper use of the mail system hurts productivity.

Morgral'm

As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.

mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

guildhelp.properties|m.emporium_info:
The Birdsong Emporium allows high-ranking guild members to purchase items for the guild using funds from the Guild Treasury. These items include various Guild Hall furniture items and upgrades. Purchased items go directly into the Guild Treasury, and thus cannot ever be removed from the guild.
 Furniture comes in a variety of types and sizes and is used to decorate your Guild Hall's rooms and halls to make them feel more like home. Some furniture even has special effects when activated\! Any furniture currently in your Guild Treasury can be placed into the Guild Hall using Design Mode.
 The Birdsong Emporium is also where you purchase Guild Upgrades that enhance your guild's capabilities, such as by increasing its maximum member count.
 As a Guild Hall's size increases by adding expansions, the selection of items available in the Birdsong Emporium's catalog also increases. Be sure to check back often to see what's available\!
