mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: What are you doing\!? My cakes\! My pretty cakes\! Unacceptable\!
item.properties|f.valiant_visor: A lightweight visor for scouting and skirmishing, often highly accessorized.
item.properties|f.enamorock: A strange stone that makes you have warm and fuzzy feelings inside just by holding it.
conversation.properties|m.hav_guardian_1: Welcome to Haven, {0}, we've been expecting you.
item.properties|f.skelly_mask: A spooky mask good for both scaring children and protecting from shadow attacks.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_123: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surge: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Surge style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: What little we've recovered from the Core Terminal has every Geo Knight, Biotech, and Tech Knight absolutely stumped. We'll be analyzing these findings for quite some time.
item.properties|f.plated_sentinel_helm: A helm reinforced with gremlin plating to defend against a range of dangerous elements.
social.properties|e.maxfriends_inviter: Sorry, {0} already has the maximum number of friends.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_2: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Though it very much resembles the original, it is still missing pieces.
item.properties|f.furni_counter_spiral: A modular piece of counter that can be combined in infinite ways. Always be careful when working with infinity.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_2: So here's the thing... I was tasked with baking cakes for the big Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration and I may have got in a tiny bit over my head when I said I could bake a couple million of them in just a week. \n\nTo speed up the process I may have used a teensy weensy bit of pure, unrefined, dark matter instead of baking powder...
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2b: I don't understand, the distress signal came from here... but that can't be, right?
item.properties|f.the_bitter_end: A shield carried by all members of the Recon Rangers. Its name is a reminder to all Rangers as to precisely when they are permitted to drop it in battle.
item.properties|f.recover_accessory: Accessory tickets can be redeemed at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
help.properties|m.tier_3_monster: Monsters can utilize attacks that deal pure special damage (PIERCING, ELEMENTAL or SHADOW). Equip yourself appropriately\!
chat.properties|m.no_tell_mute: You can't tell to a person that you've ignored.
item.properties|f.sacred_sentinel_armor: A raidiant defending doubleweave for insulating against erratic elements.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the price, in crowns, that you are willing to pay.
guildhelp.properties|u.design_wiki: A full list of available furniture can be found on our official wiki. | URL | http\://wiki.spiralknights.com/Furniture
help.properties|m.monster_1: Monsters in the Clockworks are divided into six distinct families, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Be sure to equip yourself accordingly before venturing below ground\!
item.properties|f.hazardous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
item.properties|f.prize_box_chess: Contains one randomly-chosen Chess Mini liftable statue furniture.  No key is required to open.
design.properties|i.place_room: Install a room at this location.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_1a: Clearly I really should know all about this, tell me more\!
item.properties|f.vitasuit_plus: High-tech mail that provides the wearer with myriad medical boons, including bonus health, glossier hair, and fresher breath.
mission.properties|o.alchemy_mastery: Discover the potential of master level alchemy
chat.properties|m.usage_broadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone online.
item.properties|f.mug_misery: A cursed drinking utility that can only be used by a truly wicked soul. Those that possess it are said to bring grave misfortune to those around them.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
sprites.properties|d.wide_embrace: Increases the area of effect of heart attack.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Not all, but most of them are believed to have been directly manufactured from gremlin design, yes.  We think that most were originally engineered during the building of the Clockworks.  Some remain under gremlin control, others have gone rogue and the rest have become something else entirely.
chat.properties|m.usage_fallback: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to fall back.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
item.properties|f.voltech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of electricity at an increased rate.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Trojan \nThese massive leviathans are invulnerable from the front. Hit the crystal on their back to bring them to their knees.
monster.properties|m.fired_2: Your productivity is down .03% this week. You're fired.
chat.properties|m.usage_game: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to everyone in the game.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_pur: A tall torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_3: I'll continue to explore the Clockworks and collect the minerals needed for your research.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro4_1a: I'll scout ahead then\! Be careful, Rhendon.
guild.properties|i.buy_expansions: Purchase more space for the Guild Hall. Increases upkeep.
item.properties|f.scythe: An old farmers tool, retired for the season, this blade also excels at reaping your foes.
item.properties|f.gm_armor: Impressive indigo armor that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
item.properties|f.voltaic_tempest: This high-tech, high voltage device is not recommended for use in water, around water, or near people thinking about water. To be safe, you probably shouldn't look at it, either.
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_helm: A sturdy Cobalt Helm with upgraded internal systems and external reinforcement.
item.properties|f.ecto_drop: A bit of ectoplasm meticulously collected from an unwilling undead volunteer. It's an unpleasant shade of green.
dungeon.properties|m.starlight_cradle_de: Beneath a moonlit sky azure islands drift in a sea of stars. These islands are home to creatures that are more than happy to creep upon those that succumb to this world's endless lullaby.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_4a: We need you to discover what happened to them.  You'll start by seeking out known locations of their recon modules and collecting them for analysis.  I will be in charge of locating their general whereabouts and directing you toward them.  It's your job to go into the wild to retrieve them. \n\nAdditionally, I'll provide you with a quick background of each of the four members of the Alpha Squad\: Squad Leader Euclid, Squad Guardian Grantz, Squad Recon Parma, and Squad Technician Rulen.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: But I come to warn you\!  Crimson Order not stop with Roarmulus Project.  Crimson Order desperate to destroy all enemies. Tall ones, little ones, and outcasts.  All enemies to Crimson Order\!
item.properties|f.mighty_defender: An advanced Spiral Knight shield, reinforced for battle and beautifully embossed for the stories afterward.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_mail: A suit of artifact armor that is said to have been worn by titans. Though it offers amazing protection, its incredible weight makes it cumbersome to wear.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Hi there, {0}\! As Head Chef of the Skylark I've been assigned to oversee the nutritional development of our new sprite companions. They seem to have really diversified themselves down there in the Clockworks. It will be interesting to see how they develop. \n\nDo you have any questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3c: Most of them will attack you on sight, but there are some; outcasts from the colony, that have taken refuge in the towns below the surface. Theirs is a hard life, hated by their own kind and no longer in a world they call home.
guild.properties|m.motd_changed: {0} changed the message of the day\: {1}
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
conversation.properties|r.tut_warden_1a: Great, I'm looking forward to a hot meal.
item.properties|f.imperial_tricorne: A magnificent hat worn by those who aspire to build empires on which the sun will never set.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I am here to listen. Let it all out.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_6: Fire Crystals are somewhat unstable, the amount needed for a successful forge varies. \nAdditionally, we've discovered that adding more Fire Crystals results in chances at special bonuses that will be applied to the item\! \n
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_1_1a: I was told I am to receive Star Certification here?
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_gre: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits a green glow with a gentle hiss.
mission.properties|r.reporting_duty_1a: Sure sounds important, tell me how it all works.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_2a: Yes, in order to access deeper stratums of the Clockworks you must first receive Star Certification.  This entails speaking to me when you have equipped armor, a helmet, a shield and at least one weapon of a specific star level or greater.
guild.properties|log.door_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
chat.properties|m.usage_shout: Usage\: /{0} message\nShouts a message to a wider area.
item.properties|f.miracloth: A marvelous bolt of sublimely supple fabric.
mission.properties|b.p_fast_advancement: Use this Test Server exclusive mission to quickly power up your weapons and gear.  Each level of this mission is exactly the same, allowing you to change your equipped weapons and gear at each depth. \n\nOnly a few heat embers are needed to max out any item\! 'Return to Haven' before you reach the end so you can come back to this mission.
support.properties|m.option_210_1: If you're sure the other options didn't cover your complaint, and you're sure the player broke our Terms of Service, then please enter a short explanation here for what your complaint is.
item.properties|f.stellar_sentinel_helm: This helm was was once worn by Isoran starfarers of eons long passed that stood watch over extrasolar operations. With this equipped, you feel like you understand the machinations of the universe.
item.properties|f.stoic_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_3a: I'm all ears Kora, tell me about energy\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_1a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more and under such auspicious terms.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze_super: An ornate glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
guild.properties|m.too_many_members: Your guild cannot have more than {0} members. \nUpgrades to your member limit may be purchased in the shop in your guild hall.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite: (This appears to be the Owlite tome that the spookats said describe the place above the Core.  Its pages are very worn and only portions of the original text can be deciphered.)
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_4: When you interact with an Alchemy Station you will open the alchemy interface where you can see your known recipe...
item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_2: A flawed fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.
uplink.properties|m.autoprune: Note\: Mail is automatically deleted 30 days after sent date.
helptips.properties|m.atg_shield: Surrounded? Use your SHIELD to push back attacking enemies.
global.properties|m.peer_shutting_down: The requested peer is shutting down.
exchange.properties|m.coins_cancelled_po: You have been refunded {0} crowns for your cancelled energy offer.
helptips.properties|m.unlock: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Silver Key.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_quit: Are you sure you want to quit?
item.properties|f.veteran_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Veteran rank and up.
item.properties|f.fiery_vaporizer_mkii: A Fiery Vaporizer modified to disperse combustible material over a wider range.
item.properties|f.winterfest_tree: A spectacularly spiraling tree decorated in the spirit of Winterfest. Folklore states that Impostoclaus leaves presents for those that have been nice throughout the year while those that have been naughty find their presents filled with jelly. Some believe this is the only reason that chromalisks are hostile.
projectx.properties|i.cull_transients: Prevents display of some off-screen graphics effects\npossibly speeding up graphical performance, but may\ncause some effects not to appear.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant_reward: Usage\: /{0} <account name> <reward id> [reward param string]\nGrants a reward to the identified account.
item.properties|f.cosmic_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
item.properties|f.green_shard: A shard of Valestone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_5: Good luck to you. And try to stay warm\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_d: Between the warmth of the fire and the safety of the defensive turrets, I think I'll sleep well tonight.
item.properties|f.pierce_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire piercing rounds.
item.properties|f.simple_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. While unrefined, this orb can be used to craft more powerful items.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: Always good to see another Spiral Knight\!
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
item.properties|f.zee_core: A pungent mass pulled from a slimy assailant. Its aroma is an excellent remedy for insomnia, as well as nighttime sniffling and sneezing.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_ritua: 'With great practice and tender care, with an eternal heart and mind so pure\: sharpen the stone, sturdy the chain, welcome the night, drink the Cup of Kings.'
projectx.properties|d.achievement_ebcd68: Defeat the Royal Jelly squatting in the Royal Jelly Palace.
helptips.properties|m.terminal_1: Welcome traveler, this is a Clockwork Terminal. Take a moment to rest and change your gear. \n\nUse the elevator either to return to Haven or delve into a more dangerous stratum of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.swiftstrike_buckler: A small, easy to use shield that enables the user to perform fast attacks.
item.properties|f.love_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a love puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might want a kiss\!
sprites.properties|d.high_heat: Increases the offensive power of the flame barrier.
item.properties|f.holiday_hat_snow: A holiday hat so festive, snow falls above it\!  Fortunately for the wearer, the hat itself is super warm.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_5a: {0}, something big is going down at the Lab.  You need to get here immediately\!
projectx.properties|m.confirm_delete: To confirm deletion of this character, type "{0}" below.
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_shadow_clo: Creates an explosive disruption field around you when shadow cloak is interrupted that has a chance to stun targets.
item.properties|f.pummel_gun: A Punch Gun properly modified for combat use. The recoil from its powerful charge attack is notorious amongst recruits.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_2a: What would you like to know?
mission.properties|b.scarlet_fortress: Entirely different from the Aurora Isles, recon knights have discovered another geo-globe containing the remains of a seemingly ancient castle.  Dubbed the 'Scarlet Fortress,' this crumbling castle is also the home to a horde of restless spirits. Proceed with caution when exploring its twisting passages.
item.properties|f.shock_barrier: Surrounds you with orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3b: Each battle sprite will learn three skills that you can use in combat. Skills are learned automatically at certain levels as the sprite levels up. \n\nCombat skills become stronger with skill points.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_3: Aye, it appears I'm no longer fit for this fight.  It's up to you now, {0}. You alone possess the strength to face Seerus and bring him to justice.  Many knights have lost their lives here today.  Honor their spirits by finishing the job\!
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_1a: "The Nine see all, hear all. Obey the Iron Law."
item.properties|f.grand_tortofist: A handgun empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. While wielding it you can feel the berserk energy within eager to be unleashed.
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven_b: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_4a: As a Defender, you can now undertake missions in Tier 3 of the Clockworks.  These are the deepest and most dangerous depths of the Clockworks, delve any further and you will reach the Core itself. \n\nPerhaps if you make it that far, you can locate the Alpha Squad, I just don't know.
item.properties|f.primal_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The plates used in its construction provide some protection against the elements of fire and freeze.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_9a: Here we have... me\!  I'm the Accessorizor, adding accessories to your gear so long as you have a ticket.  With accessories, you can make your gear really stand out in a crowd, I highly suggest giving it a try.  You'll soon become the apple of every one's eye\!
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Oh no\! Tell her the cakes will be ready. Erm, I'm just a little behind.  I'll make you a deal\: I'll give you some extra cake if we can keep this between you and me. I don't want to be kicked out of the party.
mission.properties|o.crimson_chaos: Investigate a Crimson Order base that has suddenly gone silent
conversation.properties|m.af_hungry: I could sure go for a snack\!
item.properties|f.ticktocktop: Enough complications to make your head spin.
item.properties|f.vial_stun_super: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
sprites.properties|d.seraphic_aura: Party members within the protective aura gain increased shield regen.
prologue.properties|m.helmsman_arrive: Captain Ozlo, the Skylark has identified the source of the powerful energy signature.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_11a: Right, down to business.  We've located an Alpha Squad recon module in an area of the Clockworks known as the 'Gloaming Wildwoods.'  However, this particular zone is home to a horrible creature known as 'the Snarbolax.' \n\nThe Snarbolax has made fast work of Squires like yourself, but I know you can handle it, {0}. But you're going to need to prepare.  I've issued you a series of missions that will allow you to assemble a loadout fit for taking on this terrible beast and reclaiming that recon module\!
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_1a: Welcome to our advanced training hall. Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like some directions?
uplink.properties|m.mission_rewards: Attention {0}\!  Our data shows that a recent mission you successfully completed, {1}, did not issue rewards to you following the end of the mission.  These rewards are enclosed in this mail. \n\nPlease accept these rewards, gear up and continue your adventure\!
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_1: Spiral Knights are capable of unleashing the hidden powers locked from within the weapons they use called "charge attacks." Charge attacks are more powerful than a standard attack and can often produce special effects.
monster.properties|m.overtime_3: Glad I caught you. I'm looking for someone to really rise to the challenge this weekend...
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.prismatic_frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. It uses a strange prismatic frosting developed in Biscotti's test kitchen that prevents it from ever spoiling.  Please don't eat it.
item.properties|f.savage_tortofist: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it you can feel the primal energy of a rampaging wolver pack within waiting to be unleashed.
logon.properties|m.steam_invalid_ticket: Invalid Steam UserID Ticket. Try logging out, quitting Steam completely and trying again.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_shield: A small, spooky shield to safeguard you from shadow.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Greetings {0}, and congratulations on becoming a Squire\!  Your performance has caught the attention of Spiral HQ and they have given you authorization to now take on Prestige Missions. \n\nPrestige Missions are select missions offered to you daily that offer prestige as rewards for completion.  Sometimes these missions require supplying Spiral HQ or other Knights with items and other times they will have you exploring the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.power_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.furni_shelf_manor_book: An unassuming shelf filled unworldly tomes of unspeakable power.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_3a: Our recent intel from Recon Knights suggest that gremlins are planning something big.  We believe they are developing some kind of weapon they're calling 'Project R' that will be targeting Haven itself.  Spiral HQ and the Strangers themselves are requesting that you investigate the matter given your performance in the Royal Jelly Palace.
conversation.properties|m.fountain_1: Greetings and welcome to Haven\!  If you head north, you'll reach the Arcade where you can get up to speed on the details of our mission.  If you head west, you'll reach the Bazaar, where the Strangers have a selection of gear and weapons for sale.  Be sure to check their stock daily, it changes\!
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of dark matter.
item.properties|f.freeze_raider_helm: A fur lined helmet, sure to keep you warm on a winter raid.
item.properties|f.guild_members_150: Allows your guild to recruit up to 150 members\!
item.properties|f.firebreak_armor: Upgraded Emberbreak armor further hacked to resist fire.
exchange.properties|m.offertosell_toolti: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100.
item.properties|f.stranger_hat: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  It seems to have small, colorful feathers hiding in every seam.
item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_3: A perfect fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.
mission.properties|o.explosive_plot: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_cam: Those Grinchlins are tricky and unpredictable. I'd recommend bringing a variety of gear just to be prepared for whatever they might throw at you.
pvp.properties|m.super_brawl-info: Super Brawl is a fantastic, free-for-all fight for up to eight knights\! You will be awarded points for defeating other contestants and lose points for being defeated. The contestant with the most points at the end of the five-minute round wins\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_d: This is my first expedition into the Clockworks\!
item.properties|f.potocrowns: An unlucky thing for your foes to find, it explodes in a painful blow.
item.properties|f.exp_west_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_7a: Cradle is growing more mysterious by the day.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_345: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.moonstone_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.rename_guild: Allows you to choose a new name for your guild. This item can only be used by a Guildmaster and is destroyed once used.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We've broken through their defenses.  Now they're cornered\!
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: (For the first time since you've known him, Hahn is silent. He seems to be contemplating your findings very carefully.)
item.properties|f.charged_quicksilver_ma: An enhanced set of Quicksilver Mail that'll get you all charged up for battle.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_5: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 5 star item.
projectx.properties|m.region_mismatched: Note\: this place is hosted in "{1}", there was a temporary problem finding a place in "{0}".
mission.properties|o.alien_ooze: Rescue the field research team from a lichen colony
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_cam: It's a hazardous climb, {0}. Watch your footing and beware those Grinchlin traps\!
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_remin: Once you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. Once we are all reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.\n\nPlease hurry\!
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_3: Rhendon is waiting for you in an abandoned gremlin chemical plant where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites. Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles. You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
item.properties|f.wizard_box: Contains one of various unique weird and wonderful wizardly items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
dungeon.properties|m.rc_bomb_training_de: Just beyond the perimeter of the Rescue Camp is a field of ruined equipment and overrun defenses.  The surviving knights abandoned this area after a series of deadly attacks during the night.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies protection and restoration. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat\: ray of light creates a steady beam of holy light, heart attack increases the chance of hearts dropping from monsters, and angelic aura creates a light shield that protects its knight and party members within. \n\nThe seraphynx is best suited for knights who wish to protect their party and provide them aid.
mission.properties|o.the_gauntlet: Battle your way to the Firestorm Citadel through a bulwark of monstrous might
item.properties|f.sudaruska: A rugged weapon for the knight who is more than willing to trade style and panache for ridiculous amounts of blunt force trauma.
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_helm: A helm imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
item.properties|f.jelly_shield: A strange looking shield created from jelly matter. Like many slime monsters themselves, it provides the user with exceptional defense against piercing damage.
mission.properties|r.cwt_mintut_1: Minerals? You mean these colorful rocky pillars?
conversation.properties|m.hunter_3a: Indeed\! Monster trophies will require a great deal of materials, so it is only reasonable that a group effort is required. \n\nLastly, some of the materials you will need can only be acquired by spending boss tokens with Brinks in the Haven Bazaar. They act as proof of your valor in defeating such fearsome creatures\!
sprites.properties|d.iron_heart_attack: Targets destroyed while enchanted may also drop defense orbs.
item.properties|f.cautery_sword: A sword adapted from a medical tool, its heated blade reduces tissue damage. It is very formidable at destroying monsters of the slime family.
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll help any way I can, Pembrooke.
item.properties|f.helm_front: An accessory that can be attached to the front of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|b.in_cold_blood: Something has really riled up the chromalisks in the levels below the town of Emberlight.  Spiral HQ sent a squad in to investigate and they quickly fell off the radar. Now they've sent out a distress signal stating that they're cornered at depth 21 by chromalisks of all varieties. \n\nBiotechs speculate these chromalisks are agitated due to their proximity to the Core. Others believe it may be mating season.  Regardless of the reason, the squad needs saving before they meet their end to the likes of these lizards\!
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: You... I... What was that? Did you say something?
mission.properties|o.p_r6_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.frenzy_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a wind-swept mountain.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Reinforcements from Spiral HQ at last\!
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_return_des: A level where travelers can safely return to the town above.
item.properties|f.skolver_cap: A finely-made hide cap that's the perfect crown for any king of the wild frontier.
conversation.properties|m.fc_greeter_1: Heed my warning traveler; this is a dangerous and terrible realm. You stand before the gates of the Firestorm Citadel, the former heart of the great kingdom of Almire, now a dominion twisted by fire and malice.\n\nLeave this place if you want to live.
projectx.properties|e.rank_limit: This item may not be equipped until you've reached rank {0}.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: The best current market price. A response of ??? indicates that there is no current market offer for the amount you've entered.
helptips.properties|m.atg_gblocks: Hitting a GHOST BLOCK can remove a whole field of blocks - including unbreakable blocks\!
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_1: Well met, {0}\! Glad to see Spiral HQ sent us some reinforcements, and not a moment too soon\! Our backs are against the wall and we need your help\!
item.properties|f.token_snarbolax: A long, razor-sharp tooth plucked from the mouth of a Snarbolax; a memento representing a Knight's triumph over the monstrous stalker of the Gloaming Wildwoods.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_2: Our advance has ground to a halt because of that artillery on the walls pinning us down.  Earlier, we staged a diversion to allow a small squad of knights to break through the front to silence that artillery...but they seem to have failed.  Now they're trapped in there, and we're stuck out here\! \n\nI need you to break through the front lines, get inside the artillery control center, and find a way to take out those cannons for good\!  Meanwhile, I'll get the troops reorganized so we can follow up your assault.  Good luck in there, soldier\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_11: (He appears to be staring very intently at the corner.)
item.properties|f.wild_buster: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the fierce energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_end: Great job\! With another successful run through the Training Grounds you should be getting the hang of things by now. It won't be long before you are exploring the depths of the Clockworks on your own.
item.properties|f.voltaic_radical_suit: A suit said to be replicated by a sentient mechaknight. It comes with a synthetic skinsuit that pulses with an electric energy.
support.properties|m.option_202_0: We realize this player may be ruining some of the fun you're having, but the best way to deal with such annoying players is to ignore them so you don't have to bother with them again. Click here to ignore {0} instead.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_2a: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
mission.properties|b.p_fiend_test_t1: Please refer to the posted instructions when testing this content.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A simple display commemorating a knight's recruitment into the Spiral Order.
mission.properties|m.elig_not: You are not eligible for this mission.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: An unarmed, half-scale reproduction of the end product of Project Roarmulus. Without armaments, it's really only good for cheering up a dreary room.
item.properties|f.electron_charge: A small electro-explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a crippling vortex of electricity.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_2: I am a sprite, a force of nature summoned to this realm to extinguish the unnatural fire that is consuming it. But Vanaduke discovered and imprisoned us. I managed to escape, but the other sprites remain in his custody.\n\nNow none may proceed beyond the court as columns of shadow fire block all exits. Shadow fire can only be extinguished with the water that flows from these spirit wells. The water is the purest found in all of nature, flowing directly from the springs within the realm of the Spirit Mother herself.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_ro: A festive new years snipe that will explore its surroundings.
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello, Lieutenant.  How can I help you?
guild.properties|m.confirm_promote: Are you sure you want to promote {0} to {1}?
dungeon.properties|m.revive_member: Revive using a Spark of Life ({0})
item.properties|f.binding_essence: A strange, vile reagent thought to be harnessed by the Apocrea to build their structures. Once it gets on your skin it seems to never wash off. No, it must, you simply need to scrub harder. Harder, yes...
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: If only there were some way to open up those gates\!
logon.properties|m.banned: That account has been banned. You are no longer allowed to play Spiral Knights.\nYou were banned due to\: {0}
item.properties|m.use_change_height: Use your {0} to change your height?
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_4a: There's one last thing- it seems you won't be the first knight to have entered the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.  We've detected another Alpha Squad recon module somewhere within the factory.  Please attempt to recover it.  I hope that analysis proves that Euclid's squad made it out of there alive...
mission.properties|m.true_champion_1a: {0}\! Oh, {0} you made it\! Haha\! \n\nI am so happy you came out of there alive\!  I was worried sick about you\!
guild.properties|m.not_in_guild: Sorry, you're not presently in a guild.
mission.properties|b.alone_in_dark: The spookats of Moorcroft Manor have another valuable piece of intel for us that is worth investigating.  They say that a lost soul of the former Kingdom of Almire resides in a soldier's graveyard near the Firestorm Citadel.  This soul is willing to provide us with the information on the nature of the citadel as well as how we can get through it and reach the Core. \n\nReaching him will not be easy given his location.  Graveyards are terrible places, especially at this depth.  It is highly advisable that you move through the graveyard as quickly as possible in your search for this lost soul.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_end: Seems like you have a good grasp on the basics. I think you're ready to join the rest of the recruits in the Sparrow Gate. There you will learn how to work as a party. There's a lot of recruits out there depending on you now. Great job\!
helptips.properties|m.loading9: If you become stunned you will move and attack slower than usual. This can leave you as a prime target for larger monsters that you can normally outrun, so watch out\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
chat.properties|m.user_disconnected: That user has been disconnected for {0}.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: So all constructs in the Clockworks were created by the gremlins?
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_2a: Yes, it has become something of a second home for us hasn't it?  Almost like we belong here, it's strange.
conversation.properties|r.rc_greet2_2a: How can I help channel power to the camp?
helptips.properties|m.tut_goldkey: Pick up and use on Gold Doors\!
item.properties|f.dangerous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Recon Rangers. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever_alt: Switches can open doors. Try throwing a pot or shooting this one with your handgun\!
item.properties|f.sacred_pathfinder_helm: A reinforced helm that is sure to stop the sharpest of foes.
helptips.properties|m.atg_cblocks: Hit a CRYSTAL BLOCK to destroy other crystal blocks of the same color.
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_3a:
Spiral HQ has authorized you to visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification. 

The Hall of Heroes is a place where Knights rising in the ranks like yourself will visit to both learn about and acquire new recipes for gear as well as receive certification to go deeper into the Clockworks. 

Your first visit requires only that you wear all 2 Star gear, which you already have so it should be a piece of cake\!
pvp.properties|m.coins_earned.n: You have earned {0} Krogmo Coins playing {1}\!
dungeon.properties|m.ancient_generator_d: Beneath the Rescue Camp is a massive energy source, capable of powering the elevator to Haven if only it could be harnessed.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_3: All Shadow Lairs are locked with a strange mechanism that can only be unlocked with a 'Shadow Key.'  Shadow Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot. \n\nOnce a party member uses a Shadow Key, the party is locked and cannot be changed, so choose your party members wisely\!
item.properties|f.pollinator_plate: Styled after the unsung heroes of the hive. Fashionable, functional, and a little fuzzy.
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They came from the darkness. There was no time to react.
dungeon.properties|m.confirm_boot: Are you sure you want to remove {0} from the party?
chat.properties|m.usage_recharge: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCharges a player (yourself by default) up with mist energy.
item.properties|f.blackhawk: A shadow-aligned handgun of incredible power, it's said to contain the soul of a knight who was only two days from retirement.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_2a: Ah, that's right, you're a new recruit.  Most knights encounter their first sprite on the battlefield.  Chances are you've not had the opportunity to see one yet. \n\nAllow me to explain...
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_2: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a more stable version that blew up gremlin test subjects far fewer times than the prototype.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze: A glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
item.properties|f.kat_eye_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a crack shot warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
shop.properties|m.cart_vitapod_adjusted: You may only equip one best vitapod\: cart adjusted.
item.properties|f.prize_box_winterfest: Contains various unique Winterfest prizes. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_4: I mean that the Core isn't a big battery that runs this world, but rather it and the whole of this world is a massive prison designed to keep something from ever leaving. \n\nThink about our geo-scans of Cradle just before the crash- they show it as being composed of hundreds of massive slabs of other worlds, almost like plates of armor.  Then you have the Clockworks, the most unnatural thing I've ever seen.  An entire world whose sole purpose seems to be stopping anyone from ever reaching its Core.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3d4b16: Amass an Arsenal that includes a 5 star helmet, armor, shield, gun and bomb.
item.properties|f.spiral_demo_suit: Sturdy armor designed for use by explosively-inclined knights.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_3a: Soon you will find yourself in one of the traps set by the Apocrea. If you are powerful enough to escape then you may be able to save some of the other lost souls along the way.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: There isn't much time. I can't reach you from here and you need to make it out. Warn headquarters. Warn Haven\! If the Core isn't kept sealed The Swarm will escape and it will continue to consume everything and everyone.
item.properties|f.breach_blaster: An enhanced pierce blaster designed to break through hostile armor.
item.properties|f.winter_pullover: A not-so-stylish sweater for the snowy season. The perfect pullover to embarass your family and guildmates alike.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_12b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
exchange.properties|m.coins_remainder_po: You have been refunded {0} crowns as the result of an energy trade taking place for less than your posted buy price.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frenzy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.confetti_dark_harvest_: Celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival by launching a sizeable gourd into the air. What comes next is up to the Punkin King...
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_2:
It was those blasted cloaking fiends\! They came from the shadows and staged an ambush.   When I get my hands on Seerus I'll... Argh\! 

(Feron slumps to one side, clearly more injured than he initially appeared) 

Blast, I'm having trouble gripping my sword...
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_hood: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Roarmulus Twins \nThese giant gun puppies showcase impenetrable armor and high powered munitions. Their skin is so thick they are only vulnerable to fraternal firepower.
item.properties|f.faust: A powerful, cursed sword forged in the Underworld. Its powerful charge attacks can sometimes curse the one that wields it.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_arcade: Select a gate to view the gate map and enable options for starting your expedition\!
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against freeze, at the expense of fire and shock resistance.
item.properties|f.arctic_acolyte_mantle: A plated robe said to be worn by wandering arctic acolytes. 'we saw them heading straight towards the mountains, off into the interior of the vast frozen continent, but why?'
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.shako: A ceremonial cap worn by knights during highly prestigious occasions.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_3: Attack a mineral column in order to break it down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Greetings, {0}\! Now that I've had sufficient time to research the battle sprites you rescued I can give you a proper evaluation of each. \n\nDespite their well, strange appearance, we have concluded that these 'new' battle sprites are not only suitable for combat but may have even further enhanced capabilities as a result of their transformation.
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_1a: Too late again\! I have already collected the power I need to use the Artifact and nothing you can do now will stop what I have set in motion.
mission.properties|b.crimson_chaos: Spiral HQ has been monitoring several known Crimson Order bases in hopes of intercepting one of their elusive high-ranking members. Recon knights assigned to watch one of those bases report that it has suddenly gone silent and have requested backup before investigating it further. Head down to their location and investigate the base for any signs of what has happened.
guild.properties|m.no_open_halls: There are no open Guild Halls
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_astation: Arsenal Stations allow you to swap your gear and access loadouts outside of safe havens like Terminals and Subtowns\!
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_3a: Now only death and smoke hang in the air, even from these great heights. And the fires; the unnatural fires that seem to burn eternal, the fires that turn even the most pious men into horrible nightmares, I know that these fires shall soon take me as well. \n\nI will not give my former Lord the gift of my own life.  It is not his to take, to twist. This shall be my final order.  This shall be my Justice.
item.properties|f.obsidian_carbine: A deadly gun made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. With every shot fired, a faint whisper is heard, believed to be the true name of its target.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Undercorp employees get a free mug with every visit.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard. It will be a rough road ahead of us but I am confident that we are up to the challenge.
item.properties|f.true_love_locket: A small, heart-shaped locket with an inscription reading "Processing thoughts of you always, Love Puppy"
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_5: Each item will require a specific type of Fire Crystal.  Fire Crystals can be obtained from the Supply Depot, earned by completing certain missions, and found in treasure blocks in the Clockworks\!
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A breezy blue plant inside a cheerful pot.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frosty: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Frosty style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
chat.properties|m.usage_guild: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all guild members.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_4a: We need you to explore the surrounding levels and collect any intel you can.  You can start with an Owlite castle of some sort that recently surfaced near this anomaly.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_helm: Made from the scales of rare Clockworks beasts, this sturdy helmet is resistant to even the highest of temperatures.
item.properties|f.chess_room: An empty room with an 8x8 chess board in the corner and a row for spectators.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A miniature model of one of the Roarmulus Twins. It is mercifully inactive.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_2a: Who doesn't right?  Let's head over to Punch and Vise's workshop.
sprites.properties|d.caustic_quills: Fires a series of quills that stick to targets and inflict poison. For each hit a quilled target receives, they lose one quill and take additional damage.
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: Our guards were overwhelmed.  We never stood a chance.
item.properties|f.magic_hood: An enchanting hood for knights who dabble in divination and contemplate conjuring.
conversation.properties|r.mon_pocket_1: Show me who is up for adoption\!
monster.properties|m.overtime_1: Go ahead and come in on Sunday, too...
chat.properties|m.unknown_command: Unknown command {0}. Use /help to list commands.
item.properties|f.token_page: A crumbling page torn from a long-forgotten grimoire of the Moorcroft Manor archives. The indecipherable language written upon it glows faintly in the dark as if containing power in its very words.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_1a: Welcome to the Haven Bazaar\!  It's a pleasure to meet you {0}, my name is Bechamel. Since I work here in the Bazaar, Spiral HQ has asked me to show new arrivals around this fabulous epicenter of commerce and let them know everything it has to offer. \n\nSo let's go on a quick tour shall we?  Try and keep up, I walk fast.
support.properties|m.option_201_1: If you're convinced this qualified as spamming then click OK to file the complaint.
projectx.properties|e.name_vulgar: Sorry, that name contains an inappropriate word. Please try another.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
helptips.properties|m.loading18: Check out wiki.spiralknights.com, where brave adventurers document what they discover in the depths of the Clockworks\!
chat.properties|m.usage_helpme: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you need help\!
mission.properties|b.from_below: A squad of Desna's Recon Rangers is trapped somewhere in the depths of the Clockworks by a mysterious force. Judging from the severity of the reports and panicked communications from the squad, Spiral HQ believes that only someone with your experience is capable of handling whatever deadly force has trapped them.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_11a: Well, that about covers the basics of the Bazaar.  It's a really fantastic place to find just about anything you need. \n\nDo you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
item.properties|f.ship_wheel: How could this possibly make a good shield? Where did it even come from? Careful matey, ask those questions and you could be made to walk the plank.
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_1a: Thank you Kora, I'm just as glad as anyone to have Haven safe once more.
item.properties|f.snarbolax_coat: A shadowy suit made from the hide of a sinister Snarbolax.  Even looking at it too closely is dangerous.
item.properties|f.flaming_pulsar: A pulsar modified with a scorching energy that burns greater over time. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|m.unlock_box_prompt: A Silver Key is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
dungeon.properties|m.aurora_isles_desc: From atop mysterious floating islands, sun bleached ruins crumble under a false sky. Though the green grass and cool air feels real enough, the ever present grinding of the machine just below the surface is a constant reminder of this world's mechanical skeleton.
uplink.properties|e.already_received: That knight cannot receive another gift of this type.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_mail: A firm set of mucilaginous mail crafted from the remains of particularly antagonistic jellies.
item.properties|f.wrench_wand: A heavy hand tool favored by Gremlins. It's good for both tightening bolts and cracking skulls.
sprites.properties|d.scorching_barrier: Increases the number of orbiting fireballs and their size.
item.properties|f.blaze_pepper: A delectable spice prized by Clockwork denizens of all sorts. In powdered form, it has a terrible habit of clinging to absolutely everything.
item.properties|f.heavy_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to pack a greater punch. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_b: One of those mechanical monsters got me.  The cursed thing's claws tore right through my armor\!
item.properties|f.glacius: Mixing some advanced theories on cryogenics with the technology powering the Cooling Chamber produced this advanced armament, which is capable of flash-freezing the most formidable of foes.
mission.properties|e.good_unavailable: Sorry, that item is no longer available.
item.properties|f.twisted_spine_cone: An enhanced Spine Cone that will thrash opponents with thorns and bury them in brambles.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_7a: Lastly, we have the trap and hazard rooms. You can come here to see how you can sometimes affect traps and also learn about traps that deal different kinds of damage.
item.properties|f.power_cell: A small device used to power complex machines.
item.properties|f.firotech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of liquid flames that split on impact.
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_2a: Basically it comes down to 'branching.'  You see, most of the alchemy you have likely seen up to this point follows a linear evolution path.  It simply improves over time and each upgrade is better than the last. \n\nBut not all items are like that.  Many of them can become multiple, completely different types of items than their original\!
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r6: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
craft.properties|e.existing_multislot: This item has an accessory that blocks a location required by the new accessory. Check carefully, and remove the accessories in the way.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_4: I'm saying that we know this entire world isn't natural, and I for one don't believe that those hordes of miserable gremlins, no matter how industrious, could have built an entire world.  They had to have been aided by something far beyond their measure and perhaps whatever that is lies within the Core. \n\nThe same goes for the Alpha Squad.  They wouldn't just disappear, even within the furthest depths of the Clockworks.  They were our very best.  It was this Core that swallowed them.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: Shh, don't tell anyone I'm here.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
item.properties|f.venom_veiler: The ultimate in toxic dispersal devices, the Venom Veiler can be used to destroy pests on crops. Failing that, it can also be used to destroy crops.
item.properties|f.raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A small Snarbolax statuette, showing the savage shadow in a stunned state.
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_hoo: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_3: Once again you talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
item.properties|f.furni_bench_manor: An exquisite bench, perfect for perching in plush repose.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!

guildhelp.properties|m.guild_hall_info:
The Guild Hall is the nerve center for any Spiral Knights guild. Here, guild members can relax, plan future missions, and take advantage of the various Guild Hall amenities at their disposal. The Guild Hall is extremely customizable, and can be expanded to fit guilds of all sizes. It can also contain a wide variety of unique furniture and room types, so coordinate with your friends to make your Guild Hall a true reflection of your guild\!
 When a Guild Hall is first opened, it consists of two rooms\: a lobby, and the Command Console room. Guilds wishing for more space to customize can purchase expansions to increase the base size of their guild hall. These are available from the Command Console while in Design Mode.
 Guilds that have expanded the usable space in their Hall can fill that space with a variety of different rooms, available for purchase from the Birdsong Emporium. These rooms can be as simple as an empty room for placing furniture, or they can contain one of a number of different guild amenities, such as alchemy terminals, shops and more\!
 Guild Halls require a large amount of resources to maintain, which is represented by a weekly upkeep cost in Crowns. As a Guild Hall gains more expansions, this cost increases, so make sure there's enough Crowns in your Guild Treasury to pay for everything\!

mission.properties|b.king_of_ashes:
Within the ever-burning depths of the Firestorm Citadel, Lord Vanaduke lies in wait for any living being to pass into his accursed kingdom.  Any squad that has ever attempted to infiltrate the citadel has perished or was simply lost, like the countless lost souls bound to this terrible realm. 

Lord Vanaduke is ready for war, believing in his twisted mind that any who dare enter the citadel to be an invading force bent on overtaking his kingdom.  He stands as the last obstacle before gaining access to the Core and the Spiral Knights having any chance of restoring the Skylark and returning home. 

As a Champion of the Spiral Knights, you alone have what it takes to lead a team into the very heart of this inferno and face the titanic might of Lord Vanaduke.

conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_2a:
In short, this camp has no power and the sun is setting soon. Last night all manners of horrible monsters came after us in the dark.  We couldn't see and had no power for our defensive turrets. 

...we lost a lot of recruits. 

We need to channel power to the Rescue Camp so that we can set up a defensive perimeter before night falls\!
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_7a:
What the heck was that?  Where did that door come from? 

It would seem that this mechanical world beneath our feet has it in for us, {0}. Better watch yourself\! 

Anyway, I think this area is secure, at least until night fall.  Let's head back to camp.

conversation.properties|m.core_tech_3: Fresh air?  Warmth?  These depths are not an environment that many of us can stand much longer, but the Lieutenant insists that we keep at it, that maybe the surge of power from the next gate will provide us with the answer that we need. \n\nYou certainly can't argue that our Lieutenant isn't committed.  I don't think I've ever seen her close her eyes let alone sleep.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.

You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!

mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft2:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into a fiery furnace where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!

For example, a drakon cannot output piercing damage. \n\nBy default, you have an iron harness that any sprite can equip. If you want to branch out as you likely do with your weapons and gear, you need to purchase new harnesses.

mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_5a: Thank you Kora, I'll try to find a way across the chasm to Haven.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_3a: Thank you, {0}.  I hope you succeed.  As you know, we believe the Alpha Squad made it this far, but it is unclear what became of them... Euclid, Parma, Grantz.... Rulen. \n\n(Lieutenant Vaelyn seems to almost drift off)
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3a: The Clockworks are the massive complex of gears and machinery that lies just below the surface of this whole world. It's truly an incredible sight. It is a strange and dangerous world in which we have found ourselves. Tread carefully.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Hissers, the unstable bombers of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research: By now you have likely collected a few material samples from your early expeditions into the Clockworks.  Spiral HQ is requesting some of those materials for their ongoing research of the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_2a: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obstacle: A baleful shield of obelisk fragments bound by Apocrean ritual. Every time the fragments align, dark memories echo in your mind.
pvp.properties|m.upload_wait: A file picking window is trying to show...
