item.properties|f.spine_cone: A ferocious device that is positively bursting with briars.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_bl: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a blue glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.plague_needle: Knights are divided on whether this gun's bolts pierce and then poison, or poison and then pierce. To the unlucky target, this distinction is irrelevant.
item.properties|f.shogun_helmet: A grand helmet worn by warriors who long ago united a land under the banner of the rising sun.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_12: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  We have two missions of vital importance.  First, we've located an energy signature similar to the one emanating from that Artifact you found in the Clockworks.  We're homing in on that energy signature now.  Finding the source might help us understand what that gremlin schemer Razwog planned on doing with the Artifact or what the device is actually capable of.
item.properties|f.chroma_suit: A suit crafted from the hide of a chromalisk. Surprisingly, chromalisks seem to find the existence of these armors flattering.
item.properties|f.static_flash: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of electricity upon detonation.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_4a: When a battle sprite is issued to a knight, a 'bond' is written into the sprite's code to support the knight no matter the circumstances.  They will never leave your side\! \n\nUnfortunately, the cargo crates holding the Skylark's cache of battle sprites fell deep into the Clockworks after the crash.
item.properties|f.dark_thorn_shield: A gloomy guard that gives one's sword strikes a supernatural savagery.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_3a: And why is it now blocking access to the Core, now that we're so close?
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_rooster: A festive new years snipe that will stay where it's placed.
mission.properties|o.reporting_duty: Report to Lieutenant Feron in the Haven Arcade
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: In most cases this is just a standard favored item, but when your sprite is ready to evolve, an Evo Catalyst will be required.
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: The watcher of the Wildwoods...the horrible Snarbolax\!
mission.properties|o.built_to_destroy: Dismantle the Roarmulus Twins in the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_1a: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_5a: Euclid wasn't your typical knight.  By the time most in his division were getting their Squire crest, he had already achieved Vanguard.  As a Squad Leader, he lead a series of successful assaults against the Morai during the liberation of Isora.  A brilliant tactician, he was known for getting the job done with half the knights of other squads.
item.properties|f.stop_sign: A strange shield capable of stopping many status attacks from harming the user. However it has an unnatural power that causes the user to come to a halt when behind it.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_gre: A Spiral-issued light source typically used at checkpoints.
mission.properties|b.true_champion: Having come out of the Firestorm Citadel alive, Intel Agent Kora eagerly awaits to hear from you.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: Don't let spikes drop near monsters\!
item.properties|f.nether_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when this shield smashes through your foes.
dungeon.properties|m.training_1_desc: Explore this derelict portion of the Clockworks and learn the basics required for survival.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
support.properties|m.option_204_0: Names that are offensive are not acceptable. Be aware that what you consider offensive may not generally be considered offensive. So please only click here to file the complaint if you know for sure everyone would find that name offensive.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_1: A ceremonial sword issued to Spiral Knight recruits. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: It's even more beautiful down here\!
admin.properties|m.load_tester_disabled: Disabled\: to enable, enter a 'pseudoPlayerPassword' in the server configurator.
item.properties|f.humbug_hazer: This cantankerous contraption is guaranteed to make anyone but the most curmudgeonly humbug sick to their stomach.
sprites.properties|d.extra_crispy: Increases the potency of the fire and chance to set targets ablaze.
item.properties|f.furni_statue: A commemorative statue that may be placed in a Guild Hall. Up to {0} statues may be placed per hall.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Feeding your battle sprite is easy\! Simply open up your battle sprite interface and select your sprite icon. From there you can select a material from your arsenal to drop into the feeding tray. \n\nOnce you've queued up a material for your sprite to synthesize, simply click 'feed to sprite' and bon appetite\!
item.properties|f.mighty_cobalt_helm: An advanced Spiral Knight helm forged from a rare alloy of Moonstone and Luminite.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I promoted myself to Senior Manager of Ghastly Implements of Destruction.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_4: That's the kind of spirit I like to see. It works like this\: you use the gates up ahead to explore the Clockworks and retrieve special minerals. Then you deposit those minerals back in to gates to change the Clockworks below, creating new, unexplored levels.\n\nWe believe the minerals are the key to opening a path to the Core, we just need to discover how to use them\!
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_helm: A mythical helmet crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
auction.properties|e.selected_updated: The selected auction has been updated.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_helm: A hardy helm crafted from overly oppressive ooze.
item.properties|f.wild_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.storm_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a snow-covered mountain.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_3: A ceremonial shield issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
lottery.properties|m.lottery_award_multi: Congratulations to all {0} winners of {1} in the Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway\!
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_012: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|b.shadowplay: Even after Lord Vanaduke's defeat at your hands, Firestorm Citadel continues to burn with accursed flames. Though the nature sprites have been steadily making progress in fighting the flames, something or someone has recently caused a violent resurgence in its destructive power. Spiral HQ requests that you gather together a crack squad of knights and return to the collapsing ruins of Firestorm Citadel in order to discover the source of the disturbance.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_mail: This gelatinous gear combines the sturdiness of stone with the piercing protection of sticky goo. It's a wonder that you managed to beat up the jelly this is made out of.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_pier: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_keyboar: Keyboard used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands,
dungeon.properties|m.battle_arena_desc: Said to be watched by countless drifting souls for entertainment, Battle Arenas offer escalating challenges for the brave warriors who wish to claim the treasure of the Arena King.
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_armor: Upgraded Circuit Breaker Armor further hacked to resist shock.
conversation.properties|m.npc_techknight: I'm collecting samples from all over this stratum.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_1: Welcome to the battle arena\! The only rule is that you must fight at least once to move on. Should you claim victory, it will be up to you to decide to fight for even more glory\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_shade_: A suit of fire retardant fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they hide in heated hallways.
dungeon.properties|m.sleeper_sanctuary: The Sanctuary|A Calm in the Storm
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: Luck changes, sometimes from bad to worse...
item.properties|f.onesie: One size fits all. Machine washable, heavy duty cycle. Air dry only.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning_pen: The server will be rebooted in under {0} minutes. {1}
helptips.properties|m.back_to_haven: This path will take you back to Haven if you are not able to enter the Fiend's Grim Gate.
item.properties|f.night_cap_round: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer a few extra hours of rest.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_d: With the power restored, I was able to mend my armor. Let's hope I don't run into too many of those monstrous rust buckets again\!
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: That and a solid arsenal, yeah.
item.properties|f.defender: A durable, high quality shield of the Spiral Order that is suitable for any adventure.
conversation.properties|m.rc_warning_1a: Up these stairs lies the gate to Haven. Be sure to talk to Virgil before you enter so you know what to expect.
item.properties|f.ultra_poison_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
conversation.properties|r.fountain_1: Thanks for the information, I'm off to explore\!
chat.properties|m.usage_who: Usage\: /{0} player name\nRetrieves information about a knight.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_6a: Here we have an alchemy station that you'll no doubt become very familiar with as you upgrade your arsenal. \n\nWell, that's it for the shops. Would you like another tour?
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r4: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
mission.properties|o.sovereign_slime: Infiltrate the Royal Jelly Palace and find the mysterious energy source
item.properties|f.crown_fallen: A cursed crown once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
item.properties|f.furni_wardrobe_sklocke: A locked cabinet containing currently unequipped clothing and armor.
logon.properties|m.newer_version: The game is in the process of being updated. Please try again in a few minutes.
item.properties|f.capsule_health: A small capsule that restores a small amount of health. An adventurer's best friend\!
mission.properties|o.blades_fallen: Place the sword of an unknown knight at the memorial in the soldier's graveyard
item.properties|f.raptor: An ancient pistol imbued with enchantments designed to smite the fiendish creatures of the Underworld. Like its namesake, its bullets fly fast and strike with deadly force.
item.properties|f.super_stun_gun: An upgraded Stun Gun whose powerful blast will discourage even the most disconcerting of Clockworks monsters.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_pathfi: A hardened helm, reinforced with volcanic alloys, made to protect against the toastiest of monsters while exploring the unknown.
mission.properties|o.terminal_meltdown: Destroy the fiery monsters in the fuel depot and prevent an explosive disaster
item.properties|f.sentinel_helm: A helm imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
item.properties|f.super_brawl_crown: Awarded to the champion of Super Brawl\!
item.properties|f.warm_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns strong enough that it feels warm to the touch.
guild.properties|m.confirm_leave: Are you sure you no longer want to be a member of {0}?
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_1: SITUATION RESOLVED. PLEASE EXIT THE FACILITY.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_armor: A loose fitting suit of armor that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
chat.properties|m.usage_smile: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nSmile at your fellow players.
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_helm: A phantasmal helm for those who are aiming for the infernal.
item.properties|f.slumber_smogger_mkii: A Slumber Smogger modified to disperse sleepy smog over a wider range.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: Thanks for your help collecting spikes\!
invite.properties|m.description_invitati: Invite a friend to come join you in\nSpiral Knights\!\nFill in their e-mail address and we'll send them an invitation to join.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_expira: Please check that the expiration date is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Very good, {0}. You will find a new set of missions for you under Operations. These new missions will be grouped according to their overall objective and can be tackled in parallel to each other. This should allow you maximum flexibility in order to respond to each new threat as they come up. Farewell, {0}, 'Guardian of Cradle'.
item.properties|f.gremlin_helm: A special helmet handcrafted by gremlin smiths to shield from the harshest of environs. This one has been modified to fit a knight.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r7: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_7a: Brinks is the Token Trader, issuing certain items to Knights in exchange for tokens that can be collected within the Clockworks.  Tokens can be found in treasure blocks, issued as mission rewards or found when defeating special boss monsters.
item.properties|f.static_clinger: A latent strand of energy that floats throughout the Clockworks, frequently catching on hair and clothing. It's too large to properly distill into Energy, but it's very useful in alchemy.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_3: Now that you know how to perform a charge attack, let's apply that to a more advanced battle. Charge your weapon and unleash at the right moment when the enemy is exposed. Good luck\!
item.properties|f.alpha_claw_gauntlet: A protective Wolver-hide gauntlet affixed with razor sharp claws.
item.properties|f.spiraltail_mail: A simple simian mail typically worn at parades to provide prosperity and lend luck.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4c: Harness upgrades are definitely worth the crowns. Superior versions of each harness reduce combat skill cooldowns\!
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_helm: A Circuit Breaker Helm modified to provide further protection against shock.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Without you?  No, I'm here to bring you back.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of slime and beast family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
item.properties|m.moved_to_arsenal: Your inventory items have been moved to your arsenal.
item.properties|f.capsule_health_ultra: A capsule that restores an extreme amount of health. Never leave home without one\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_169085: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the heart of the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.prize_box_autumn: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in an Autumn style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.fused_demo_suit: An upgraded Demo Suit fused dangerously with the unstable core from a powerful Blast Cube. Even still, you should feel a lot safer wearing this.
projectx.properties|m.instance_shutdown: There has been a server error. You will be transferred to another instance.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5b: Get energy and do amazing things- got it\!
monster.properties|m.overtime_4: Remember, tomorrow is Hawaiian Shirt Day and every other day is Unpaid Overtime Day.
item.properties|f.book_of_dark_rituals: An ancient grimoire filled with unspeakable eldritch rites. Just like any cursed tome, there is likely some twisted individual out there who wants it for extremely nefarious purposes. Trade with caution.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_bc04ed: Earn clearance to explore Tier 2 of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: I will provide you with a summary of each battle sprite. In recognition of your valor in rescuing these sprites, Spiral HQ has authorized you to bond with one. This bond will last forever and is a significant responsibility. \n\nPlease think carefully before making your decision; there is no going back once you decide.
exchange.properties|m.billing_error: Your payment could not be processed due to a stray snipe in the gears. Fear not\! Your card has not been charged, and maintenance gremlins have been dispatched to repair the problem. Please try again later.
exchange.properties|m.billing_success: Thank you for your purchase\! ${0} has been charged to your credit card. {1} Energy will be delivered to your energy supply momentarily.
item.properties|f.armor_arms: An accessory that can be attached to the arms of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
shop.properties|m.cart_costume_own: Warning\! You already own this exact costume.
helptips.properties|m.atg_blocks2: Blocks can even affect each other\!
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_4a: Accept my mission and let's get to work blowing some stuff up\!
item.properties|f.supply_pack_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This compact pack has enough supplies to last a single Knight one week.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_2a: Well then you'll need one of these\!  It's a Proto Bomb and it's good for making things go boom\! \n\nI had an extra one in my pod so consider it an advance reward for saving all our hides here.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3c: Once you reach Haven I would advise you explore the town and familiarize yourself with all the sights and services the town has to offer. You will gain access to more powerful gear than we offer here as well and be surrounded with many more experienced knights. Be sure to ask them for assistance if you get lost.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Yes, you must be Edger.  Your squadmates requested that I come find you.
item.properties|f.armor_rear: An accessory that can be attached to the rear of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: None know for sure. Tinkinzar not seen for many many years. Crimson Order carries out Tinkinzar's plans for Cradle. Emberlight was blight on master plan because built by outcasts. Haven probably the same, founded by non-gremlins. Not part of plan\!
uplink.properties|m.bonus_reward: As part of the Homecoming Celebration for the new Guild Hall Expansion, Spiral HQ has authorized you receive these exclusive rewards. \nTo use the Battle Stand, deposit it into your Guild's Treasury and place it in a room in Design Mode. Enjoy\!
monster.properties|m.overtime_2: I'm not saying to work this weekend, but everyone else is, so...
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|o.spark_roar: Prove your valor against a legion of elite elemental monsters
mission.properties|o.abandoned_depot: Learn the basics of survival in the Abandoned Depot
dungeon.properties|m.cogmaster_castle_de: Calling all knights\!  Spiral HQ has launched a full-scale assault on the heavily fortified castle of Warmaster Seerus, a devious gremlin of the Crimson Order. All attacks against the sturdy walls and destructive artillery have failed - Spiral HQ needs YOU to turn the tide of the battle and take the fight to the Warmaster himself\!
craft.properties|e.cant_use_accessory: This item is not compatible with this accessory type.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_8a: Yes.  It would seem as though we have much to learn of this place. \n\nRhendon's report noted that many of the sprites were missing from the site. He suggested foul play.
projectx.properties|m.revisit_help: You can click on completed stages to revisit them.
pvp.properties|e.late_playagain: You are too late to play again.
guild.properties|log.member_added: Accepted {0}'s invitation to join the guild. Welcome\!
logon.properties|m.under_maintenance: The game is currently undergoing maintenance.  Please check back later.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_012: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Gremlins hide explosives in those bunkers, I bet throwing something inside will set them off\!
steam.properties|m.confirm_convert: Are you sure?  The conversion cannot be undone.  Once complete, \nyou will be logged back in with your Steam account.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_1a: Tell me what you know about the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_9b: Great, then I will go ahead and give you credit for this mission. \n\nRemember, if you would like to come back for more training, The Advanced Training Hall is located in Haven Town Square.  Take care out there, {0}.
mission.properties|b.first_contact: You have escaped your crash pod and reached a Rescue Camp just as the sun set across the alien landscape.  Using your comlink, it is now time to establish contact with Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|b.explosive_plot: Recon Knights have discovered what they believe to be a gremlin-hatched plot to destroy Haven\!  As a Knight Elite, you have been selected by Spiral HQ to investigate this matter.  Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
item.properties|f.storm_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to ride the lightning into battle.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The rest of us thought we weren't going to make it. But then...then the light surrounded us and we were safe. We've taken to calling it The Sleeper. We aren't sure what it is exactly, but it needs our help. This world was created to protect it but somehow The Swarm breached the Core and has been feeding on the energy and growing like a leech ever since.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\!

item.properties|f.heavy_plate_mail: Thick armor reinforced with more metal plates than a Clockworks vending machine. It's a little uncomfortable.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_2a: If you know where it is, I'll put a stop to it.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_amazing: Contains three amazing eye shapes for your style kit\: Clover, Skull, and Circuitry.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of moonstone.
item.properties|f.replica_mask: A plastic {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's not well made and eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_1: Hello again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage correct?
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_6b: I don't see or hear any of those things.
dungeon.properties|m.no_revive: Your revive effort is no longer necessary.
item.properties|f.starlit_hunting_coat: An advanced, star-soaked hunting coat that will keep you awake even as it coddles you in downy comfort.
item.properties|f.frayed_fabric: The worn remains of a Clockworks denizen's duds. It could probably be recycled.
item.properties|f.frenzy_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so fast, his frenzy alone could fell armies before they rose against him.
item.properties|f.angelic_helmet: A beautiful costume designed exclusively for great heads.
item.properties|f.super_dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more Dark Matter. How much Dark Matter is too much? This much.
mission.properties|f.p_tip: Prestige Badges are displayed next to your knight name.  They are automatically awarded when enough prestige is acquired.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_2a: To the West, you will learn about useful items found in the Clockworks. To the North, you will learn about a variety of block types and doors. To the East, you will find an array of traps and hazards as well as a combat room to practice defense against training cubes.  Don't worry, we have taken precautions to make sure the cubes are perfectly harmless\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_barrier: If you start feeling overwhelmed, use the force barriers like the one to your right to take a breather. Monsters and projectiles cannot pass through them.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_1a: Thanks Kora.  I owe a lot to your intel.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the fiery drakon, battle sprite of those who prefer frontline, destructive combat? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r6: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_64d528: Deposit a single mineral into a gate.
mission.properties|b.the_flickering_flam: After your victory in Firestorm Citadel, the nature sprites of the great Spirit Mother finally began to make headway in battling the cursed flames engulfing the charred remains of Almire. A recent flare-up has impeded that progress, hinting at some lingering malevolent force that continues to fuel the fires. Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.

Welcome to the Dark Harvest Festival\!  This annual celebration honors the undead with festive masks, delicious treats and dangerous tricks\!

To participate, explore the Clockworks and try to find the legendary 'Punkin King.'  This ghoulish gourd gives out candy to visitors.  You can exchange the candy to the traders here in the Haven Town Square for monster masks\!

mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!

mission.properties|m.legion_almire_2a:
An excerpt from the accounts of Lord Brandell, High Chancellor of Almire\: 

Like so many of its people, Law and Order have fled Almire.  Only Justice remains, but she too has been twisted by the cursed flames that ravage our kingdom.  Justice is now the burning scepter of our once great Lord Vanaduke.  Justice is swift, unflinching, merciless. 

My position has afforded me much in my life.  I used to love the view that my tower offers. From these lofty heights I thought of myself as the first one to greet the spring season, the first to smell the life in the air as the flowers bloomed.

mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_6a: Good luck to you. Travel swiftly and avoid their grasp.
projectx.properties|m.shutdown_warning: This server will be refreshed in {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|f.emberbreak_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting fire. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_super: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_5a: Nice to finally meet you in person, {0}\!  Congratulations\!
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_7b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_armor: A sturdy suit of armor for those who want to bring down some beasts.
mission.properties|b.reporting_duty: Lieutenant Feron is responsible for overseeing the Clockworks mining operation in the Haven Arcade.  Report to him and learn about the situation in Haven and Spiral HQ's mission to reach the Core of Cradle.
helptips.properties|m.atg_torto: Tortodrones can be found patrolling the Clockworks.  They will not attack unless attacked first - but be warned, once they are enraged, they are fearsome and deadly opponents.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_6a:
Wow, this thing is a massive tower of everfrost.  I've only ever seen little handfuls of the stuff, nothing close to what we're seeing here. 

The intel we've collected so far suggests that fiends utilize large deposits of the stuff to trap the souls of the lost within it, like some kind of icy prison. 

It would seem that Maulos, that horrible arch-fiend you just took down, had a different use in mind and was actually destroying this everfrost to unleash swarms of angry, frozen souls into the Clockworks.  Had he finished the job, well, I don't even want to think about how many sweaters we would all be needing right now...
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_3: Take some time to rest up and enjoy this tremendous victory.  Sprial HQ will no doubt call on you again\!
item.properties|f.super_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with potent icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_4a: Thanks, {0}.  I thought we were done for back there. \n\nLet's get the artifact back to Spiral HQ before someone else tries to nab it.
uplink.properties|m.auction_incomplete: We're sorry, but the item you tried to sell was not sold.\n\nTip for sellers\: Always sell shiny items that everyone wants at super good prices.
help.properties|m.energy_depot: You can buy or sell Energy at the Energy Depot.
item.properties|f.wise_owlite_shield: It doesn't take a renowned Owlite scholar to figure out that defending oneself with a shield is an excellent idea.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
chat.properties|m.usage_salute: {0} [player name]\nCauses your tech knight to salute.
item.properties|f.pathfinder_armor: A handy set of armor for blazing trails and protecting against the bites of hungry monsters in the wild.
item.properties|f.slime_lockbox: A slippery, slimy lockbox won at the Golden Slime Casino.  It contains one of many special items.  It can be opened with a Slime Key or a Silver Key.
mission.properties|m.once_only: This mission can only be played once per day.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_16: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you get your bearings. Good luck to you, {0}\!
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_4: Once you reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_1a: Well, looks like we're in quite a bind here, {0}. There's plenty of work to be done to get this camp up and running, so you've now been authorized to receive missions\! You can find any available missions in the Activities bar.
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Want to earn even more Krogmo Coins with every match?
mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_2a: Wow, sounds like I have a lot to learn\!
item.properties|f.seraphynx_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Seraphynx Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies divine light. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat with protection and restoration.
item.properties|f.rocky_core: A delicious gummy treat with an impenetrable rocky shell. More than a few teeth have been lost by knights attempting to get at the gooey interior.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_4: Great\!  I'll meet you near the exit once you've cleared them out.  Careful though, they seem to have adapted the use of birthday candles as weapons...
item.properties|f.raider_buckler: A light wooden shield that blocks basic attacks and allows a countering swift strike.
design.properties|m.room_install_warning: You are paying to install this room. If for any reason it is removed you will have to pay to install it again.
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_mask: An upgraded Skelly Mask sure to spook any spineless monsters lumbaring around the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.supply_standard_compac: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This standard pack has enough supplies to last a few Knights one week.
item.properties|f.ionized_salt_bomb: A solid chunk of rock salt with an explosive surprise inside. Jellies hate surprises.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_4a: Tell me about Squad Leader Euclid.
mission.properties|b.return_of_ur: A Recon squad has reported that deep within a fiendish city, devilites are attempting to summon a legion of powerful trojan warriors.  Based on intel from a devilite internal memo, the trojans are known as the 'Legion of Ur,' and are said to have once numbered in the thousands.  Strangely, the memo indicated that the Legion of Ur was sealed away in the Underworld and that an alternative approach would be required for bringing them back. \n\nWhatever means the devilites intend to use to bring a few thousand trojans into the Clockworks, they must be stopped.  Infiltrate their city and stop the fiendish army before they become unstoppable\!
item.properties|f.silvermail: Strong, yet light armor for knights who've sworn an oath to hunt down and destroy the undead, wherever it may lurk.
item.properties|f.exp_west_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.lightning_capacitor: An upgraded Capacitor that can explode with the fury of an electrical storm.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_dev: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_1a: What's this? Another poor soul ripe for harvest by the Apocrea?
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r9: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
guild.properties|m.invite_name: Enter the name of the knight you wish to invite\:
projectx.properties|d.achievement_7542da: Forge an item up to level 10.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_2a: That mass of negative energy we've been investigating is a portion of an ancient kingdom called Almire, the very same realm described in that Owlite tome you discovered\!
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_2a:
I've established a comlink with Knights that have formed a Rescue Camp up ahead.  If you head north, you should eventually reach it. 

I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp before sunset. 

And should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
item.properties|f.toxic_core: A solid, pulsating lump that oozes with vitriol.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_2: Again, this is really weird Biscotti, but I'll do my best.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_shield: This weathered wobbling wall can withstand a walloping when wielded by unwaveringly willed warriors.
mission.properties|o.shadowplay: Discover the source of the disturbance in Firestorm Citadel
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_1:
Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\! Merry Winterfest\!

That special time of year is finally here, when a delicate blanket of wondrous white snow covers Haven and every Stranger, every snipe and every Knight fills their hearts with holiday cheer.

But to you I must tell, all is sadly not well. Lacking motive or reason, a group of shriveled-heart grinchlins have threatened this Winterfest season\!
help.properties|m.monster_slime: Deal PIERCING - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against PIERCING
item.properties|f.prize_box_cozy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Cozy style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
helptips.properties|m.final_test: You've made it this far knight - but your final exam will require quick thinking and even faster feet.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_ghost: Ghost blocks will destroy any blocks connected to them, even unbreakable blocks\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_decoration: Contains various festive decorations for your Guild Hall to help ring in the winterfest season.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
helptips.properties|m.tut_welcome: We have picked up your distress signal, recruit. Your first objective is to reach Haven, where we have created an outpost. You're likely a little woozy from the crash, so I'll guide you through the basics. The road may be dangerous, so ready your sword and keep your wits about you. Good luck\!
item.properties|f.grand_solstice_ring: A magnificent, enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its surface seems to change color over time, sometimes hot and sometimes cold to the touch.
mission.properties|b.creators_and_create: In order to be fully prepared for the challenges ahead, Chief Biotech Hahn is requesting you contact him before undertaking the new missions that you have available to you.
item.properties|f.divine_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: Drones can also deal status damage.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a temperamental warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
redeem.properties|e.invalid_code: The code you entered was not found. Please double-check it and try again.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise_3: Contains three randomly chosen Prize Boxes in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.forbidden_fruit: A sinful snack favored by famished fiends.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_1: Well met {0}, it has been some time since I first met you having just arrived from the Rescue Camp.  You've come along way since then, rising to the rank of Defender Elite no less. \n\nYou are a gifted soldier, {0}.  I have no doubt you will soon be a Champion amongst the Spiral Knights and instrumental in our solving the great mystery that is the Core, restoring the Skylark and returning home.  You have proven that you have what it takes to face the legions of dark forces that lurk below the surface.
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_2c: On second thought, I'm going to head out.
item.properties|f.arctic_acolyte_hood: A hood said to be worn by wandering arctic acolytes. 'we saw them heading straight towards the mountains, off into the interior of the vast frozen continent, but why?'
conversation.properties|m.seerus_defeate: I would rather it all burn than give the Arsenal up to anyone else\!
item.properties|f.proto_sword: A small sword issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.bushy_tail: A peculiarly intact specimen of a Clockworks beast's tail.
mission.properties|b.spark_roar:
An exceptionally high concentration of constructs has been found guarding an area of the Clockworks that Spiral HQ suspects could be a Crimson Order hideout. Unlike other monsters, constructs don't seem capable of reproducing on their own, meaning that any time one is deconstructed, it's a permanent dent in their numbers. It will be a worthwhile task regardless of Crimson Order influence or not. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter these levels, investigate the possible hideout, and eliminate the construct threat. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with elemental resistant gear with elemental and shadow damage weapons\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Careful, those Gremlins have lined the place with barbed wire.
item.properties|f.gh_env_snowing: A beautiful environment that fills your Guild Hall with perfect snow\: the kind that gently falls from the sky and never collects on the ground, melting into gray muck.
social.properties|m.earned_prestige: become the Most Prestigious, having earned {0} prestige in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.supernova: The destruction left in the wake of this peerless pistol is anything but nebulous. Supernova shots become more powerful the further they travel.
chat.properties|m.usage_accessory: Usage\: /{0} (armor helmet) [clear | accessory name]\nAdds an accessory to the equipment or clears all accessories.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_3: Without the power of the rest of the sprites, water will never flow through this realm. It requires a focus link with the Spirit Mother to bring even the smallest of drops of water into such an oppressive world. The master of this realm has seen to it that the flames surrounding him will always burn.
guildhelp.properties|l.storage_console: The Guild Storage can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|f.heavy_demo_helm: A reinforced helmet that might be handy if you, the master of exploding, take it with you.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2b: All traces of Compound 42 should be eliminated, along with the facility and any engineers not part of the inner fold. Remind the scorchers who find these orders uncomfortable that those who disobey shall soon hear my whisper in their ears. \n\nSeal the doors and burn everything to the ground.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r7: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_3a: Once the charge aura has reached maximum charge, release the ATTACK button and unleash a devastating charge attack\!
item.properties|m.equip_locked: Equipping {0} will bind it to you. You will not be able to trade this item once bound. Are you sure?
item.properties|f.jelly_glue: A viscous compound developed by Biotechs to allow for the study of slime creatures. When mixed with slime and jelly matter, it allows for reshaping without losing its form. Though reserved for scientific purposes, the process is generally regarded as 'super fun.'
chat.properties|m.not_in_party: You are not in a party.
mission.properties|o.eye_of_needle: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_3a: It's because the Strangers took us in that they're now targeted...
projectx.properties|m.reboot_desired: Server will reboot due to code update when all players log off.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni:
Astounding\!  I would have never expected a new recruit to crawl out of that fiery wreckage alive\!  You must really be something else... 

The name's Feron, Lieutenant of the Spiral Order.  We had believed this entire complex was derelict until the elevator leading to it suddenly surged to life.  Upon investigating the whole place soon went up in a blaze\! 

How did you end up here?
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: Thank you, Lieutenant, I'll head on into Haven.
item.properties|f.raging_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and razed the gates of a heavenly kingdom.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_2a: At the rate you're going you just might, {0}\!  Though based on new intel it would seem that's not going to be easy.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_chara: Sorry, that name contains an invalid character.
item.properties|f.prize_box_colossal: Contains various unique costumes and accessories to celebrate the Year of the Horse\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_2a: Yikes, are those the sprites or some kind of phantom?
item.properties|f.nodeslime_helm: A menacing mask of malice made from obliterated ominous ooze.
conversation.properties|m.npc_onwatch_c: Did you see something out there?
chat.properties|m.unspecific_item: Equipment not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_5a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
mission.properties|o.ending_in_fire: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.radiant_silvermail: An upgraded set of Silvermail that is said to shine brightly even in the darkest of hours.
item.properties|f.winterfest_table: A stylish antique table with a plate of cookies set out for Impostclaus.
mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4a: You talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
mission.properties|b.high_temperature_ho:
Intel had reported a gremlin deconstruction crew dismantling a portion of the Clockworks in order to generate scrap resources for use in their Project R. Using powerful welding torches, they are truly burning the place to the ground. 

One of the squads investigating the site has gone missing and is believed to be now held in captivity at the site. 

Infiltrate the fiery deconstruction zone and rescue the captive knights.  But be warned, the deconstruction crew are said to have a powerful security construct hidden somewhere on site.
item.properties|f.robo_wrecker: A wrench-like tool thought to be of gremlin design.  Though its origin is mysterious, its abilty to destroy constructs is well-documented.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_compound_: The others must never know.  Silence them. -H
mission.properties|m.search_continues_3a: Perhaps.  It certainly could be when you look at it.  We'll need to study it further.
item.properties|f.leviathan_blade: A rare treasure of the Spiral Order, the blows from this mythical sword are said to rain down upon its victims like the water from a tidal wave.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_mastery_1a: I could always use a good sword.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: Hello there, {0}\!  My name is Bosco and I'm here to give you a rundown on the basics of alchemy. \n\nIt's pretty simple stuff really, thanks to these Alchemy Stations.  They do all the heavy lifting for ya\!
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of crimsonite.
item.properties|f.searing_edge: A light blade that sets foes ablaze as it slashes. The technology that keeps the hilt from catching fire is more advanced than the sword itself.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_5a: I'll stay here and protect these sprites. Some of these sprite transport crates are empty. I think someone or something is after them. \n\nYou go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
item.properties|f.cold_iron_carver: An enchanted sword crafted from cold iron whose blade wards off the creatures of the dark.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_8a: Pah\!  I am no mere gremlin.  I am the thousand eyes that watch you in the darkness.  I am the hissing blade that whispers your doom.  Tear down every wall and cog in this accursed place and you will find only shadows. \n\nI cannot be stopped by the likes of you\!  Hsst\!
item.properties|f.vial_shock_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight5_1a: {0}, have you seen these minerals in your travels yet?  They're fascinating\! You should ask Chief Geo Knight Wegner about them.  I hear he's the expert on minerals\!
help.properties|m.monster_gremlin: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against ELEMENTAL
projectx.properties|m.petfood_descriptio: Select any material from your Arsenal to feed your Sprite.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Whatever that was, we're here now. Wherever here is. It looks like our only option is to see where this leads.
item.properties|f.royal_core: A sweet-smelling lump of ooze collected from a particularly noble specimen of slime.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3b: A "gate" is an entry point into the Clockworks. They take the form of the lifts you see before you. Each gate has a display monitor showing the gate's unique icon as well as a control panel that allows the user to enter the gate. This gate here will always take you to the same place, but other gates have shifting floors beneath them. In those, you never quite know what's next\!
item.properties|f.bechamel_room: A trendy room where Bechamel can add or remove Accessories from your favorite equipment.
item.properties|f.dangerous_brigandine: Padded armor that seems to emphasize the high mortality rate of the elite Recon Rangers. Recon Rangers need to travel light and fast, often headlong into situations that would terrify other knights.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I'm either here celebrating or downing my sorrows.
dungeon.properties|m.scarlet_fortress_de: Named for its vibrant tapestries, the Scarlet Fortress is a deconstructed mass of a forgotten castle, drifting endlessly in the void of the Clockworks. Strange bestial ghosts haunt its long corridors, tirelessly pursuing those that enter their domain.
item.properties|f.buccaneer_broadsider: A fearsome firearm fitted with a flintlock. The vintage mechanism's reliability has been enhanced with a bit of gremlin know-how.
item.properties|f.coliseum_room: A lively room featuring a Coliseum ticket booth, a Coliseum Rewards Supervisor, and a Krogmo Alchemy Machine.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.cursed_idol: A small, stone statue carved into the form of one of the thousands of arch fiends of the Underworld. The shadowy surface color seems to move and shift like smoke.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Clawers, the fearsome frontline fighters of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.trojan_horseshoe: A jet black horseshoe. It appears relatively harmless.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_shield: A mythical shield crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
item.properties|f.toxic_catalyzer: A Catalyzer modified to fire dangerously radioactive projectiles. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
projectx.properties|m.warning_info: You have received the following message from the Game Masters\:\n\n {0}
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
helptips.properties|m.event_module: Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of crimsonite.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_8a: I assume you've named them as well?
item.properties|f.kilowatt_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to deliver an unpleasant shock on impact. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
helptips.properties|m.tg_pots: Some objects can be picked up and used or even thrown across the room. Try throwing a pot at that switch.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_or: A short torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2a: An official order from Herex, the Whispering Venom\: \n\nProduction of Compound 42 is to cease immediately.  While a formidable poison and no doubt useful in achieving a... 'higher' power amongst the Order, it seems to have formed an intelligence well beyond the scope of a standard bio-toxin.
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r4: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: Gaaah\! I need to get out of here\! \n\nEmergency Sneakfield...activate\!
projectx.properties|m.display_failure:
We were unable to initialize the game's graphical display. Please take the following steps to ensure compatibility\:
  • Visit the technical support forum for up-to-date information and suggestions.
  • Make sure your system satisfies the game's minimum requirements.
  • Update your video drivers.
  • Ensure that hardware video acceleration is fully enabled.
uplink.properties|m.bid_outbid: Visit the Auction House for another chance at this item\!
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_2: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 2 star item.
item.properties|f.prize_box_electric: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in an Electric style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.autogun: A fully automatic handgun capable of rapidly firing powerful bolts of energy.
item.properties|f.winterfest_coat: A supremely soft and seasonally stylish suit that radiates with wondrous Winterfest cheer. It tells everyone that when it comes to the holidays, you mean business.
item.properties|f.spark_life: A powerful charge of pure energy that instantly revives you or a fellow party member.
uplink.properties|m.metal_sonic: Thank you for purchasing Sonic CD on Steam\!  Attached is your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.  These items are costumes that can be equipped over any armor allowing you to look like Metal Sonic whenever you like\! \n\nPlease note, gear can only be equipped in towns or at an Arsenal Station.  If you are a new recruit and have just emerged from your crash pod, make your way to the Rescue Camp.  Once you reach the Rescue Camp you can equip your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_4: Welcome back to the Hall of Heroes, {0}.  Please speak to the heroic knights you see before you to gain access to their weapons and gear.
mission.properties|r.another_trace_3a: You can count on me, Kora.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_4a: Energy is essential in order to acquire powerful gear and items from the Supply Depot. \n\nYou will find all sorts of uses for it in your travels, just look for the energy symbol\!
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We were in the middle of receiving a report from Lieutenant Vaelyn's team at the Core Terminal when our signal was disrupted. It took some time, but I've managed to pinpoint the source of the disruption. It's coming from that strange device you discovered near Vanaduke's throne room in Firestorm Citadel.  It seems like someone has activated it.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_recon:
I am drawn to this place. 

In the eyes of these silent warriors I see myself\: cold, strong, unflinching... and crumbling. I have been asked to let it go, to move on, but this I cannot do. 

Their faces, their dying cries... they haunted me in my dreams, so I no longer sleep.  Now I see them when I close my eyes, so I shall not blink. 

I will remain here, among the stones... never blinking, never forgetting.
mission.properties|b.alchemy_mastery: Bosco in the Haven Bazaar has more information for you regarding the highest level of alchemy available to you.  Mastery level alchemy will be instrumental in your survival as you attempt to reach the Core of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A rosy red plant inside a cheerful pot.

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...

uplink.properties|m.tf2_start:
G'Day, loyal customer\! 

You may have recently heard that I've become the fourth richest man in America, having surpassed the fifth richest man in wealth, and having killed the previously-fourth richest man in a harpoon duel. While this is, of course, entirely true (especially the part about the harpoon duel, which was long and bloody), it's not nearly enough. Fourth place might be fine for HIPPIES who wouldn't know victory if it wandered up and offered to braid their ponytails, but it's damn well not good enough for Saxton Hale\! 

Mister Reddy, my accountant, explained to me that the best way to light a fire under the backside of Mann Co.'s revenue would be to "open up new markets". I'd relate exactly how we plan on doing that to you, but as he was talking I immediately started doing military presses to keep from dying of boredom, and missed out on the intricate details. 

All you need to know, dear customer, is that I need a good man to find his way to a town called "Haven", bravely stride into one of the many gates there and then cut his way down to the first "Clockworks Terminal". Since we couldn't find a good man, you'll have to do it yourself. You'll be amply rewarded, of course\: there's NOTHING I wouldn't do for an employee who risked life and limb on a trivial task necessitated by my selfish whims. 

Don't bother directly contacting me once you're done, as I'll be too busy kickboxing giraffes to care. One of my other employees will handle things from there. Best of luck\: you'll need it\! 

Sincerely yours, 

SAXTON HALE 
Australian 
CEO, Mann Co.

mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft3:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, intel has located a black kat nest beyond an area with electrifying resistance. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!

mission.properties|b.blades_fallen:
Not every knight who enters the Clockworks returns to feel the sun on their face once more.  Within the perilous depths of the Clockworks, those that brave its dangers always face the reality that every expedition may be their last.  Sometimes their bodies can be recovered and other times all that is left is remnants of their gear. 

Just outside of Haven, Spiral HQ has built a soldier's graveyard where fallen knights can lay to rest.  As a Spiral Knight, you must face the reality of death in order to understand its gravity. 

Deliver the remains of an unknown knight, a sword, to a memorial within the graveyard.  But stay alert- dark energies resonate from the graveyard, attracted to the countless souls it houses.

An unlikely source of intel has surfaced from the residents of Moorcroft Manor.  A few of the spookats that call it home contacted one of our visiting Recon Knights and provided details of the negative energy mass that has appeared above the Core. 

Calling it 'a place of burning hatred' and 'a prison for dark souls' they say that you can read all about it in 'one of those weird Owlite books' in an Owlite keep they pinpointed. 

If what they claim is true Spiral HQ could gain valuable intel from investigating the Owlite keep.  Just remember that these Owlite structures have all proven to be swarming with the lost souls of countless undead monsters.  Prepare accordingly.

mission.properties|b.oilers_in_boilers:
A boiler room beneath Moorcroft Manor has been overrun by a legion of oily slimes known as 'oilers' that seem to enjoy fiery conditions.  This could prove disastrous for any levels in close proximity should the slimes enter the boilers and cause an explosion. 

Moorcroft Manor serves as an invaluable connection point into Tier 2 and its departed residents have been the most gracious of hosts.  It is in Spiral HQ's best interest to send a squad in to deal with the smoldering slimes before they create a firestorm that seals off our access to Tier 2. 

It is up to you to locate the oilers and remove them from the boilers\!

mission.properties|b.vile_engine:
Somewhere below a level that lichens have taken to inhabiting lies a strange facility of unknown origin that seems to be used for the production of toxic slime monsters. The 'slime generators' are capable of rapidly producing slime monsters that then quickly populate nearby levels. 

Squads in neighboring levels have already reported overwhelming numbers of toxic slimes, making it impossible to lead expeditions beyond depth 23.  It is time a knight of your caliber form a squad to infiltrate this strange facility and shut down production of these vile creatures. 

Any data that you could collect as to their origin would be highly valuable to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|b.chilled_to_bone:
By now you have no doubt run into strange, undead monsters known as 'spookats.'  Recon Knights have finally discovered what seems to be the source of these ghostly cat-like creatures. 

Large concentrations of spookats have been sighted in what is believed to be the darkened remains of an owlite castle.  Dubbed the 'Candlestick Keep' this shadowy realm is only illuminated by a series of owlite candles.    

Proceed with caution while exploring outside the light of the candles.  Lurking in the dark are enormous spookats known as 'grimalkins.'  Grimalkins seem to withstand all weaponry and are to be avoided.  Your only defense is to stay in the light\! 

Spiral HQ has issued you this mission in order to collect more data on the origins of the spookats and the mystery behind the fall of the owlites.  Investigate the Candlestick Keep and report your findings\!

helptips.properties|m.tg1_heat: You may have noticed monsters leaving little embers like these behind. Embers grant you heat. As your heat meter fills, the flame next to your health will grow. If you make it to the exit without dying, the heat will be applied to your weapons and armor. Over time, this will level them up and make them stronger. While playing with others, every party member gets heat whenever anyone picks up an ember.

item.properties|f.serene_helm: An ancient, resilient helmet covered in a soft layer of moss.  Within the cool, stony interior of this helmet you can hear a faint and soothing song formed by the rustle of winds traveling from distant lands.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: A magnificently preserved royal seal of the lost kingdom of Almire. It probably belongs in a museum.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_crown: A regal crown resembling that of the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.

mission.properties|b.sovereign_slime:
The source of the strange energy signature is believed to be located somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace, the home to one of the members of the slime aristocracy, the Royal Jelly. 

The might of these sovereign slimes is not to be underestimated.  Should you find yourself facing this hot-tempered highborn, you would be wise to be equipped with the appropriate gear and backed by a full squad of experienced knights. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with pierce resistant gear and shadow damage weapons before deploying for the Royal Jelly Palace\!

mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.

mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
