mission.properties|b.p_r7_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.sun_shards: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in solar-charged Luminite. Whatever you do, don't look directly at it.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_11a: I'd like you to give me the tour once more.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
pvp.properties|m.no_reward: You have dishonored my great Coliseum with your lack of fighting spirit\!  You shall receive no Krogmo Coins and no rank points\!
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_3: Truly you are among the greatest of all warriors who have ever lived\! The bounties of the Arena King are yours for the taking\!
auction.properties|m.cancel_support:
Are you sure?


Use your GM powers to cancel this auction and refund everyone involved?
helptips.properties|m.tut_weapons_short: Use [[NEXT_WEAPON]] to cycle your equipped weapon.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_ma: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! Unfortunately, that knight already has a full friend list, so you were unable to be auto-friended.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_shield: A large, bony bulwark bathed in blackish brume. It occasionally issues a quiet, forlorn whisper, usually about remembering to block.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_slime_: I have a delicious fruity center\!
item.properties|f.snarble_barb: A bestial blade that can shoot slithy spines at those who would oppose its wielder.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: To think, all this could have been unleashed on Haven...
conversation.properties|m.npc_supplies_b: It's been days since we had fresh supplies.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_4: A ceremonial shield issued to Vanguards of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.somnambulists_totem: An ordinary object with a unique texture and weight, the result of having been partially digested by a Sloombargo.
sprites.properties|d.maskeraith: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
item.properties|f.graviton_bomb: Capable of dragging enemies toward its location before exploding, this bomb utilizes technology that the Spiral Order does not fully understand.
item.properties|f.guild_members_300: Allows your guild to recruit up to 300 members\!
item.properties|f.artillery_beacon: A portable beacon that when deployed, summons a barrage of powerful rockets
helptips.properties|m.party_nosplit_warn: WARNING\! You may not split your party during this mission.
sprites.properties|d.flame_barrier: Surround yourself with a barrier of flames that enhances your defenses while burning nearby targets.
conversation.properties|m.fc_bridge_2: Lord Vanaduke is the master of this broken realm. Once the king of Almire, Vanaduke now commands a terrible legion in the ashes of his former kingdom. You would do well to never cross his path.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_2a: As you know I am attempting to assemble a research team to work on-site in the Core terminal.  In order to successfully utilize it to restore the Skylark, it is imperative that we reach it and set up this research station. \n\nAll evidence seems to point towards you having the potential to finally reach the Core.  By breaking through the Firestorm Citadel and establishing a link to the Core, my team could set up the necessary supply lines and get to work immediately.  But we can't do that while that infernal citadel and its horrible ruler stand in our way.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Amazing...I never thought I'd see another one of us ever again\! I'm glad to see you made it here safely.
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm: Cross the perilous chasm and connect with Spiral HQ in Haven
chat.properties|m.usage_heat: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield sprite) [heat]\nSets the equipment to that heat.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.black_kat_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a shadowy sapper of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.fur_cap: A toasty fur cap forming the visage of a wild beast.
item.properties|f.redwood: A sturdy chunk of fine, unfinished wood. It's typically used in the production of cabinets.
uplink.properties|m.tf2_end:
To Whom It May Concern\: 

I have confirmed your arrival at the Clockworks Terminal, and have obtained the relevant data regarding our competitor's catalog. Mann Co. appreciates your cooperation in this task. 

In return for your assistance, we have remitted to you one (1) Mann Co. Brand "Spiral Sallet" replica headwear. No refunds or exchanges will be offered for this reward, and Mann Co. is not liable for any injury sustained while attempting to use said reward. 

Regards, 

Mister Reddy 
Mann Co. 
"We sell products and get in fights." 

The information in this mail is confidential and is intended solely for the addressee. Access to this mail by anyone else is unauthorized. If you are not an intended recipient, you must not read, use, think about, eat or seduce the information contained in this mail. Failure to comply with this request will result in the recipient being mauled by bears to within the fullest extent of the law.
item.properties|f.deadly_splinter_bomb: A large chunk of synthetic mineral primed with a potent explosive. Fact\: the easiest way to find the splinter in the haystack is to blow up the haystack.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_5a: Along the north wall here we have all sorts of blocks, switches, doors, and buttons from the Clockworks. If you want to overcome the devious and deadly mechanisms down there I suggest you become familiar with how these work\!
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Smashing\! Good luck to you, {0}. You'll need it- black kats are an unlucky bunch...
item.properties|f.shock_raider_helm: A simple helm, shielding the wearer from the elements and enemies alike.
chat.properties|m.jk_notfound: {0} does not exist on your friend or guild lists.
item.properties|f.slime_key: A slippery key that can only open a Slime Lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_1a:
(You see the lost soul of Almire standing before you.  In his face you see a profound sadness.  Staring beyond you he begins to speak without introduction.) 

Lord Vanaduke brought the fire from the mountains to our kingdom.  Everything burned.  His enemies.  Even his family. 

My family was lost too.  I fled the battle as soon as I saw the wave of flames in the distance.  I was able to reach my home just in time to see it burn.  I don't even remember how it ended.  I have no memory of my passing.
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_1b: No thanks, I'll explore the place myself.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_6a: Once again these sprites seem to have adapted their form to suit their surrounding environment.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rage: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_4: We've doubled the amount of patrols around Haven in case there is another attack, but I have a feeling that those gremlins already got what they came for...
item.properties|f.wolver_mask: A simple mask made from wolver pelt.
guild.properties|e.in_default: Sorry, you cannot do that while the guild is in default.
item.properties|f.raging_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used rage to carve whole worlds from stone.
chat.properties|m.usage_summon: Usage\: /{0} player name\nSummons a player to your current location.
item.properties|f.gremlin_gizmo: A strange device used in gremlin machinery. It is inscribed with a warning against exposing it to direct sunlight or submerging it in water.
mission.properties|b.vicious_viscous: Spiral HQ would like you to investigate levels of the Clockworks where the most powerful slime and beast monsters reside.  By exploring these levels and transferring your combat data back to Spiral HQ, all knights would ultimately benefit from your dangerous experience. \n\nIt is highly recommended that you equip yourself with piercing resistant gear with piercing and shadow damage weapons\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_4a: Before you go, here's a few materials to get you started.  Good luck.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r9: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on direct assault\: firebolt creates an explosive projectile, flame barrier surrounds its knight with protective fireballs, and firestorm creates a massive wave of flames. \n\nThe drakon is best suited for fearless knights who prefer frontline, destructive combat.
item.properties|f.overcharged_mixmaster: An industrial strength handheld mixer that is sure to stir things up.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_2a: Awesome\! I'll break it down for you in three easy lessons\: what it is, how it's used, and how you can get more.
item.properties|f.divine_mantle: A heavenly cloak thought to be once worn by celestial sages.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_5a: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_2a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more.  Few knights make it this far and can assemble an arsenal of such great power. \n\nNow then {0}, for your 5 Star Certification you must be currently equipped with a 5 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting shock. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_4: In order to venture deep enough to reach the Core you must visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 5 Star Certification.
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_2a: Speaking of 'below', how do I get there now?  This place is collapsing\!
conversation.properties|r.arc_mintut_1: I'm here to learn about the minerals found within the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3c: See Riley here in the Lab to purchase new harnesses. Once purchased, a harness is automatically added to your harness list in the battle sprite interface. \n\nAdditionally, any time you purchase a direct upgrade to a harness you own, it will be replaced by the superior harness.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2a: Once I make it to Haven I really can't come back?
pvp.properties|m.name: Name
logon.properties|m.server_error: A server error caused authentication to fail.
helptips.properties|m.graveyard: Graveyards are an unnatural place, a world between worlds where dark spirits gather, hungry for the life of any live soul that must pass through.  You must hurry and find the exit as fast as possible before these phantoms awaken and stalk you\!
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_2a: Lord Vanaduke rules over the citadel now.  His soul bound to some horrific armored prison. \n\nHe has the citadel ready for battle at all times, believing that his kingdom is still under siege.  He doesn't even realize that what he is trying to protect was lost a thousand years ago.
helptips.properties|m.lock_guard: Protect and heal yourself and teammates from damage with the Guardian Shield\! \n\nKeep enemies at bay with increased resistances to damage and attack with faster swords and bombs\!
conversation.properties|r.almire_histori: What have you learned about Almire?
mission.properties|o.welcome_to_haven: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_2a: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings. \n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
item.properties|f.obsidian_shard: A jet-black shard of unnatural stone. Holding it fills your head with imagery of a distant shore where waves crash against rocks that seem to writhe in the chill of the water.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: Four Ways to Bring About the End of the World
helptips.properties|m.atg_retraps: Some switches can reverse the direction of a trap wave. Now you can cross traps in both directions\!
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_1: Hello. I'm Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark and head of geological studies within the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.iron_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|b.axes_of_evil: A gremlin logging operation has been discovered in levels known as the 'Jigsaw Valley.'  These strangely carved islands are home to an even stranger species of twisting trees that gremlins seem to be determined to completely wipe out. \n\nSpiral HQ believes that gremlins are using the lumber from this operation as resources for the development of Project R and needs you to enter the Jigsaw Valley and shut it down.
item.properties|f.prize_box_blooming: Contains various unique costumes and accesories to celebrate the blooming nature of spring.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
mission.properties|m.search_continues_1a: {0}, I cannot thank you enough.  We've already established our research base and are collecting a tremendous amount of data that we would have never had without your efforts.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_5: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|b.choose_your_sprite: Morlin has prepared three of the battle sprites you rescued for you to evaluate. You have been authorized to choose one of these battle sprites and become bonded with it. This battle sprite will forever aid you in your future adventures, so choose wisely. \n\nThis mission cannot be repeated.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_8a: Yes, quite. These sprites have adapted the power to cloak, to use the very shadows around them for subterfuge. Between that and their newfound skills in toxins and debilitations, I'd say they could be quite handy on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.silent_nightblade: Crafted with some of the most devilish materials found on Cradle, this inky blade can explode with fiendish fury.
sprites.properties|d.magnify: Increases the reach and power of the ray of light.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_2: THEY WILL KILL US THEY WILL KILL YOU.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r4: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.proto_blade: A swift, compact utility blade issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A liberated set of schematics showing off the complete spec and scale of Project Roarmulus.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_2: Ok, here is the gist of it all- collect materials and recipes and turn them into weapons and gear.  Easy right?
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r9: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.polar_day_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending day patrols.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_return: Are you sure you want to return to {0}?
item.properties|f.bronze_bolt: A simple bronze bolt found everywhere throughout the Clockworks.
guild.properties|e.guild_deleted: Sorry, that guild has been disbanded.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_2a: Nice to meet you, {0}.  What's your situation?
item.properties|f.wild_hunting_blade: A legendary cutter feared by even the mightiest of Wolvers and Chromalisks.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_1a: This is it, recruit. This is the final gate that leads out of the Rescue Camp, through the chasm and into Haven. Once you pass through, you will never need to return here. You can buy everything found in the Rescue Camp and much more in Haven. \n\nAny questions?
mission.properties|b.built_to_destroy:
Once known to Spiral HQ as 'Project R,' the Roarmulus Twins have been identified as a gremlin-engineered weapon of tremendous power built with the sole purpose of destroying Haven.  Stored deep within the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory, this weapon is not only protected by hordes of shock-powered constructs and gremlins, but the factory is a highly dangerous, explosive hazard itself\! 

In addition to shutting down the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to recover the Alpha Squad recon module that is believed to be located somewhere within the factory. 

It is highly recommended that you form a full squad before deploying.
item.properties|f.gift_of_autumn: A rare charm cherished by travelers that fortifies the wearer during the winter season.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_suit: An advanced demolitions suit capable of resisting the strongest sleep mists. The soft glow is strangely stimulating.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
uplink.properties|m.wildwoods_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within this forest.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

This forest is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area.  Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible. 

Good luck\!
item.properties|f.dark_chaingun: A machine gun capable of firing a barrage of searing, shadow bolts.
guild.properties|m.storage_warning: WARNING\: Items left here can be taken by any guild member of the appropriate rank.
uplink.properties|m.firestorm_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, at your current depth establishing communications is difficult- I hope you receive this message.  You currently stand in the Firestorm Citadel, some kind of ancient fortress that this planet apparently like to collect.  It is an incredibly hostile region of the Clockworks, you will not last long without the right gear and a talented squad. 

We have detected a faint signal that indicates some kind of artifact of the Alpha Squad's expedition is located within the throne room of this citadel.  We need you to recover this artifact- it could be a valuable clue for discovering their current whereabouts. 

I won't lie to you, no squad that has taken this mission has managed to return from the citadel.  As you have no doubt seen, the place burns with an unnatural fire and a legion of similarly unnatural horrors roam every hall.  Now may be a good time to turn back and craft some fire-resistant gear.  A trial by fire will only get you burned. 

Good luck\!
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_mail: Superior plate mail forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It's restrictive, but incredibly strong.
helptips.properties|m.lichenous_lair: Lichens are strange, alien varieties of slimes thought to have arrived on this world in a large meteor.  While a single-cell colony is mostly harmless, they can quickly combine into a most terrible foe.  Keep them from mingling\!
item.properties|f.perfect_snowball: An icy snowball of almost mythical perfection. Though it begs to be thrown squarely into the side of someone's head, it would be best to use in alchemy.
item.properties|f.rename_knight: Allows you to choose a new name for your knight. This item is destroyed once used.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1a: Greetings, {0}. I imagine you have some questions about battle sprites. How can I assist you?
support.properties|m.option_203_0:
You have to be 13 years or older to play this game. If someone admits in chat that they are under 13 then please click here to file the complaint against them.

Do NOT use this option if you simply believe the player to be underage, as there has to be proof in the last few minutes of chat. If there is no proof, then you should drop the complaint. 

Please use common sense, if they claim to be 4 years old while typing perfectly as an example then that's clearly not true and you should not file the complaint.
helptips.properties|m.tut_charge: Hold [[?ACTION]] until fully charged and then release to attack\!
item.properties|f.master_blaster: This advanced sidearm is an excellent choice if your adventuring party happens to need another hero.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_sn: A curious snipe that will explore its surroundings.
conversation.properties|m.tier_done: Well met, {0}.  Having achieved the required rank, you are authorized to explore deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Good luck to you.
guildhelp.properties|m.storage_info: The Guild Storage acts like a community item bank. Guild members of the appropriate rank can add or remove equipment or items to the Storage as they see fit. It's a great way to share resources between guildmates, or to help out newer members\!\n WARNING\: Items placed in Guild Storage can be removed and claimed by any guild member with access to Guild Storage. Do not put items into Guild Storage that you want to keep for yourself\!
item.properties|f.salamander_suit: A suit crafted from the hide of a salamander. It grants the wearer the beast's natural resistance to fire.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_ultimate: Usage\: /{0} skill ultimate\nUpdates a sprite skill's ultimate value.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of crimsonite.
item.properties|f.plate_shield: A heavy iron shield adept at deflecting impacts that would otherwise leave you stunned.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_4a: (The lost soul continues to stare beyond you, saying nothing.)
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_1: I'd like to know how I can help.
item.properties|f.strike_needle: Plans to modify the Strike Needle for non-combat usage were shelved after a recruit accidentally riddled Lieutenant Feron's bunk with holes.
item.properties|f.maidens_tear: A sacred jewel cherished by Almirian knights.  Given to them by their beloved, it is said to keep them safe in battle.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_311da7: Hit the Whammie playing the Golden Prize Wheel.
chat.properties|m.usage_action: Usage\: /{0} command argument\nPosts an action to the scene controller.
projectx.properties|i.render_effects: Enables more detailed graphical effects, but\nmay reduce graphics performance with less powerful systems.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_1a: Alright, {0}, let's get started. Looks like you and I get to go on a little sprite hunt, eh? \n\nI've aligned my tracker with the recon knight intel but something's not right. The energy signature I'm detecting is erratic, but still definitely a battle sprite. They may be in trouble, so let's hurry\!
item.properties|f.drake_scale_shield: A solid shield shaped from stout scales.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale: An armored scale from what was thought to be an extinct creature. It reflects light with an otherworldly sheen.
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mask: A mask said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. The shattered ice will conceal your identity during clandestine arctic expeditions.
mission.properties|b.pumping_up: You are free to use the Advanced Training Hall whenever you like in order to practice with new weapons or learn about other unique features of the Clockworks.  Check it out and see what it has to offer\!
help.properties|m.support_1: You can access your account info, change your password and update your e-mail address on our official website.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
item.properties|f.raging_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to ride their rage into battle.
chat.properties|m.usage_zgo: Usage\: /{0} zone name\nMoves to the named zone.
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_hood: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
mission.properties|b.delved_too_deep: The truth has been revealed. It's time to update Intel Agent Kora and Spiral HQ about what you and Lieutenant Vaelyn have learned.
conversation.properties|r.rc_greet2_3a: I'll meet up with Rhendon before I investigate the generator.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Moorcroft Manor.
item.properties|f.prize_box_owlite: Contains unique Owlite costumes and accessories, recreated from the latest archaeological evidence. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.deadshot_mantle: A poncho for a pale rider with sights set on taking down the bad, ugly, undead denizens of the dark.
item.properties|f.divine_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
item.properties|f.graviton_charge: A small explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a vortex of crushing gravity.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_1a: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven.  To start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
chat.properties|m.usage_force_bug_report: Usage\: /{0} <knight name> [description]\nForces a bug report to be submitted from the player's client.
mission.properties|o.vile_engine: Locate and destroy the bizarre slime generators below the lichen colony
item.properties|f.jar_o_fireflies: A small jar of hibernating fireflies that can be released on a festive occasion.
item.properties|f.fire_raider_tunic: Treasure is at your fingertips and ash in your wake with this soot laden coat.
item.properties|f.aegis: A sublime shield entrusted to only the most worthy members of the Spiral Order. Whether its crest is a relic from the Order of old or a creation from the Knights' time on Cradle is not immediately clear.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of dark matter.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: One of them lobbed a spike at me\!
item.properties|f.green_ward: A sturdy shield with an emerald sheen that saves Spiral Knight recruits from the perils of sharp spikes and deadly toxins.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
guild.properties|e.design_full: Sorry, design mode is already occupied by the maximum number of editors.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_3: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap.\n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
mission.properties|o.p_testmission_1: Help us test this new content.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
item.properties|f.super_shard_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more depleted Crimsonite. The choicest cure for a combative creature is clearly a crystal to the cranium.
pvp.properties|m.love_unapprove_confirm: Are you sure? You will be able to make changes again, but the approval process will be started over.
board.properties|i.playprivate: Create a party that only friends and guildmates can join.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_1: I'll leave the next few areas to you. They are pretty overgrown, so keep your eyes peeled for monsters in the tall grass. Some of them are pretty adept at hiding in the shadows. Gives me the creeps just thinking about it really.
item.properties|f.crest_of_ur: A crest from the lost Legion of Ur, an elite band of fiendish warriors said to have once conquered the Underworld. Whomever holds it can faintly hear the sound of drums and the clomping of hooves.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_8: Yes indeed\!  That's because every time you transmute an item through alchemy, there is a chance you can get one of several Unique Variants that makes your item much more powerful\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_3a: {0}, it is my great honor, in the company of all those who support you and whom you serve, to award you the high rank of Vanguard of the Spiral Knights.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
item.properties|f.jelly_helm: Gelatinous headgear made from gooey guardians.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Who sent you infernal, iron assassins?  Was it Herex? It matters not. There are ways of finding out...
mission.properties|m.true_champion_4a: Yes, I suppose we just might.  Safe travels then, {0}.
guild.properties|i.guild_shop: Purchase guild furnishings and upgrades using funds from the Guild Treasury.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a temperamental warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_3: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_blu: A Spiral-issued light source typically used to illuminate special areas, or indicate the presence of a limited-time sale.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_2: Such bravery, such pluck\! Yes, perhaps with some luck you stand a chance against the terrible fiends that mean to destroy Winterfest dreams. \n\nSo note the addition of a Winterfest mission, take up your sword and I will grant you rewards\!
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_6a: I've heard some of the other Biotechs mention how much they wish to get the Skylark operational once again and return home.  I hear they're very grateful to Knights like you, {0}.
item.properties|f.voltech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires highly charged ionic bullets that split on impact.
item.properties|f.soul_dust: The dust of the departed. Whether it still retains any shred of a soul remains to be seen.
helptips.properties|m.candlestick_keep: Beware the horrible Grimalkins that lurk in the dark\!  These cursed wraiths cannot be destroyed and the only thing they truly fear is the light of the enchanted candles.  Light them with embers and take refuge in their shining embrace.
item.properties|f.snow_hat: A comfy winter hat, keeping you warm whether hunting frozen jellies or merely melting marshmallows in your hot chocolate.
mission.properties|o.the_flickering_flam: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_keyboard_m: Keyboard used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands,
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_stri: Greetings {0}, I'm Echo, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad striker.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on rapid, close-quarters combat. \n\nThe arsenal of a striker focuses on speed.  You want to get in close with your enemy, hit them hard and get out.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that leaps into battle ahead of your squad, striking first before they can even fire off a shot.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_0: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_bedazzling: Contains three bedazzling eye shapes for your style kit\: Flower, Blooming, and Sparkle.
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_description: Leave your party and venture out on your own.
helptips.properties|m.loading14: Do not share your account information. Game Masters will never ask you for your password.
helptips.properties|m.loading0: The basic play controls can be viewed at any time by pressing [[TOGGLE_HELP]].
item.properties|f.quilted_hunting_cap: A flexible helm lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells like animal.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_1a: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation. \n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_1: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 1 random variant.
mission.properties|r.collector_prisoner_: Yes, but can you tell me what happened?
social.properties|m.not_online: There is no knight named {0} online.
item.properties|f.storm_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so skilled, he could cut through lightning as it struck the ground.
item.properties|f.triglav: No stories have been told about this almighty blade, but that's only because people are rarely in the mood to talk after having been crushed by a mountain.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: You should get inside the town walls.  It's not safe out here.
item.properties|f.vial_shock_super: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_mouse_move: Mouse used for targeting, attacking, movement and menu navigation
item.properties|f.mechaknight_helm: A hardy helm handcrafted by Gremlin smiths to protect a Mecha Knight's control unit. With the control unit removed it fits a knight remarkably well.
item.properties|f.poison_barrier: Surrounds you with toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
item.properties|f.unstable_core: A hazardous hunk pulled from a fulminating foe. It hums menacingly.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Trespassers within my Arsenal?  I'll see to it you go... quietly.
item.properties|f.thwacker_shield: A shield repurposed by gremlins and worn by Darkfang Thwackers. Similar to the gremlins themselves, it is resistant to fire and shock attacks. Knights who use these shields report that is impossible to completely remove all the fur stuck to it.
uplink.properties|m.subject: SUBJECT
item.properties|f.blackened_crest: A shield once carried by a knight of Almire, now a cursed relic that has been nearly burned beyond recognition within the Firestorm Citadel. Very powerful alchemy would be required to restore it to its former glory.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_armor: A suit of armor worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_companion_cu: A sociable slime with uncontainable curiosity. (Limit 1 per hall).
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_3: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A fine display commemorating a knight's full acceptance into the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.budding_helm: This cracked biotech helm is home to a harmless decorative plant.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_2a: Smashing\! Then perhaps you and your mates will be of service to this lodge. You see, the alchemy machine you see before you can craft magnificent monster trophies for your Guild Hall. \n\nThe alchemy machines uses materials and crowns from your Guild Treasury and deposits the results into the Guild Treasury as well.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_shield: An antique shield whose origins have been lost to the passing of time.
helptips.properties|m.rescue_door_sk: I've almost got this door open. While I'm working at it, rescue the captive knights in the area\!
chat.properties|m.talk_self: Talking to yourself is a sign of insanity.
item.properties|f.scissor_blades: A custom made Leviathan Blade designed by Bechamel, the Accessorizor.  While these blades are typically used for crafting stylish accoutrements for armor, they are said to be powerful enough to cleave through solid rock.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those wolvers weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_4a: It's all a bit too convenient.  But do gremlins really have this kind of power?  I suspect something more than even what they are capable of engineering. \n\nIn any case, this Almire, it's not a kingdom any longer.  All that remains is a great citadel that seems to be engulfed in never-ending flames that Spiral HQ has been calling the 'Firestorm Citadel.'  From what we can tell, the whole place is swarming with undead and built like a fortress.
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: Click here to accept the listed trade, and buy energy with crowns.
shop.properties|m.purchaseWindowDepotAd: Out of energy? Get more in the supply depot\!
item.properties|f.vial_shock: A glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_shade_: A helm of fire retardant fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they hide in heated hallways.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_4a: If what Parma said is true then we're the last line of defense against The Swarm. {0}, I won't lie but this might change everything. We'll need to pass this on to Spiral HQ immediately. I'll round everyone up and send you a mission to accept when you're ready.
projectx.properties|m.find_rhendon: Find and talk to Rhendon to gain access to missions.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Then scour the Clockworks for those wretched kats and destroy them\! Even if they ate the books you will be able to recover the Ancient Pages. These pages can be given to Montague in exchange for rewards. Help us and we'll help you\! \n\nBlack kats can be found randomly when encountering spookats in Tier 2 and Tier 3 (Arcade Gates and Missions). There is also a daily Prestige Mission that likely leads to a black kat nest.
item.properties|f.virulent_seedling: This small, dangerous plant has been weaponized by biotechs so that it spreads a cloud of toxic spores on detonation. Don't let the size fool you, it packs several kiloaudreys of power.
item.properties|f.splinter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in a synthetic mineral. Prone to shattering, the otherwise useless material in this bomb is perfect for giving foes a nasty splinter.
mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4b: I think I've got it thanks for-
support.properties|m.subheader_step208: Hacking is when someone is trying to get a hold of your account name or password, or already has done this.\n\nThe vast majority of hacking issues, aren't actually hacking, but careless sharing of accounts or passwords. You should never share your password with anyone for any reason. Game Masters will never ask for it either.
projectx.properties|i.vsync:
Synchronizes the game display with the monitor's
output to help prevent screen tearing,
but may affect framerate with less 
powerful systems.
item.properties|m.item_lockable: This item will bind to you when equipped.\n
item.properties|f.storm_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a bolt of lightning from the heavens.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_2a: Always be on your guard. Who knows what other dangers await us on this world?
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight2_1a: Emanations from this world's core have had strange effects on our battle sprites.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_6a: Something has happened\!  That door just popped up behind you like a trap\! \n\nDefend yourself, {0}\!
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_w: Glorp\! Glorp\! Winterfest is saved and one thing is clear\: all hearts now sing with holiday cheer\!
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_crown: Ruggedly royal regalia recently reproduced from regally resinous remains.
item.properties|f.member_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Member rank and up.
item.properties|f.fiery_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a dense cloud of highly combustible, searing dust.
guild.properties|log.energy_removed: Withdrew {0} energy from the energy well (new total\: {1}).
mission.properties|b.faith_armor:
An apprentice named Wilks who had just arrived from a Rescue Camp has found himself in what Spiral HQ calls a 'Trap Chamber.'  These levels of most likely gremlin design seem to be specifically built to trap and ultimately eliminate those attempting to explore the Clockworks. 

Wilks probably didn't know what he had got himself into until it was too late.  Now he's stuck somewhere in the chamber and needs your help. 

Some traps can be avoided and sometimes you may find that you just have to take the hit. In saving Wilks, you will no doubt learn the true value of strong armor.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Well, I won't dishonor them by giving up now. We've come so far after all. 'Time to be a hero again\!' Right, {0}?
helptips.properties|m.energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to spend energy on this device.
guild.properties|log.room_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
support.properties|m.option_207_0: If you believe someone is maliciously trying to scam you, then please click here to send the complaint. You may want to inform this player they have been complained that way other players around you can hear this too and take precaution.
item.properties|f.sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_1a: There you are, {0}\!  I was beginning to think you wouldn't show up\! \n\nOk, let's get to work securing this place.  But first, you'll need to equip that Proto Bomb I gave you.  Head over to the Arsenal Station behind me and equip it.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_hard: Elite difficulty features an exceptional challenge for fearless players who have mastered combat. Monsters and traps are very deadly. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are greatly increased.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r6: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.bristling_buckler: A small shield spiked to supplement your sword in a skirmish.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_2_2: The gates are as good as opened, Lieutenant\!
item.properties|f.glowing_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns bright enough to light a darkened room.
board.properties|m.auto_create_party: Sorry, we could not find you an available party. Do you want to start your own party?
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven. \n\nTo start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_4: Good luck to you then.  Shadow Lairs will be the greatest challenge you will face yet.
sprites.properties|d.five_alarm: Increases the duration and size of the firestorm.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s:
We got enough that Anomalie let me mess around with a few. 

See, I had this handgun chassis from an old import.  Cool little launcher, but impossible to get parts for, especially the ammo. 

Well, with a little wrenching and a little creative misapplication of thermodynamics, I converted it into a pretty peppy little Spike Slicer\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3a: No, you won't be able to return. Once you reach Haven your training is complete and your new objective will be to aid the Spiral Knights who are now based in Haven.
pvp.properties|m.love_reupload_layer: Uploading a new file for the selected level. Other layers may be updated\!
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_1: Well met, knight.  Before you lies elevators leading to what Spiral HQ are calling 'Shadow Lairs.'  Shadow Lairs contain some of the most powerful monsters in the Clockworks, so be sure that you are fully Tier 3 equipped before going any further.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_4: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.captain_coat: A seaworthy greatcoat outstanding for spaceage swordplay.
item.properties|f.power_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.sacred_hazard_armor: A sturdy suit of armor for those who want to shoot some slimes.
item.properties|f.token_forge: A small wisp of the essential spirit of technology and progress. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
dungeon.properties|m.final_test_2_desc: The route to Haven is suspended high above a perilous clockwork chasm. Prepare yourself, danger is sure to lurk around every corner\!
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_3: Now that you have a grasp of using pickups, let's apply what you've learned in a combat environment.
item.properties|f.serene_armor: An ancient suit of armor weathered by the elements. While standing in this armor you can sense the far-off tremors caused by the migration of countless tortodrones journeying to lands unknown.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_3a:
Aye, as do we all. 

Now then, {0}, you need to prepare for what's to come.  Reaching the Core is only the beginning for us.  I suspect that Spiral HQ will be issuing you many more missions in the future that could only be taken on by someone of your ability. 

And finally, it is my pleasure to inform you that you will soon be awarded one of the greatest honors of the Spiral Knights, the rank of Vanguard.  I will see you in the Hall of Heroes.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_1a: What is this place and what are you talking about?
item.properties|f.plasma_cell: A high-tech plasma source that could positively blind someone with science.
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc1: You may only rename your knight every 30 days.
item.properties|f.celestial_saber: A special saber said to resemble Isoran spacefarers of old as they sliced across the night sky. With this equipped, your foes are sure to see stars.
mission.properties|b.sewer_stash: It seems that the Ironclaw Munitions Factory is not the only place gremlins are storing high-powered weaponry.  Intel suggests that once manufactured, weapons are moved out of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory and stored in secret weapon caches throughout the Clockworks. \n\nOne of these caches has been uncovered in one of the Clockwork's wasteworks systems.  It's likely not going to be pretty reaching it, but eliminating the weapons stored in these wasteworks could result in far fewer casualties in the future.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I worked my employees hard to get where I am today.
guild.properties|m.warn_in_default: WARNING\: Your guild is in default\!
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Hello {0}, it seems you had few problems with the oozing hordes and their like which can no doubt be chalked up to a good education on their behaviors prior to the mission.
guild.properties|m.confirm_demote: Are you sure you want to demote {0} to {1}?
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: A sprite's appetite will increase naturally over time, though slowly. To increase appetite quickly, take it for a run in the Clockworks. Absorbing heat from monsters is a great way to burn calories\!
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5a: I'd like to go over your energy tutorial one more time.
item.properties|f.peppermint_repeater: This holiday hand cannon is the proper piece to pepper your opponents with hot lead of holiday cheer.
item.properties|f.iron_slug: Only the most frightening of foes can withstand the crippling paralysis caused by the magnum force of the Iron Slug's sudden impact. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
guild.properties|log.expansion_added: Added the {0} expansion for {1} crowns, plus {2} crowns for pro-rated upkeep.
logon.properties|m.paying_customers_only: This server is only available to customers who have spent at least $4.95 on Energy in the last three months.
item.properties|f.virulent_catalyzer: The incorporation of Spiral technology has given this harrowing handgun a powerfully poisonous payload. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_1a: I have lingered in halls even after all these long centuries, denied my eternal rest by my cursed lord. I feel his spirit clinging onto this shattered realm even now. He refuses to leave and thus dooms us all.
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting freeze. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires 50 Golden Slime Coins or equivalent crowns.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_3: These shelters will offer you two choices\: exit the mountain and claim some Grinchlin treasure, or press on further up the mountain. \n\nShould you press on, you pass on the loot in that shelter, but will find even more treasures at the next shelter.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_c: I always carry a blaster, never know when it might come in handy.
mission.properties|m.verify_exchange: Confirm these items to be exchanged for the Mission Rewards.
logon.properties|m.deadbeat: Please go to https\://billing.spiralknights.com/billing to resolve a reversed payment.
helptips.properties|m.loading7: If you are on fire you will take damage regularly until the fire wears off. That can't stop you from spreading it to monsters though. Get close and share the love\!
item.properties|f.toxic_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that produces a choking poisonous cloud.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef
mission.properties|m.new_threat_12a: Hmm, most of our sensor equipment seems to have been damaged.  It might take some time to get things working to the point where I can track down the Artifact.  While we work on that, you should get in contact with one of our Biotechs, Hahn.  He's a little rough around the edges, but he can help you prepare for the challenges you'll likely face. \n\nI'll contact you later as soon as I have my tracking equipment back online\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b631f6: Power up a derelict Mecha Knight.
social.properties|m.confirm_go_solo: Are you sure you want to continue on alone?
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_4: Then you are brave as well traveler. You can find my kinsfolk throughout the whole of this court. Be very careful though, for Vanaduke's terrible minions are guarding them. Many patrol the main drag, so watch your back as you move about.\n\nOnce you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. When six others are reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.
item.properties|f.proto_duelist: A six-shot firearm preferred by the marksmen of Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_a: We may not have power, but the least I can do is get a fire going to provide a little light tonight.
item.properties|f.power_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_1a: Hello there, {0}.  The name's Konway.  Spiral HQ says you're in need of some additional pointers to help you out on your upcoming missions.  Care to meet me in the Advanced Training Hall for the rundown?
mission.properties|o.from_below: Find and save the squad of Recon Rangers
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
sprites.properties|d.concussive_firebolt: Adds a chance for a powerful stun to the firebolt.
helptips.properties|m.atg_pplate: Pick up and place a STATUE on a PRESSURE PLATE to keep doors open.
support.properties|m.item_granted_messag: You have been granted an item. Click below to claim.
helptips.properties|m.danger_module: Warning\! The path beyond this point is far more dangerous than what you would expect on this level. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I don't think anyone will notice I'm missing.
logon.properties|m.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in on the website again and relaunch the game.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_gr: A short torch filled with ghastly green fire.
item.properties|f.ironwood: A pristine log of one of the hardest substances known to the Spiral Knights.
mission.properties|r.new_chapter_3a: Thanks Kora, I'll do my best\!
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_6a: On the east side we have a couple of combat practice rooms. These Training Cubes are mostly harmless and are perfect for experimenting with your weapons and shield techniques\!
guild.properties|l.gl_save_progress: Saving guild log to the desktop...
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_snipe: A quietly resting snipe that will stay where it's placed.
conversation.properties|m.rescued_strang: Hello little one.  You will find there are many dangers in this new world but also many opportunities for the adventurous and brave\!  A fellow of yours awaits you just up the path.  We will undoubtedly see each other again.  Farewell for now\!
item.properties|f.heavy_shard_bomb: A solid chunk of depleted Crimsonite with an explosive surprise inside. Everybody loves surprises\!

mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.

These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!

mission.properties|b.work_idle_hands:
Devilites are a type of fiend that seem to have a very rigid corporate structure that governs their every action.  Recon Knights have discovered a series of devilite 'offices' throughout the Clockworks, typically found in the remains of an alien city. 

Analysis of the data collected from these offices indicates that devilite corporations are outsourced by gremlins in order to design and manage various projects that include weapons specifically engineered to target Spiral Knight squads. 

It's time these devilites were issued pink slips and their fiendish projects cancelled.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Hello {0}, I'm Remi, a knight who specializes in bombs and explosives.  The recipes I have for you are pretty straightforward- producing weapons and gear that focus on blowing up your enemies to smithereens\! \n\nUsing bombs isn't a fire and forget kind of affair though.  Bombs require an understanding of timing, both before and after you drop one, in order to get the most bang for your buck.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad sends in to take down many enemies at once.  Bombs are great for clearing out a mob of beasties in one swift KA-BOOM\!

mission.properties|m.silent_legion_2a: I could swear I heard them just now, their voices carrying in the wind.  No longer screams, no longer cries- whispers.  Indecipherable even in the stillness of this place.  Are they leaving me here?  Why must I be left behind? \n\nYou... I warned you not to proceed, to stay away from me.  Now you'll learn what they did... that those who are close to me die\!

He disappeared into the Clockworks soon after Biscotti delivered the last crate of batter. With the Anniversary celebrations at stake once again, Biscotti needs some culinary champions to help her sort out this mix-up\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_3a: When our technicians finally got the Skylark's communications systems online, we could not establish a link with the Alpha Squad and they have never been heard from since. Its skills focus on subterfuge\: caustic quills fire poisonous quills that explode when followed with an attack, shadow cloak allows a knight to become invisible to monsters, and hexing haze allows the knight to inflict monsters with a timed damage blast. \n\nThe maskeraith is best suited for knights who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks.
