conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_345: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
auction.properties|e.auction_bid: The auction may not be cancelled, it already has a bid.
sprites.properties|d.enduring_light: Increases the duration of the ray of light.
helptips.properties|m.alpha_recon: This recon module was left by a member of the Alpha Squad.  The recording it contains has been copied to your Arsenal.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2a: What happened here? These remains look to be hundreds of years old...
item.properties|f.exp_east_4f: An expansion that adds three rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.bio_helm: An air-tight helm designed by biotechs for collecting field samples or working in toxic greenhouses.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
uplink.properties|m.ignite_reward: Hail, {0}\! As part of a special promotion with Ignite, you're entitled to receive a bonus pack of items designed to give you a head start on the great adventure before you\! Attached is a special suit of armor and an array of fiery weapons. \n\nSee you in the Clockworks\!
chat.properties|m.away_set: Auto-response message set. Use /back to turn it off.
helptips.properties|m.tut_chromalisks: Those chroma whelps up ahead can lash you with their tongues from afar. Avoid facing them when they get ready to strike.
item.properties|f.furni_rainbow: A magnificent arc of refracted light. What does it mean?
item.properties|f.frenzy_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used frenzy to carve whole worlds from stone.
item.properties|f.illuminating_ward: A personal candle for warding off the darkness, and that which lurks within it.
item.properties|f.paper_mask: A simple paper {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's not well made and eventually falls apart.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_fiend_: I've got a case of the Mondays.
item.properties|f.trinket_slot_upgrade: Once used, this upgrade opens a trinket slot for {0} days.
item.properties|f.snarbolax_cap: A shadowy cap made from the hide of a sinister Snarbolax.  Even looking at it too closely is dangerous.
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_bra: The path to Haven allows you to escape this perilous mountain and collect a haul of Grinchlin treasures along the way\! \n\nHowever, should you decide to pass on it now and continue up the mountain, even greater treasures await...
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Welcome to the Moorcroft Archives, traveler. Here you will find an illustrious collection of ancient grimoires from many forgotten worlds. It's quite the sight, I know\! \n\nYou're free to look around but please don't touch- some of these books are filled with incredible mystic power. You could hurt yourself\!
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: Gremlins\!? Am I reading this data right? An ambush\!? How were they able to trick our sensors?
auction.properties|e.bid_insufficient: You must bid at least {0} crowns.
item.properties|f.calibur: A standard issue sword awarded to Spiral Knights who have proven themselves in the field.
item.properties|f.shadow_key: A mysterious key that grants a party entrance to Shadow Lairs.  A Shadow Key is destroyed once used.
mission.properties|b.time_enough_at_last: A knight named Edger has gone missing while exploring the Scarlet Fortress.  Given that this crumbling castle is swarming with spookats and jelly cubes, his squadmates fear for his safety and have asked a more experienced knight like yourself to investigate. \n\nLocate Edger within the fortress and bring him back to Haven\!
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_or: A short, elegant street lamp that emits an orange glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.crystal_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in an alloy of Moonstone and Valestone. Its soothing shade of cerulean has been clinically proven to both calm knights and annihilate the undead.
chat.properties|m.usage_trade: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message on the trade channel.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_nature_sprit: A spirit of Nature willing to wander rather than follow the guide of the Spirit Mother.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: Welcome to our camp\! Have a seat by the campfire if you want a little break.
item.properties|f.hex_visor: It's said a fly could dodge anything with eyes like these. Too bad you're not a fly.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_5b: And don't worry about applying skill points the 'wrong way,' since you will eventually gain enough skill points to max out all your skills\!
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r6: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_spec: Hi there {0}, I'm Zebulon, a knight who utilizes specialty gear that is suited for specific scenarios.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons that target specific monster families and gear that has mixed defense types. \n\nSometimes what you really need is a sword that smites the undead or armor that raises your slime smashing proficiency.  The gear I specialize in is often built for a specific task, but is also great to mix and match with other sets.  Experiment\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_gunn: Howdy {0}, the name's Daxen. I'm a knight who specializes in gunslinging.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on ranged combat... you know, shootin' stuff. \n\nHandguns allow you to hit your enemies from a safe distance, but don't offer you many options once they close in on ya.  You've got to think and shoot fast to be a good gunslinger.  The gear I specialize in will make you a dead shot, not a dead knight.
item.properties|f.valestone: A fabled mineral of a vibrant, green color said to contain the essence of all natural life.
item.properties|f.nightblade: A short slicer infused with the essence of the Underworld.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dazed: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Dazed style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_1: Yes, but this time you need to let me-
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_8a: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
sprites.properties|d.seraphynx: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies divine light. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat with protection and restoration.
mission.properties|o.occurance_at_owlite: Locate the ancient tome within the haunted Owlite keep
item.properties|f.stranger_robe: A robe once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
item.properties|f.stone_tortoise: A large, powerful shield made to resemble a creature's shell. Its formidable weight can make attacking more difficult.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_2a: First dragons and now... little winged feline creatures? I can't believe we're seeing this phenomenon again\!
item.properties|f.ignition_helm: A lightweight helmet augmented to keep a knight's head cool under pressure.
mission.properties|o.sewer_stash: Destroy the gremlin war machines hidden in the wasteworks
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_1a: Tell me what you know about the gremlins.
item.properties|f.zapper: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity electrical charge.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: Emberlight founded by gremlin outcasts from Great Colony. Gremlins of Emberlight not obey the Iron Law, so flee or die. We start over with Emberlight. New colony home to few of us\: most ex-schemers, some merchants, some fighters, all traitors in eyes of Great Colony gremlins.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of moonstone
guild.properties|e.leave_current_first: You must leave your current guild before accepting this invitation.
helptips.properties|m.loading10: If you become shocked you will regularly spasm from the electricity coursing through your body. This will interrupt anything you are doing.
monster.properties|m.punkin_intro_2: What does the Punkin King have for thee...?
item.properties|f.wooly_onesie: An itchy yet warm set of pajamas for knights to wear at night. {0}
item.properties|f.padded_cap: A one size fits all light helm that is typically worn by gunslingers.
item.properties|f.prize_box_obsidian: Contains various unique and terrifying items found within the realm of the Apocrea. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_vest: Wearing this stunningly stellar vest allows you to guide others to safety in even the darkest corners of space.
helptips.properties|m.tut_shrubs: Try clearing out these shrubs. Plants and other destructible objects often hide treasures.
helptips.properties|m.loading16: Using a shield can help you completely avoid damage, so make sure to use it\! Press "[[DEFEND]]" to defend. As the shield takes damage it will turn red and eventually break. The shield must regenerate before it can be used again.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_3a: Over here we have a collection of valuable items and objects you will likely find in the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.luminite_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.vial_fire_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
mission.properties|o.becoming_champion: Speak with Lieutenant Feron via Comlink
item.properties|f.perplexing_element: A rare metal recovered from a shattered mountain deep within the realm of the Apocrea. Under a microscope it reveals to have a kind of impossible geometry. Perhaps more dedicated study, free from the distractions of the world would reveal its secrets.
mission.properties|d.supply_depot_explan: The Supply Depot is full of items for sale. As you complete missions, more items will become available.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_armor: A sturdy set of Cobalt Armor reforged for additional comfort and protection.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_zombie_bellh: A bellhop with unusual dedication in charge of carrying luggage to a guest's quarters. Most just offer to carry the bags themselves.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_2a:
You're eager, that's good.  Your current mission is to reach the town of Haven where Spiral HQ has set up base.  Spend the time you need within the Rescue Camp to prepare yourself for your journey to come. 

Make use of any traveling merchants as well as the knowledge of other knights in the camp to learn how to survive in this new world.  I will contact you again once you reach Haven. 

Good luck to you.
design.properties|e.current_room: That is the currently installed room.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_shield: A huge reinforced shield perfect for brushing off blows and fending off foes.
projectx.properties|m.heatsummary: Heat levels up your weapons and gear and  makes them stronger.
item.properties|f.gun_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gun puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might give you the run around\!
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_5a: It seemed like the world itself tried to trap you back there, what a close call\! \n\nKeep your wits about you when you go off exploring the Ancient Generator below.  If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters and rigged with traps, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: I love getting out in the field.
pvp.properties|m.start_soon: Your {0} game will be starting soon...
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_su: A Salamander Suit reinforced with sturdy plates of volcanic iron. Extremely protective, and usable as a makeshift stove during long deployments.
item.properties|f.heavenly_iron_helm: A powerful helm said to be crafted from angelic shields.  It retains many divine properties celestial beings possess but lacks their weakness to fire.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_2: I've heard Spiral HQ has lined up for you some missions befitting a true Champion.  But in order to become one, you'll need the right gear. \n\nI am entrusting you with the tools you will need to become such a Champion.  With these recipes, you can craft the highest caliber of gear of the Spiral Order.  With it you can finally wear the armor of the Azure Guardian, wield the might of the Leviathan Blade, and face anything in the protection of the Aegis.
item.properties|m.in_style_kit: (This modifier is also present in your style kit.)
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
logon.properties|m.downtime: Gremlins have knocked the game out of service. Please check back soon.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_7a: Hsst\! So, you're the ones who defeated Razwog and took what was mine.  You are not worthy of possessing this powerful Artifact and so I am here to relieve you of it.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_easy: Normal difficulty features challenges suitable for any player.
item.properties|f.empty_room: An empty Guild Hall room with standard flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
sprites.properties|d.deadly_shadow_cloak: Gain an attack power and attack speed bonus when shadow cloak activates. Bonus lasts for a short duration after shadow cloak expires.
item.properties|f.celestial_vortex: A Celestial Bomb modified with a payload of a dying sun. Foes caught in its fiery blast radius are shown a glimpse of the dawn of creation.
item.properties|f.black_kat_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.primal_ore: An extraordinary metal imbued with the savage spirit of the wild.
help.properties|m.controls_chat: Press [[CHAT_START]] to enter chat or commands. Type /help into your chat window for a list of commands.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
item.properties|f.prize_box_spiraltail: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Monkey\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
sprites.properties|d.heavy_smoke: Increases the defensive power and duration of the flame barrier.
uplink.properties|m.instructions: Listed below are gifts that you may send to other Knights.  Select a gift and enter the name of the Knight you wish to receive the gift.  Giving is easy\!
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1b: What services can I find here? (Follow Tylen)
uplink.properties|m.login_event: Hail, {0}\! Thanks for playing Spiral Knights\! As part of a special event, please accept the attached rewards to aid you in your adventures\! \n\nAnd don't forget to check out the Supply Depot for more rare items and special offers\!
helptips.properties|m.tg_welcome: Welcome to the Training Ground, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
mission.properties|o.darkest_forces: Learn about the most powerful fiend and undead monsters
town.properties|m.rescue_camp_desc: The Rescue Camp serves as a refuge for newly dropped Spiral Knights. It offers a few creature comforts as well as a training facility to prepare recruits for their journey to Haven.
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_2a: You and me both. Now let's get- \n\nHold on, something's not right. Brace yourself, I think we've got company\!
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the evil master of munitions within the gremlin's all-powerful Crimson Order  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_2: This is a party pad. It's a big floor button that only activates when all members of the party are standing on it. They often open doors, but sometimes there is a little more to it than that...
sprites.properties|d.violent_heart_attac: Targets destroyed while enchanted create an explosion.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_2a: It should, there're plenty of new recruits that chatter about them constantly. They're like heroes to some knights. \n\nThe Alpha Squad was an elite squad of knights that Ozlo personally selected to first enter the Clockworks in an effort to locate the source of the massive energy signal below.  Because all systems on the Skylark were offline for several weeks, radio communication was not possible.  Instead, they left a series of recon modules throughout their travels, sort of like a breadcrumb trail.
item.properties|f.spike_shower: A powerful device designed to shred opponents with a snarl.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_2a: I bet. I guess you'll have to fill me in for once\!
item.properties|f.battle_chef_hat: A hat worn by the knights who work in the Skylark's galley. Not to be trifled with, these chefs are blade masters on and off the battlefield.
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_1a: Sure Konway, I'll head right over.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_roarmulus: The monitor shows readouts coming from a prototype of a massive war machine labeled "Project R".
mission.properties|b.shadow_beast:
Spiral HQ has detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within the Gloaming Wildwoods.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Gloaming Wildwoods is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area. Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible.
helptips.properties|m.lost_knights: You have discovered the missing knights...
pvp.properties|m.removed: Your coliseum signup has been cancelled.
item.properties|f.scale_mail: A shimmering set of serpentine scales woven into a suit of armor.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.guild_members_100: Allows your guild to recruit up to 100 members\!
item.properties|f.confetti_summer: When thrown, this summer confetti makes you feel all warm inside.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_1: {0}\! Am I glad to see you\!  Things are getting pretty bad down here.
mission.properties|o.securing_camp: Find and talk to Rhendon to gain access to missions.
uplink.properties|m.generic_change: Something changed and we had to change things. Please accept this attachment as a replacement. Sorry for the inconvenience.
item.properties|f.humbug_hat: A horrible hat worn by those who truly loathe the magic of Winterfest. The only possible explanation for this feeling is having a heart two sizes too small.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_baa4bd: Become a premiere elite select platinum plus priority member in the Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club.
mission.properties|b.dreams_and_nightmar: Respond to the distress signal from the Core Terminal. We have no intel on what to expect. \nThis is a dangerous mission. Prepare for anything.
social.properties|m.play_pvp: Sign up for a game of {0} {1} in the Coliseum\!
item.properties|f.padded_armor: A loose-fitting set of light armor that is typically worn by gunslingers.
item.properties|f.shadowsun_slicker: An evil duster that is said to harbor a great power that feeds off of the unforgiven sins of its owners.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning: The server will be rebooted in {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|f.prize_box_solstice: Contains various unique items that celebrate the Solstice\! Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
social.properties|e.cannot_friend_gm: You can't be friends with a Game Master. They are like stone.
exchange.properties|m.opening_mobile: Opening mobile phone checkout in your browser...
conversation.properties|m.test_greeter_1: You here for some testing?  Ok, make sure you read up on the latest info regarding what to test on the Test Server board in the official Spiral Knights forums.  Thank you, move along.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|o.go_shopping_b: Help out a knight in trouble
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_danger: The Grinchlins have sabotaged Winterfest for the last time. Take the fight to them\!
item.properties|f.arthro_pod: A streamlined helmet fashioned after the tough chitin of a beetle's carapace.
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_helm: A reliable helmet that's charged with protecting your skull from any unpleasant jolts.
item.properties|f.auto_turret_kit: Deploys an auto turret that fires at nearby hostiles
item.properties|f.confetti_leaf: A fantastic party favor used in forest festivities.
item.properties|f.lite_shield: A lightweight knight light that offers holistic protection.
item.properties|f.voltaic_radical_mask: A mask said to be replicated by a sentient mechaknight. The internal gyros and shock crest are sure to obscure your identity.
projectx.properties|i.full_inspect: Allow other knights to inspect all your equipped items.
item.properties|f.irontech_bomb: A heavy bomb wrapped in thick iron plates. Though it is slower than most bombs, it packs a powerful punch.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r4: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_rit: 'With great practice and tender care, with an eternal heart and mind so pure\: sharpen the stone, sturdy the chain, welcome the night, drink the Cup of Kings.'
item.properties|f.prismatech_alchemer_mk: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of photonic liquid at an increased rate.
item.properties|f.fusion_blaster: An enhanced elemental blaster designed to banish creatures that lurk in the shadows.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_4a: Uh, I think these sprites are studying these old books. I didn't even know they could read\! \n\nAnyway, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. I see more empty transport crates; not good. You go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_subject: Krogmo Coins earned in The Coliseum\!
item.properties|f.hazardous_brigandine: Padded armor that seems to emphasize the high mortality rate of the elite Scarlet Scouts. Scarlet Scouts need to travel light and fast in order to stay ahead of lesser skilled squads.
mission.properties|b.becoming_champion: Having heard of your many accomplishments and successful missions completed for Spiral HQ, Lieutenant Feron would like to speak with you.
item.properties|f.exp_east_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.spiral_pith_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.

mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_3a: Thanks Bosco\!  I'll gather some recipes and get crafting\!

mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: But what about you and the others?

Remember, you can exchange the Cake Slices you receive for awesome cake helms from Maskwell in the Haven Town Square. It's just like that old baker's saying, 'Wear the hide of your fallen foes to prove your might as a warrior\!'

projectx.properties|m.suggestion_submit_: Suggestion submitted. Thanks for your feedback.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_9a: If so, we must prevent further damage.  Now please, there are yet more sprites to be rescued.  And who knows what we'll discover when we get there\!
item.properties|f.valkyrie_helm: A priceless helmet whose name denizens of the Underworld dare not mention.
item.properties|m.trinket_tip_locked: Trinket Slot (Buy Trinket Slot Upgrade to Unlock)
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We're in\!  This is it\!
item.properties|f.reaper_rib: A bone stained black by the wickedness of its former possessor.
helptips.properties|m.dead: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to cycle to Spectator View.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_a: I just need to rest a bit before moving on.
mission.properties|r.ending_in_fire_2a: What have you got for me?
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: Come get warm by the fire.
item.properties|f.freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
item.properties|f.phantamos: A powerful handgun brimming with dark energy. The Phantamos represents one of the most recent additions to the Spiral Knight's arsenal, as containing shadow energy of this degree took a great deal of research.
exchange.properties|m.fee: For every trade, the energy seller pays the {0}% trading fee from the crowns.
item.properties|f.wolver_cap: A lively hat made from significantly less lively Wolver hide.

If you want weapons that will shake the heavens, then mastery level alchemy is what you need. \n\nOnce you craft an item into its 4 and 5 star incarnation, you unlock that item's true hidden potential.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks. These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team. conversation.properties|m.lab_knight3_1a: We managed to pull the secondary generator from the Skylark mostly intact. Unfortunately it's barely powerful enough to keep this lab running, let alone power our ship.  We'll need to find another power source if we ever hope to return home.

item.properties|f.heavenly_guardian_helm: A brilliant, white helm belonging to a heavenly warrior.

conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_2a: My knowledge is yours, little one.

conversation.properties|r.hunter_2a: Ah, so it's a team effort?

item.properties|f.seraphic_mail: A beautiful mail coat that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.

item.properties|f.grey_owlite_shield: A resplendent replica of the shield thought to have been issued to the most eminent of Owlite wizards. Wielding it fills you with righteous vengeance.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_8a: Parma was the youngest of the bunch, a very talented Recon, but with little combat experience.  She and I went to academy together and I can remember the day when the simulator technicians had thought their program was busted due to Parma's performance.  She actually apologized\! \n\nBut still, I'm worried about her.  From the reports that I've read, the Clockworks are unlike anything we've ever encountered.  I only hope that as she keeps them informed of what's ahead, that they will watch her back.
item.properties|f.trojan_armor: The armor of the stalwart Spiral Wardens is said to give great comfort to other knights. Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.

uplink.properties|m.royal_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad within this palace.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Royal Jelly Palace is a strange place.  It appears to be some sort of castle that slimes have re-purposed as a residence for members of their oozing aristocracy.  Known as a 'Royal Jelly,' these noble slimes are said to rule over their countless loyal subjects with an iron fist-shaped appendage. 

Our intel suggests that the module is located somewhere near an enormous concentration of slimes, so it is reasonable to believe that it may be the 'throne room' of a Royal Jelly.  If so, be prepared for a fearsome fight- Royal Jellies are quick to anger and love to throw their enormous weight around.  Your best bet is to find a way to suppress their natural regenerative abilities. 

Good luck\!
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_suit: A Salamander Suit imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_coba: Well met, {0}.  I'm Jorin, a knight who has mastered the standard issue Spiral Knight gear.  The recipes I have for you produce very reliable weapons and gear. \n\nJust because your weapons don't output fancy special damage types or your armor defends from status conditions doesn't mean you can't shake it in the Clockworks.  The gear I specialize in is good for just about any situation.  It will keep you alive and packs a punch on almost any monster that comes your way.
item.properties|m.add_more_success: Add more fire crystals to increase chance of forge success and bonuses\!
item.properties|m.item_lock_acquire: This item will bind to you when acquired.\n
item.properties|f.raiment: A long, flowing battle garb best accessorized with a pair of angelic wings.
mission.properties|b.another_trace: The technicians in the Haven Laboratory report that their tracking system has finally been repaired and brought back online. Intel Agent Kora would like to bring you up to speed on the challenges ahead. Contact her via comlink for the details.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_8a: Well, that's the end of the tour, {0}. Would you like me to go over that again or are you ready to try everything out for yourself?

mission.properties|b.alien_ooze: One of our field research teams is under siege from a large colony of lichens. Lichens are an alien species of the slime family thought to have come to the Clockworks via a meteor that crashed on to the surface of Cradle.  This particular species of slime is formed from innumerable smaller slimes that form mobile, sentient 'colonies.' \n\nLichen colonies can further combine to form larger and larger versions of themselves, rapidly evolving a range of deadly claws and barbs.  Prevent them from combining at all costs and save the research team\!

mission.properties|m.new_threat_11a: Oh my\!  What is the connection between these gremlins and that Artifact anyway?

By purchasing an Expansion, you will unlock the missions included in the Expansion to play as often as you like. 

Unlocking an Expansion unlocks it for all knights on the account. 

Only players who have unlocked an Expansion Mission may join an Expansion Mission. 

Expansion Mission rewards cannot be sold, dropped or traded.

This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!

conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_9a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!

item.properties|f.sulfur: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_1a: Surprise\! Looks like you took the bait. That's good, because I needed test subjects for my latest invention.
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_1a: Congratulations on becoming a Soldier, {0}\!  I hear you really gave that Snarbolax a clobbering, well done\! \n\nWe've had an opportunity to analyze Euclid's recon module you discovered in the Snarbolax's lair.  Based on the recording, it seems that Euclid suspected something our Geo Knights discovered sometime after the crash- that the levels within the Clockworks are comprised of terrain from multiple alien worlds\!

mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!

item.properties|f.prize_box_moorcroft: Contains various unique Moorcroft Manor-themed furnishings. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t3: Help us test this new content.
item.properties|f.gh_env_embers: An environment that fills your Guild Hall with falling ash and soot as if Vog himself had passed through.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_4a: Now then, greet those that have helped you become what you are today. When you are done, take the elevator back up to receive your commendation.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.plasma_capacitor: The addition of an advanced Spiral power source gives this bomb a shockingly large blast radius.
exchange.properties|m.billing_spending_l: You have reached your spending limit. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.black_kat_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a shadowy sapper of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_3a: An intense sadness radiates from his fallen form.  His eyes fade and a darkness washes over him.  Arkus is lost.
support.properties|m.subheader_step206:
Revealing personal information is not acceptable, whether it is their own or another player's. Asking for personal information is not acceptable either.

Asking people how old they are or what grade they're in or what sorts of sports they do etc. is not considered personal.

But things like phone numbers or address or real name are personal information and should never be revealed.
item.properties|f.frost_gel: A drop of chilly gunk collected from a cool Clockworks customer.
item.properties|f.volt_oil: A slippery substance that always holds a slight electrical charge.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_power: Usage\: /{0} skill power value\nUpdates a sprite skill's power value.
item.properties|f.exp_west_4f: An expansion that adds three rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.officer_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Officer rank and up.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the shadowy maskeraith, battle sprite of those who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
support.properties|m.option_4_0: If your complaint was for offensive chat, harassment by player etc. then this would be a good time to ignore {0}, so you're never bothered by them again. Playing a game is about having fun, don't let other players ruin this.
help.properties|m.controls_attack: [[ACTION]]. Hold to do a charge attack. [[ACTION]] also lifts large items, speaks to NPCs, and activates stations.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_10: Congratulations {0}.  The Geo Knights owe a great deal to your efforts.
uplink.properties|m.detached_accessory: Spiral Knights had a change and the attached accessory was removed from your {0}.\n\nApologies.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_a: Last night terrible monsters attacked us in the darkness.  It was utter chaos. With no power for the turrets we couldn't defend ourselves. \n\nSo many brave Knights lost...
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_4a: Even though you have defeated Vanaduke, it appears as though the curse he brought down upon this kingdom still lingers. It requires all of our power to keep these raging shadow fires in check.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_helm: A sturdy helm worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.vial_curse_super: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
item.properties|f.grintovec: Your enemies will surely enjoy the cool, refreshing sensation of being hit by a glacier.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: Oh, {0}\! As if all these strange occurrences weren't bad enough, I have some shocking news for you.
item.properties|f.ultra_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
item.properties|f.ascended_calibur: Made of a rare alloy of sun silver, knights talented enough to possess Caliburs as fine as this one typically bond with and name their blades.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_mask: The ultimate in haunted headgear, certain to protect your cranium from even the most hellish of shadow attacks.
item.properties|f.armor_fallen: A cursed suit of armor once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
item.properties|f.sacred_wraith_helm: A honed helm for those who are gunning for gremlins.
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts_short: If you are hurt, use Hearts to heal yourself\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Raise your shield to block attacks\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: B-beware...it stalks us...it watches our every move\!
sprites.properties|d.disintegration_ray: The ray of light also reduces the defense of its targets.
item.properties|f.combuster: Combining the principles of the Skylark's engines with the technology powering the Blast Furnace produced this brutal blade, which can ignite even the most flame-retardant materials at a distance.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
item.properties|f.prisma_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful prisma bullets that split multiple times on impact.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_773357: Defeat the Roarmulus Twins in the dangerous depths of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
item.properties|f.armor_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
chat.properties|m.usage_advance: Usage\: /{0} [number of floors]\nAdvances the party ahead one or more floors.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|r.ending_in_fire_1a: Thanks Kora, I plan on being the first to reach the Core\!
item.properties|m.add_more_bonuses: Add more fire crystals to unlock chances for bonuses\!
conversation.properties|r.mon_pocket_2: Thanks Nonna, but maybe next time.
mission.properties|b.eye_of_needle: After compiling the data you collected from the Owlite keep and additional intel from Recon Knights, Intel Agent Kora has prepared a debriefing for you with regard to the mass of negative energy blocking access to the Core.
item.properties|f.ghost_bell: A small, silvery bell worn by considerate ghosts that alerts the living when they are close by.
mission.properties|r.new_threat_5a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_bl: A short torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Seekers, the skillful grenadiers of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|r.winterfest_danger_1: I need all the help I can get, tell me all you know.
chat.properties|m.usage_kick: Usage\: /{0} player name\nKicks a player offline.
conversation.properties|m.lab_hahn_1a: (Hahn looks busy and does not seem to notice you)
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_suit: A suit snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells a bit sweaty.
item.properties|f.spiral_plate_helm: A heavyweight helm made of iron designed to withstand stunning impacts.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_5a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
item.properties|f.iron_gear: A metal gear that was once a component of a complicated contraption.
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_suit: A bony barrier that throbs with malevolence. Anyone skeptical of this suit's power deserves a good ribbing.
mission.properties|m.a_call_to_arms1: This is Vaelyn at the Core Terminal. Team wiped out. Darkness everywhere. Send help. It is opening.
chat.properties|m.usage_spawn: Usage\: /{0} name attr value attr value...\nSpawns an actor in the scene.
guild.properties|i.console_edit: Work with others to decorate and modify the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_1a:
Alright Rangers, listen up - we've got orders to infiltrate a gremlin bioweapons facility lead by a member of their 'Crimson Order,' known as 'Herex.'  This is just a fancy way of saying that one of the craziest of the crazy gremlins likes to load his gun with unconventional bullets. 

We don't know what he has cooking down there so arm yourself and don't forget to wear a mask. If Herex is anything like Seerus you're liable to catch more than a cold down there. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
item.properties|f.furni_block_ice: A block made of densely packed snow. It's perfect for assembling elaborate snow forts\!
uplink.properties|m.tx_failed: Something went horribly wrong, but we were able to recover the following item(s).\n\nPlease contact a support agent if anything is still wrong.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_2a: Do Strangers sell anything else besides weapons and gear?
item.properties|f.almire_table: A table transplanted from the hallowed halls of Almire to adorn your abode.
item.properties|f.gm_helmet: An impressive indigo helmet that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
item.properties|f.firo_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful firo bullets that split multiple times on impact.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last:
Yes, it is isn't it?  I should not have come here alone.  I should have stayed with my squad. 

(Edger looks off into the distance) 

I don't even remember how it happened.... maybe I never will.  But it didn't hurt.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_crowns: Crowns are the currency of the Clockworks. You can use them to purchase all kinds of things like new weapons and armor. While playing with others, every party member gets crowns whenever anyone picks some up.
social.properties|m.already_played: You have already completed this mission today.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: The Alpha Squad's sacrifice will not be in vain. I will immediately order our forces to undertake special Operations Missions all over Cradle. If there are forces trying to free The Swarm, we'll have to stop them.
item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_1: A fractured fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.
mission.properties|o.first_contact: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
item.properties|f.night_cap_pith: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer a restorative night of sleep.
item.properties|f.blazebrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a concentrated high-temperature explosion that is harmless to knights.
item.properties|f.driftwood: A peculiar piece of wood that just won't stay put.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_3a: The energy signature is coming from somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace and we need you to investigate.  Royal Jellies are very territorial so you might have to get past its lair in order to reach your objective. Be wary though, a Royal Jelly surrounds itself with plenty of protection.  You will likely face significant resistance as you investigate the palace.
item.properties|f.budding_coat: A ripped clean suit can mean death, but fortunately this one was colonized by an unusual symbiotic plant. Wear this and you'll be guaranteed to have a green thumb\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeknigh: Did you see the view from the Arcade?
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_plump_rooste: An impressively-large Buhgok that is taking a nice, long rest after a hearty meal.
sprites.properties|d.no_mercy: Increases the damage inflicted by hexing haze.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Everyjelly is welcome at the Golden Slime\!
mission.properties|o.alchemy_beginners: Learn about the wonders of alchemy\!
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r7: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
projectx.properties|m.mission_imf: Recover the recon module in the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_4a: Hah\! You'll never reach me in my 'Room of Invincibility'\! You'll be trapped in that control room forever\! ...Erm, wait. I might have overlooked something...
social.properties|m.watch_full: Oops\! That party is no longer accepting new watchers.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: At any given time a sprite has a 'favored item', a special material that it enjoys eating the most. Feeding one of these to your sprite is a great treat and grants the sprite a lot of heat.
item.properties|f.ignition_armor: Light armor augmented to help protect knights venturing into heated situations.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
conversation.properties|m.hav_greeter_1a: Welcome to Haven, little one. Please join your friends in procuring shinies from the Clockworks. Shinies are always appreciated by the Strangers.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
The Clockworks have been so consistent for so long\! Just ticking along like, well... you know. But now *something is happening* and I don't know what it is\!\! 

I'm so excited\! 

Bring us samples of these Mysterious Spikes and we'll make good trades for them\!
guild.properties|m.environment_change_wa: You are paying to install this environment. If for any reason it is removed you will have to pay to install it again.
shop.properties|m.unbindeDepotAd: Out of energy? Get more in the supply depot\!
mission.properties|b.shopping_again_b: Now it's time to learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers.  Follow knight Bechamel and pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
item.properties|f.turbillion: An ostentatious mechanized blade whose turbine crackles with the power of a thousand storms.
mission.properties|o.first_mission: Get to the end of the gate. Cheat if necessary.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Get inside, use the elevator...blow up whatever is controlling those cannons\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_klepto_: I won't steal anything... I promise\!
mission.properties|b.p_testmission_1: Start the mission and refer to the testing notes for the depth of each floor.
mission.properties|m.intro_expansion: Expansion Missions are special missions that must be unlocked in order to access. Completing Expansion Missions earns you exclusive rewards\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_edge: A sinister sword made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Simply holding it makes you somehow feel guilty of an unknown crime.
guild.properties|e.already_withdrew: You have already withdrawn from an energy well today and must wait 24 hours.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_2: We're attempting to find a means to activate the Core through the power of the minerals found within the Clockworks.  Those minerals are capable of transforming the Clockworks- we have seen this in the Haven Arcade.  It is our belief that we can use that power to activate the Core and... open it somehow.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro4_1a: I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp to the north. \n\nAnd should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I don't know about that... I'm fine here amongst all these ancient tomes.  I've got plenty to read, more than I ever could in a lifetime.  But I suppose that won't be a problem. \n\nPlease, just head on back to Haven.  Let my squad know that I'm ok and that I'm safe.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite: (The remaining pages are too deteriorated to decipher anything further save for a date of the events described which suggest that the Kingdom of Almire was destroyed over a thousand years ago.)
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: I'd like to see the shops. (Follow Tylen)
item.properties|f.piggy_banker: A small volatile bank that is sure to burn a hole in your enemies' pockets.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires one Golden Slime Coin or crowns if none are available.
exchange.properties|m.coins_traded_poe: You have received {0} crowns as the result of an energy trade.
mission.properties|r.becoming_champion_1: I'll fight to the very end, Lieutenant.  I know what's at stake.
item.properties|f.vog_cub_coat: This hide garment is so flame retardant that you won't even mind that it reeks of wood smoke.
mission.properties|b.guardians_of_cradle: You have been invited to attend a meeting with several members of Spiral HQ to discuss what to do next about the Core and the threat of the Swarm. Join them in the Hall of Heroes to learn about Operations Missions.
item.properties|f.style_kit: {0}  This item will be destroyed, but you will be able to re-apply this modifier to your knight using the style kit.
conversation.properties|m.tier_2_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 7-1. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
helptips.properties|m.design:
Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to place.
Press DEFEND [[DEFEND]] to put away.
Press PREV_WEAPON [[PREV_WEAPON]] to rotate clockwise.
Press NEXT_WEAPON [[NEXT_WEAPON]] to rotate counter-clockwise.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_5a: That's right, you can acquire recipes and materials in order to alchemize weapons and gear at alchemy stations.  Come on, I'll show you one.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_2a: You stand within the Hall of Heroes, where the best of the Spiral Knights offer what they can to aspiring knights.  Knights like you yourself once were when you first emerged from your drop pod and found your way to Haven. \n\nAnd after so many successful missions, daring rescues and exemplary performance in battle, you now stand fit to join these heroes.
item.properties|f.deadly_virulisk_mask: A Virulisk Mask upgraded with an advanced toxin filter. It always smells like artificial pine needles on the inside.
item.properties|f.shocking_salt_bomb: A large chunk of rock salt primed with a potent explosive. For nutritional purposes, this particular chunk of salt has been enriched with dangerous amounts of electricity. Wait, what?
town.properties|m.haven_desc: A peaceful town that is home to the Strangers. These salvagers offer the Spiral Knights sanctuary in return for the treasures that they acquire while investigating the Clockworks. Haven is also heavily populated with snipes, bulbous little birds with a curious means of locomotion.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_2a: Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage correct?
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_5a: Done here?  Yes, though there's just one more thing I wish to add.
item.properties|f.swordstone: A fine chunk of natural rock perfect for honing the edge of a deadly blade.
helptips.properties|m.atg_pots: Some objects like pots can be thrown at switches AND enemies\!
mission.properties|r.apocrea_2_3a: I will try. Tell me what to do.
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_mail: A suit of Spiral Plate Mail with a supercharged internal power source. The upgrade didn't make the armor any lighter.
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Purchase a Krogmo Coin Booster from the Upgrades Merchant\!
item.properties|f.hololite_box: Contains one randomly-chosen Hololite costume or accessory.  No key is required to open.
uplink.properties|m.title: SPIRAL UPLINK
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_ema: We have saved the offending email already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
helptips.properties|m.can_resurrect: You have been granted a Spark of Life by a party member. Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to revive.
sprites.properties|d.chaotic_haze: Targets damaged by hexing haze have a chance of receiving a random status condition.
uplink.properties|m.bid_complete: Thank you for using the Haven Auction House, your shinies are always appreciated.
mission.properties|b.whipping_mishandlin: After Recon Knights discovered a fiendish city known as Sol' Fork, Spiral HQ deployed a research team to station itself in the heart of the city and study the devilites within.  Their findings have become the basis for our understanding of devilite culture and their motives for working with gremlins. \n\nThis research team is in desperate need of supplies in order to maintain working on-site.  It would be of great help to Spiral HQ's continued research to have a squad enter the city and deliver the necessary supplies.
item.properties|f.gorgofist: A terrifying handgun that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Suppressing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_3a: Wow, it sounds like you've already had quite the adventure, {0}\!  Spiral HQ will most certainly be interested in that artifact you recovered.  It's remarkable that you were able to face off against a gremlin in the Clockworks and survive.
craft.properties|m.confirm_remove_access: The accessory will be removed and destroyed. Are you sure?
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_9a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
item.properties|f.proto_bomb: A small bomb used by Spiral Knight recruits to learn the art of blowing things up.
chat.properties|m.usage_follow: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to follow you\!
item.properties|f.sacred_sentinel_helm: A radiant defending doubleweave for insulating against erratic elements.
item.properties|f.powderkeg: Careful, this thing could go off like a metaphorical powder keg.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
item.properties|f.nova_driver: It'll take more than a wish to save you if you're the unfortunate target of this all-powerful pistol with the strength of the stars themselves.
item.properties|f.confetti: Use this item to throw it into the air and celebrate good times. Come on\!
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_5a: It would seem so.  And this place, it just radiates evil, it's almost indescribable.  It's even starting to affect the levels surrounding it- fires are breaking out everywhere. \n\nYou're one of the best we've got, {0} and if there's anyone that could lead a squad through the citadel it's you.  But even reaching it won't be easy.  We're going to need to take care of a few fires and gather a bit more intel before storming the gates.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_2a: Yes, we nature sprites are the rain, the root, and the soil. But you are not like us. You are like the ones below.
item.properties|f.slicer: Energy spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!  And look out for that extra-peppy boomerang effect...
helptips.properties|m.sprite_cooldown: After using any sprite skill, a cooldown is required on all skills before using them again.
item.properties|f.harlequin_cowl: You can't clown the wearer of this colorful cowl or you'll find that you're the punchline.
item.properties|f.industrial_hard_hat: Normally worn by construction workers, this hat doesn't offer much defense but grants the wearer high stun resistance.
conversation.properties|r.lab_biscotti_3: How do I feed my battle sprite?
sprites.properties|d.explosive_firestorm: Creates a series of explosions when unleashing the firestorm.
item.properties|m.sprite_food_only: Can be fed to Battle Sprites.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of fiend and undead family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'best free lecture yet' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_3: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 4 Star gear and receive certification
pvp.properties|m.prize: You were awarded the weekly prize for {0}\!
conversation.properties|r.sl_guard_2: Got it.  What else do I need?
